Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Good decisions need more than numbers. They need sound thinking, clear context and the confidence to act. As Senior Data Analyst at GoodHabitz, you will turn company, revenue and product data into standardized metrics and insight that helps people across the business make better decisions — and helps our organisation move from reactive reporting to a data-driven, insight-led way of working.

You will be the analytical backbone behind that progress. You will bring statistical rigour to the metrics and models that reach senior stakeholders, while helping teams agree on what their numbers really mean. This is a role for someone who enjoys the detail, sees the bigger picture and wants their work to have real-world impact.

Key Responsibilities


Provide statistical sound insights — cohort maturity, sample size, aggregation bias, construct validity — before analysis reach senior stakeholders.
Shape the team's data model and analytics conventions, and mentor other analysts on data quality.
Translate complex analysis into clear business language so senior stakeholders can decide with confidence.
Own end-to-end analysis across revenue, product, finance and marketing domain.
Align Revenue, Finance, Product and Operations on shared metric definitions and resolve conflicts into one documented decision.
Build self-service Tableau dashboards or access via LLMs for non-technical stakeholders.
Write clean, documented SQL/code to support the centralised data hub.
Partner with Data Engineers on data model design and champion data quality.


Requirements

You bring a strong analytical and statistical foundation, sound judgement and the curiosity to keep asking better questions. You also know that great analysis is a team effort: it takes collaboration, empathy for the people using the work and the confidence to make complexity clear.


Analytical experience: 7+ years as a (Senior) Data Analyst, preferably in a B2B organisation with subscription or recurring-revenue dynamics
Statistical reasoning: You are comfortable applying statistical reasoning to time-based and cohort data. In this role, that ability is core to the work.
Cross-functional impact: A strong track record of leading complex analysis across teams and raising the analytical bar for the people around you.
SQL & Python: Expert-level SQL skills for querying and transforming large datasets, advanced Python skills for data preparation and statistical validation.
Self-service BI & Insights: Proven experience in offering self-service to non-technical stakeholders via dashboards or AI/LLMs.
Predictive & Machine Learning: Experience designing, validating, rolling out and monitoring predictive models (e.g. churn or conversion prediction), including basic safeguards like train/test separation and drift monitoring.


Preferred Qualifications (nice-to-have)


Databricks: Confidence working in Databricks and Delta Lake
Experience with Tableau, Tableau Pulse


Benefits


💰 Competitive salary and role-specific performance bonus because we value your contributions and reward your hard work.
🏖️ Paid time off - 25 days holiday.
🚆 Travel budget.
💻 Flexible work & tools - work in a supportive environment with the comforts you need, plus a laptop.
📈 Growth & development - unlimited access to GoodHabitz resources and MyAcademy to fuel your personal and professional growth.
🧠 Mental coaching - support from our partner, to keep your mind in top shape.
🌍 Diverse & inclusive teams - work with colleagues from across Europe, bringing different cultures, perspectives, and ideas together.
🎉 Themed events & team-building - from creativity workshops to vitality socials, our events are full of energy and fun surprises.
🤝 Annual Do-Good Day - a fully paid day to do volunteer work, alone or with your team, supporting a cause you care about.
🛡️ Pension & insurance - disability and pension coverage for your long-term security.

Title: Analyst, Data Operations and Analytics (all genders)
Description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a savvy Analyst, Data Operations and Analytics to join our Data Office in Berlin and serve as the ultimate bridge between data, product, and business teams across our Hospitality vertical. You'll turn complex business questions into clear insights, reusable data models, and reporting that help teams understand their customers and business, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. If you're ready to combine strong analytical judgment, product and business understanding, and technical expertise to elevate data standards, and make a lasting impact, this is the opportunity for you!

Lightspeed empowers the businesses at the heart of our communities, from standout retailers to unforgettable restaurants to renowned golf courses. We are a global team who fuel ambitions with technology and insight.

From online and in-person operations to multichannel sales, payments, inventory management and data-driven insights, Lightspeed helps businesses grow, deliver exceptional customer experiences and run smarter across all channels and locations.

Join our driven, diverse and inclusive team to find your people, accelerate your career and create tangible solutions that help local businesses thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing


Build a solid understanding of Hospitality's business processes, customers, and data so you can answer questions accurately and with the right context.
Perform analyses such as segmentation, customer health checks, and impact measurement to help teams understand how the business is performing.
Write SQL queries and build datasets to answer stakeholder questions, pulling from multiple data sources as needed.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that make it easy for business partners to track KPIs and spot trends.
Work with stakeholders to understand what they're really asking, turning loosely defined questions into a clear analysis plan, with support from senior colleagues on trickier requests.
Present findings clearly, with visualizations and a short narrative that explains what the data shows and why it matters.
Help spot and investigate data quality issues, documenting what you find and flagging root causes to the right people.


And a Little Bit Of


Stay up to date with developments, innovations, and trends in data, including state-of-the-art machine learning models and large language models (LLMs).
Contribute as part of the wider team to achieve organizational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.


What You Need To Bring


2–3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytics role.
Solid SQL skills, comfortable querying and joining data across multiple sources.
Experience with Python for data analysis is a plus.
Experience building dashboards or reports using Looker or a similar BI tool.
Exposure to Hospitality, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Sales, or another operational business environment is a plus.
Comfortable turning a business question into an analysis plan, and asking clarifying questions when the ask isn't fully defined.
Careful with data accuracy, with a good eye for spotting things that look off.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, able to explain findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Curious, organized, and a self-starter, comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with GCP, BigQuery, Dataform, GitHub, or Salesforce is a plus.
Familiarity with Segment or Heap type of tools is a plus.


We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

What’s In It For You

Come live the Lightspeed experience...


Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day
Opportunity to make a difference; help merchants grow their businesses and become more successful by creating or improving products and addressing customer feedback
Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact
Development of very high-traffic products, used at a global scale
Opportunities to learn and expand your skill set
Become a valued part of the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture


… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:


Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)
Monthly office lunch
Work from anywhere in the world for 60 days a year
Health and wellness benefit of 400 euros per year
Mental health online platform and counseling & coaching services
Volunteer day


To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who We Are

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

Title: Staff Data Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
About Redcare Pharmacy:

As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health.” If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values, join us and start your #Redcareer today.

About the role:

Join one of our cross-functional product teams and become the technical leader driving analytics excellence within your domain. As a Staff Data Analyst, you'll work end-to-end—from understanding business challenges to designing scalable analytics solutions that enable better decision-making across Redcare Pharmacy.

You'll combine deep technical expertise with strong stakeholder collaboration, helping shape our modern analytics platform while mentoring colleagues, promoting best practices, and contributing to the evolution of our cloud-based data landscape.

Job Description

About your tasks:


Lead the design and development of scalable data models using dbt, SQL, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric, delivering trusted, high-quality analytics across your product domain.
Partner closely with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions, influence backlog prioritisation, and deliver measurable business value.
Develop impactful Power BI dashboards and semantic models, enabling intuitive self-service reporting and supporting data-driven decision-making across the organisation.
Contribute to the evolution of our cloud analytics platform, helping modernise existing data products, improve scalability and performance, and support Redcare's ongoing Microsoft Fabric journey.
Champion analytics best practices, mentor fellow analysts, share technical knowledge, and contribute to innovative initiatives including AI-assisted analytics and self-service capabilities.


Qualifications

About you:


You bring 8–10+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or similar role within modern enterprise data environments.
You have strong hands-on expertise in SQL, dbt, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI, with experience building scalable analytical solutions and semantic models.
You confidently engage with both technical and business stakeholders, translating complex business challenges into scalable data solutions and communicating technical concepts in a clear and accessible way.
You enjoy mentoring colleagues, driving technical excellence within your team, and continuously improving analytics practices. Experience with Azure, Unity Catalog, Python, AI-assisted development, or cloud migration projects is considered a strong advantage.


Additional Information

About your benefits:

In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family, or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:


Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings.
Redcare events: We promote teambuilding through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.
Corporate pension plan: We offer a company pension scheme and have a dedicated external consultant to offer you the best guidance and advice.
Mental Health: Get quick and professional help from psychologists of nilo if you feel overwhelmed in private or professional life. Anonymous and free of charge.

Title: Game Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
We are Kolibri Games - a mobile games developer from Berlin. We believe that with the best people, we can make games that players will enjoy for years to come.




Our games have defined the idle genre, and bring enjoyment to hundreds of millions of players all around the world. This is possible due to the talented people who make us who we are. ‘Kolibris’, as we call ourselves, are on a mission to continue making great games and we're looking for new talent to join our team. We strive to offer you a fair recruitment process and a great candidate experience, as well as a friendly environment to work in, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.




Game Data Analyst (f/m/d)




Are you curious about what makes games engaging? Do you enjoy understanding not just what players do, but why they do it, and turning that understanding into clear, actionable insights? We are looking for a Game Data Analyst to strengthen our product analytics capabilities. In this role, you will combine strong analytical thinking with solid technical foundations to support multiple game teams over time. This is an individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on data modeling, advanced analysis, and scalable analytical foundations.




Responsibilities

Partner with product and game teams to answer complex questions around player behavior, engagement, and progression
Perform advanced analyses using SQL to uncover patterns and drivers behind player actions
Design and analyze player segmentation and behavioral cohorts
Design, implement, and evaluate A/B tests to measure feature performance, optimize player experiences, and guide data-informed decisions. Build and maintain reliable, analytics-ready data models (experience with dbt or similar tools)
Ensure data quality, clarity, and documentation of key datasets and metrics
Contribute to self-serve reporting and visualization
Partner with cross-functional teams to align priorities, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure analytics is central to shaping the player experience.
Collaborate with other analysts and data infrastructure team to improve analytical workflows and standards




Required Skills

3+ years of experience in Data Analytics
Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools
Experience working with complex datasets and analytical data models
Ability to translate data into clear insights for both technical and non-technical audiences
Curiosity, ownership, and eagerness to learn new tools and approaches




Desirable Skills

Experience with Looker and dbt
Experience with Python or R for data analysis.
Familiarity with data orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow)
Background in games, free-to-play, or product analytics

Title: Data Analyst (f/m/d) Snowflake, Tableau & Alteryx
Description:
Momentaufnahme von Ihrem Tag

Sie arbeiten in unserem Global Order Management Team an der Entwicklung moderner Datenlösungen und begleiten den gesamten Data Lifecycle – von der Integration und Transformation bis zur Analyse und Visualisierung von Daten. Dabei analysieren Sie komplexe Geschäftsprozesse, stimmen sich regelmäßig mit Fachbereichen und internationalen Stakeholdern ab und entwickeln datenbasierte Lösungen für unterschiedliche Business-Anforderungen. Ihre Arbeit verbindet analytische Aufgaben mit technischer Umsetzung und bietet Raum, bestehende Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren und innovative Ansätze im Bereich Data & Analytics voranzutreiben.

Wie Sie etwas bewirken können


Entwicklung, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Datenprodukte sowie Datenpipelines mit SQL, Snowflake und Python
Konzeption, Automatisierung und Optimierung leistungsfähiger Analyse- und Datenverarbeitungsworkflows mit Alteryx
Erstellung interaktiver Dashboards, Berichte und KPI-Visualisierungen zur Unterstützung datenbasierter Entscheidungen mit Tableau
Analyse komplexer End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesse sowie Identifikation von Effizienzsteigerungs- und Optimierungspotenzialen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und internationalen Stakeholdern zur Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in nachhaltige Datenlösungen
Mitarbeit in agilen Projekten sowie aktive Weiterentwicklung des Data- und Analytics-Portfolios



Was Sie mitbringen


Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Fundierte Erfahrung mit SQL sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in Snowflake, insbesondere in den Bereichen Data Warehousing, Datenmodellierung und Datenanalyse

Title: Data Analyst:in Product & Business Intelligence (d/m/w)
Description:
Tagesspiegel Background ist das B2B-Fachinformationsprodukt des Tagesspiegels: professionelle Briefings und Politikmonitoring für Ministerien, Verbände, Kanzleien und Unternehmen, im Jahreslizenz-Abo.

Für unser Produktteam suchen wir eine Person, die Geschäfts- und Produktdaten zusammenführt und daraus belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen macht. Die Rolle verbindet klassisches Reporting mit Produktanalytik und ist bewusst breit angelegt – Du entwickelst unser Reporting weiter, untersuchst Nutzung und Geschäftsentwicklung und gestaltest mit, wie wir Nutzung messen, bewerten und in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen.

Du ziehst also nicht nur ein Reporting, wenn danach gefragt wird. Du fragst auch selbst: Was hat sich verändert? Warum könnte das so sein? Welche weiteren Daten oder qualitativen Erkenntnisse brauchen wir, um die Hypothese zu prüfen? Eine der Fragen, denen Du nachgehst: Welche Nutzungsmuster sagen Vertragsverlängerungen oder -kündigungen am besten voraus?

Du arbeitest im Produktteam, eng mit Produktentwicklung, Growth, Vertrieb und Redaktion, sowie mit dem zentralen Datenteam des Verlags, bei dem Betrieb und Datenpipelines liegen. Für einzelne Fragestellungen arbeitest Du eigenständig mit den Rohdaten; was dauerhaft laufen soll, entsteht gemeinsam mit dem Datenteam.



Das sind Deine Aufgaben:

Du verantwortest unser Reporting in Power BI auf Basis von Salesforce und dem Data Warehouse – Umsatz, Kundenentwicklung, Retention, Forecasts – entwickelst es weiter und sorgst für einheitliche, dokumentierte Kennzahlendefinitionen, etwa rund um Abwanderung im Lizenzgeschäft
Du definierst gemeinsam mit Produktentwicklung, Marketing und Growth, welche Ereignisse wir messen, und führst Daten aus Webtracking, E-Mail-Versand, Landingpages und CRM über die verschiedenen Quellsysteme hinweg zu einer konsistenten Account-Sicht zusammen
Du erkennst relevante Veränderungen und Auffälligkeiten in unseren Daten, formulierst Hypothesen und untersuchst sie eigenständig. Dabei bleibst du nicht bei der ersten plausiblen Erklärung stehen, sondern prüfst alternative Ursachen und die Aussagekraft der Datenbasis
Du entwickelst Analysen zur Nutzung unserer Website und unseres Produkts weiter – zum Beispiel zu Aktivierung, Engagement, Nutzungstiefe und Verlängerungswahrscheinlichkeit. Du leitest daraus konkrete nächste Untersuchungen oder Handlungsempfehlungen ab
Du legst bei neuen Funktionen und Produkten vor dem Launch fest, woran wir Erfolg messen, und wertest nach dem Rollout aus, was sich bewährt hat, für wen und unter welchen Bedingungen
Du bereitest Deine Ergebnisse für Redaktion, Vertrieb und Geschäftsführung so auf, dass sie als Entscheidungsgrundlage taugen – methodisch sauber, zielgruppengerecht und inklusive der Aussagegrenzen der jeweiligen Datenbasis


Das bringst Du mit:

Etwa drei bis fünf Jahre Erfahrung in Product Analytics oder Business Intelligence – beides zusammen ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Ein Abo-, Medien- oder B2B-SaaS-Umfeld ist von Vorteil
Sehr sichere SQL-Kenntnisse auf einem Cloud-Warehouse (z. B. BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift oder Databricks) und Erfahrung mit einem BI-Werkzeug, bei uns Power BI
Fundierte Erfahrung mit Web- und Produktanalytik, inklusive GA4 auf Rohdatenebene. Erfahrung im Entwurf eigener Tracking-Konzepte ist von Vorteil
Du definierst, erklärst und vertrittst Kennzahlen sicher, ordnest ein, was eine Zahl aussagt und was nicht, und leitest daraus nächste Schritte ab
Du arbeitest hypothesengetrieben und beharrlich. Wenn ein Signal interessant ist, gehst Du ihm nach, bis Du Ursachen, Unsicherheiten und Konsequenzen möglichst klar voneinander trennen kannst
Du arbeitest reproduzierbar, sodass andere Deine Auswertungen nachvollziehen und weiterführen können
Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich, prüfst deren Ergebnisse jedoch sorgfältig, bevor Du sie weitergibst
Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss:

Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System als Datenquelle, idealerweise Salesforce
Kenntnisse in Python oder R
Erfahrung mit Kundeninterviews oder Nutzerforschung
Verständnis für Abo- und Lizenzmodelle


Das bieten wir Dir:

Kreativer Freiraum in einem Team, in dem Ideen geschätzt werden und Du Deine Visionen in einem innovativen Medienunternehmen im Herzen Berlins umsetzen kannst 
Flache Hierarchien mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Kommunikation 
Bezuschusstes BVG-Firmenticket und Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
Kostenloses Digital-Abonnement von Tagesspiegel & Tagesspiegel Plus, Handelsblatt und die Zeit 
Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch die Online-Plattform Masterplan, um Deine Karriere voranzutreiben  
Eine 38,5-Stunden-Woche mit 30 Tagen Urlaub (bei einer Vollzeitstelle), damit Du ausreichend Zeit hast, um Dich zu erholen 
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten bis zu 50% 

Jede Nachricht erzählt eine eigene Geschichte – und so ist es auch mit den Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. Beim Tagesspiegel schätzen wir die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter und sind fest davon überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven unsere Arbeit bereichern.   

Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und fördern einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter oder sexueller Identität – bei uns bist Du willkommen. Lass uns gemeinsam ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld schaffen, in dem jeder seine Einzigartigkeit einbringen kann!  



Du denkst, wir sollten uns kennenlernen?


Wenn Du bereit bist, Deine Fähigkeiten in einem inspirierenden Team einzusetzen und einen echten Unterschied zu machen, dann bewirb Dich jetzt über unser Bewerbungsportal https://verlagsjobs.tagesspiegel.de/ und sende uns Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen. Gemeinsam erzählen wir Geschichten, die bewegen! 

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

  • Du erkennst relevante Veränderungen und Auffälligkeiten in unseren Daten, formulierst Hypothesen und untersuchst sie eigenständig. Dabei bleibst du nicht bei der ersten plausiblen Erklärung stehen, sondern prüfst alternative Ursachen und die Aussagekraft der Datenbasis
  • Du entwickelst Analysen zur Nutzung unserer Website und unseres Produkts weiter – zum Beispiel zu Aktivierung, Engagement, Nutzungstiefe und Verlängerungswahrscheinlichkeit. Du leitest daraus konkrete nächste Untersuchungen oder Handlungsempfehlungen ab

  • Du bereitest Deine Ergebnisse für Redaktion, Vertrieb und Geschäftsführung so auf, dass sie als Entscheidungsgrundlage taugen – methodisch sauber, zielgruppengerecht und inklusive der Aussagegrenzen der jeweiligen Datenbasis

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Web- und Produktanalytik, inklusive GA4 auf Rohdatenebene. Erfahrung im Entwurf eigener Tracking-Konzepte ist von Vorteil

About us

At ablefy, we believe passion can turn into a career for anyone. With ablefy.io, we give coaches, consultants, creators, and entrepreneurs everything they need to build and sell digital products online — simply and efficiently. 70,000+ entrepreneurs already trust us to power their business.




Born in 2015, ablefy has grown into a true all-in-one solution — courses, memberships, payments, e-ticketing, and more. We take care of the hard stuff, so our users can focus on what truly matters: growing their business.




Today we're the #1 platform for coaches and creators in the DACH region — and we're not slowing down. That's where you come in.




Our mission; to build software that empowers everyone to start, run and grow a successful digital business - borderless, is supported by our high performance principles that are crucial to our success:

Radical Collaboration
Constructive confrontation
Adaptive execution
Collective ambition
Evolving expertise
Empathetic leadership




About the role

Data is at the core of how we build products at ablefy — not only to guide our own decisions, but also as a value we deliver to our customers. As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping both our internal analytics and the customer-facing data products we bring to market. This includes delivering business-critical insights and reports, working on our AI-powered self-service analytics agent and the intelligence layer that powers agentic, data-driven product recommendations for our customers.




You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to define priorities and deliver end-to-end data projects. You will also stay close to customer needs and feedback to shape impactful data products — ensuring that data and AI-driven insights deliver maximum impact.




Responsibilities

Take responsibility for key analytics initiatives across the business, owning projects end-to-end and ensuring insights are translated into decisions.
Own parts of our analytics engineering layer: design and build the data models and transformations that prepare and clean data for reliable consumption by dashboards, tools, and AI agents.
Contribute to the ongoing development of our data warehouse — integrating new data sources and ensuring scalable, consistent metrics across the company.
Work closely with internal teams to understand business and customer workflows, challenges & goals, and translate these into meaningful analytics solutions.
Design and build customer-facing data products — from embedded dashboards and reports to AI-based self-service analytics tools and our intelligence layer — empowering internal stakeholders and our customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions more efficiently.
Collaborate with senior leadership and stakeholders to define and track KPIs, assess opportunities, and prioritize projects with the largest impact.




Qualifications

Strong quantitative background and 3-5 years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst.
Exposure to AI-driven analytics products or LLM applications (e.g. self-service analytics agents, chatbots and dashboarding tools). Hands-on experience is a plus, but curiosity and the ability to learn are essential.
Experience with product and business event tracking — including defining business events, understanding product flows, and identifying the signals that drive meaningful analytics.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and an interest in applying them to build and iterate on data pipelines, models, and analytics products more efficiently.
Great knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and data warehouse concepts.
Proficiency in Python for analytics and statistics.
Experience building or contributing to customer-facing data products is a plus (embedded analytics, data APIs, or AI-based self-service tools).
Strong communication skills and commercial awareness — able to simplify complex insights, prioritize based on customer and business impact, and manage diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering and Finance.
Experience in fintech domains — such as payments, PSPs and checkout is a plus.
Fluent in English; German is a plus.




Benefits

Paid time off – 30 vacation days.
A competitive salary.
A personal training and development budget of €1,500 per year.
Responsibility and trust from day one.
Individual coaching and further training to support you in your development.
A free BVG ticket.
Employee discounts at numerous companies (e.g. at the gym or in online stores).
Pension program with company match up to 30% of employee contributions.
A culture of equity and inclusion where you are appreciated for the person you are.




Diversity & Inclusion

At ablefy, we embrace our differences, as they are our greatest strength. We recognize that everyone has a unique perspective based on their experiences, identities, and thought processes, and we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. Discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or any other aspect that makes you unique is not tolerated at ablefy. We aim to make growth accessible to everyone!




We know that no candidate checks every single box, and that’s okay! If you’re excited about this role and think you can bring something valuable to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement. We’d love to hear from you!




AI at ablefy

As an AI-first company, we put intelligent technology at the heart of everything we do. AI is part of how we build, learn, and grow together. It helps us work smarter, move faster, and focus on creating real impact. We believe the strongest results come from combining thoughtful technology with curious, driven people — and we’re excited to shape what’s next, together.

Mit über 14 Millionen Online-Leser:innen und der höchsten verkauften Auflage in der Hauptstadtregion sind wir weit mehr als nur ein reichweitenstarkes Qualitätsmedium – wir sind ein dynamisches Medienhaus, das kontinuierlich wächst und sich weiterentwickelt. Unsere Redaktion und unser Verlag setzen auf Innovation, um den Herausforderungen des Medienmarktes mit frischen, kreativen Ideen zu begegnen. Neben Qualitätsinhalten in Print, Online, Audio und Video bieten wir ein vielfältiges Veranstaltungs- und Konferenzgeschäft, das unser multimediales Angebot perfekt ergänzt. Als stolzes Mitglied der DvH Medien GmbH von Dieter von Holtzbrinck stehen wir in einer Reihe mit angesehenen Leitmedien wie der Zeit, dem Handelsblatt und der WirtschaftsWoche. Bei uns arbeiten leidenschaftliche kreative Köpfe zusammen, die eine gemeinsame Vision für die Zukunft des Journalismus teilen. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und gestalte mit uns die Medienlandschaft von morgen!


Tagesspiegel Background ist das B2B-Fachinformationsprodukt des Tagesspiegels: professionelle Briefings und Politikmonitoring für Ministerien, Verbände, Kanzleien und Unternehmen, im Jahreslizenz-Abo.


Für unser Produktteam suchen wir eine Person, die Geschäfts- und Produktdaten zusammenführt und daraus belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen macht. Die Rolle verbindet klassisches Reporting mit Produktanalytik und ist bewusst breit angelegt – Du entwickelst unser Reporting weiter, untersuchst Nutzung und Geschäftsentwicklung und gestaltest mit, wie wir Nutzung messen, bewerten und in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen.


Du ziehst also nicht nur ein Reporting, wenn danach gefragt wird. Du fragst auch selbst: Was hat sich verändert? Warum könnte das so sein? Welche weiteren Daten oder qualitativen Erkenntnisse brauchen wir, um die Hypothese zu prüfen? Eine der Fragen, denen Du nachgehst: Welche Nutzungsmuster sagen Vertragsverlängerungen oder -kündigungen am besten voraus?


Du arbeitest im Produktteam, eng mit Produktentwicklung, Growth, Vertrieb und Redaktion, sowie mit dem zentralen Datenteam des Verlags, bei dem Betrieb und Datenpipelines liegen. Für einzelne Fragestellungen arbeitest Du eigenständig mit den Rohdaten; was dauerhaft laufen soll, entsteht gemeinsam mit dem Datenteam.


Das sind Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du verantwortest unser Reporting in Power BI auf Basis von Salesforce und dem Data Warehouse – Umsatz, Kundenentwicklung, Retention, Forecasts – entwickelst es weiter und sorgst für einheitliche, dokumentierte Kennzahlendefinitionen, etwa rund um Abwanderung im Lizenzgeschäft
  • Du definierst gemeinsam mit Produktentwicklung, Marketing und Growth, welche Ereignisse wir messen, und führst Daten aus Webtracking, E-Mail-Versand, Landingpages und CRM über die verschiedenen Quellsysteme hinweg zu einer konsistenten Account-Sicht zusammen
  • Du erkennst relevante Veränderungen und Auffälligkeiten in unseren Daten, formulierst Hypothesen und untersuchst sie eigenständig. Dabei bleibst du nicht bei der ersten plausiblen Erklärung stehen, sondern prüfst alternative Ursachen und die Aussagekraft der Datenbasis
  • Du entwickelst Analysen zur Nutzung unserer Website und unseres Produkts weiter – zum Beispiel zu Aktivierung, Engagement, Nutzungstiefe und Verlängerungswahrscheinlichkeit. Du leitest daraus konkrete nächste Untersuchungen oder Handlungsempfehlungen ab
  • Du legst bei neuen Funktionen und Produkten vor dem Launch fest, woran wir Erfolg messen, und wertest nach dem Rollout aus, was sich bewährt hat, für wen und unter welchen Bedingungen
  • Du bereitest Deine Ergebnisse für Redaktion, Vertrieb und Geschäftsführung so auf, dass sie als Entscheidungsgrundlage taugen – methodisch sauber, zielgruppengerecht und inklusive der Aussagegrenzen der jeweiligen Datenbasis


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Etwa drei bis fünf Jahre Erfahrung in Product Analytics oder Business Intelligence – beides zusammen ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Ein Abo-, Medien- oder B2B-SaaS-Umfeld ist von Vorteil
  • Sehr sichere SQL-Kenntnisse auf einem Cloud-Warehouse (z. B. BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift oder Databricks) und Erfahrung mit einem BI-Werkzeug, bei uns Power BI
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Web- und Produktanalytik, inklusive GA4 auf Rohdatenebene. Erfahrung im Entwurf eigener Tracking-Konzepte ist von Vorteil
  • Du definierst, erklärst und vertrittst Kennzahlen sicher, ordnest ein, was eine Zahl aussagt und was nicht, und leitest daraus nächste Schritte ab
  • Du arbeitest hypothesengetrieben und beharrlich. Wenn ein Signal interessant ist, gehst Du ihm nach, bis Du Ursachen, Unsicherheiten und Konsequenzen möglichst klar voneinander trennen kannst
  • Du arbeitest reproduzierbar, sodass andere Deine Auswertungen nachvollziehen und weiterführen können
  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich, prüfst deren Ergebnisse jedoch sorgfältig, bevor Du sie weitergibst
  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss:

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System als Datenquelle, idealerweise Salesforce
  • Kenntnisse in Python oder R
  • Erfahrung mit Kundeninterviews oder Nutzerforschung

Title: Business & Data Analyst - B2B2C
Description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.



About the Ideal Candidate
We are looking for a Business & Data Analyst to support our B2B2C business by turning complex commercial, operational, and product data into clear insights and decision-ready analysis. This role sits at the intersection of data, commercial performance, and business strategy.

About the Role

Own business and performance analysis across B2B2C products, partners, and markets
Analyze large datasets using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Build and maintain commercial and operational reports (revenue, margins, ARPU, churn, usage, onboarding KPIs, etc
Translate raw data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior stakeholders
Support pricing analysis, partner performance reviews, and business cases
Work closely with Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to align data with business reality
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and logical interpretation across reports and dashboards.





Requirements



About You 

Must-haves

4+ years of experience in data analysis, KPI reporting, or business intelligence
Strong SQL skills and experience working with data lakes or large datasets
Proficiency with BI/DWH tools (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets (pivoting, modelling, complex formulas)
Strong analytical ability with a solid understanding of business models, value chains, and technical systems
Ability to navigate complex operations, understand performance drivers, and derive clear, actionable recommendations
Experience supporting business case development, benchmarking, or strategic analysis
Excellent communication skills — able to present complex insights in a simple and effective way
High degree of ownership, proactivity, and the ability to drive tasks end-to-end


Nice-to-haves

Telecom / MVNE / MVNO domain experience is an advantage



Benefits



Why 1GLOBAL?

Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly capable Data/Business Analyst to help us track, analyze, and govern Commercial Data. You will sit at the intersection of Finance, Pricing, and RevOps, acting as a vital part of the analytical engine behind our commercial operation.

You’ll need to manipulate large, complex data sets derived from a broad spectrum of systems. You should be able to demonstrate experience and knowledge of analysis concepts, tools and techniques. The successful candidate should be able to articulate and present complex information and data clearly in the form of dashboards, scorecards & reports.

Because you will frequently collaborate with non-technical stakeholders, you must be skilled at interpreting requirements, discovering new datasets, and executing iteratively in an agile environment. Part of your role will be to act as a dedicated analyst, working with stakeholders that require absolute precision in their metrics. To contextualize the data being processed, you should be able to liaise with subject matter experts. The ideal candidate will have a mix of curiosity and passion along with a drive for results.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own


Consumption Tracking: Build the data models required to trace quota & credit consumption
Audit & Compliance: Build data products that pass rigorous financial audits using factual records
Data Pipeline Engineering: Translate complex commercial business logic into robust SQL and dbt pipelines
Executive Insight: Design + build LookerStudio dashboards offering clear & actionable findings
AI-Assisted Engineering: We heavily leverage AI in our daily workflows. You will architect logic, define decision thresholds, let AI handle routine coding, and meticulously validate output
Reconcile & Triangulate: You will perform rigorous validation and testing of your data to ensure trust


What You Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis, with a strong emphasis on Finance, commercial transactions and SaaS solutions like Salesforce & Netsuite
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, Information Systems or similar quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills and experience querying large databases (Google BigQuery preferred)
A mix of curiosity and stamina; you are risk-tolerant, comfortable with light structure, and thrive in a scale-up environment
Experience with coding language principles, version control (Git), and data transformation tools (dbt)
A proactive and highly flexible team player, comfortable collaborating closely with a globally distributed team spanning European and US time zones


Application Deadline

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Title: Senior Analyst, Data Operations and Analytics (all genders)
Description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by! 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a savvy Senior Analyst, Data Operations and Analytics to join our Data Office in Berlin and serve as the ultimate bridge between data, product, and business teams across our Hospitality vertical. You'll turn complex business questions into clear insights, reusable data models, and reporting that help teams understand their customers and business, make better decisions, and improve operational performance. If you're ready to combine strong analytical judgment, product and business understanding, and technical expertise to elevate data standards, and make a lasting impact, this is the opportunity for you!

Lightspeed empowers the businesses at the heart of our communities, from standout retailers to unforgettable restaurants to renowned golf courses. We are a global team who fuel ambitions with technology and insight.

From online and in-person operations to multichannel sales, payments, inventory management and data-driven insights, Lightspeed helps businesses grow, deliver exceptional customer experiences and run smarter across all channels and locations.

Join our driven, diverse and inclusive team to find your people, accelerate your career and create tangible solutions that help local businesses thrive.

What You'll Be Responsible For


Develop a deep understanding of Hospitality’s business processes, systems, customers, and underlying data architecture to provide meaningful analysis and support operational excellence within the Pod.
Develop exploratory and reusable data models leveraging diverse data sources, supporting business partners with insightful datasets, reporting, dashboards, and clear analytical recommendations.
Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous stakeholder questions into well-defined analytical requirements, approaches, and solutions that address the underlying business need.
Be the bridge between the Data Office and the broader Hospitality organization, turning complexity into clarity and ensuring clear communication of assumptions, findings, limitations, and implications.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and data flows, and use analysis to help Hospitality teams make more informed and effective decisions.
Monitor and improve data quality by investigating discrepancies at the source, documenting findings, communicating impact, and driving continuous improvement across the relevant teams.
Collaborate with the Data Office to establish analytical standards and best practices, improve documentation and definitions, and mentor junior team members.


And a little bit of...


Stay up to date with developments, innovations, and trends in data, including state-of-the-art machine learning models and large language models (LLMs).
Contribute as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.


Who you are:


4+ years in an analytical role, with strong experience in data operations, business intelligence, reporting, or process optimization.
Strong experience translating business stakeholder challenges and needs into technical requirements, analytical approaches, and practical solutions.
Excellent SQL skills, with the ability to work across complex data structures and multiple data sources; willingness to learn new tools and data systems.
Experience developing data models, datasets, dashboards, and reporting that are accurate, reusable, and accessible to business partners.
Experience in Hospitality, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Sales, or another operational business environment will give you a head start.
Strong business acumen and a knack for bridging the gap between technical challenges, analytical findings, and business strategy.
Enjoy tackling complex problems through meticulous research, structured analysis, critical thinking, and creative but pragmatic solutions.
Meticulous with data accuracy and quality, with a keen eye for spotting anomalies, investigating root causes, and understanding the impact of data issues.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex problems, analytical results, and recommendations with clarity and impact.
A drive to deliver results, strong organizational skills, a self-starter mentality, and the ability to drive projects autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with GCP, BigQuery, Dataform, Looker, GitHub, and Salesforce is a plus.
Familiarity with Segment or Heap type of tools is a plus.


What’s In It For You

Come live the Lightspeed experience...


Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment;
Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;
Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.


… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy:


Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)
Mental health online platform and counselling & coaching services
Health and wellness benefit
Volunteer day to be able to give back to society!


To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who We Are

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
Wer uns fehlt, bist du!




Als Senior Data Analyst analysierst und interpretierst du Daten, um fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden und internen Teams abzuleiten und die Weiterentwicklung digitaler Strategien und Marketingmaßnahmen zu unterstützen
Du konzipierst, implementierst und optimierst Tracking-Architekturen und setzt dabei Tools wie Google Tag Manager, GA4, Piwik PRO, BigQuery und Data Studio ein, um eine datenschutzkonforme, präzise und zukunftsfähige Datenerfassung sicherzustellen
Performance-Daten analysierst du systematisch, identifizierst relevante Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungspotenziale ab, zunehmend auch mit Unterstützung KI-gestützter Analyseverfahren
Du planst und analysierst A/B-Tests entlang der gesamten Customer Journey und hast immer den nächsten Hebel im Blick
Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript, HTML und CSS sowie praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit SQL, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrungen mit MCP-Schnittstellen, der Anbindung von KI-Anwendungen an Datenquellen sowie Kenntnissen in Python oder R
Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen behältst du im Blick und bringst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse gezielt in die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Strategie-, Performance-Marketing- und SEO-Teams ein
Datenschutz- und DSGVO-Anforderungen berücksichtigst du selbstverständlich bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Tracking- und Analysekonzepten
Agiles Mindset? Unbedingt! Unsere Projekte finden hauptsächlich im agilen Umfeld statt und wir arbeiten mit Tools wie Miro, Jira und Confluence
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, da unsere aktuellen Projekte überwiegend in deutscher Sprache durchgeführt werden. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil




Darauf kannst du dich freuen




Flexibilität & Vertrauen: Hybrides Arbeiten an einem unserer denkwerk Standorte & flexible Arbeitszeiten
Deine Gesundheit zählt: Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und JobRad-Leasing
Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam: Gewinnbeteiligung für alle festen denkwerker:innen, große Partys und Event Formate
Deine Entwicklung ist uns wichtig: Weiterbildungsbudget für neue Skills und Trainings; denkwerk Inspirationen im Form von Tech Talks, Lunch Club, Resilienz-, KI- und Design Formate
Zukunft sichern: 20% Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
Support in allen Lebenslagen: Beratung durch den pme Familienservice und die Mindance App
Mehr als nur Urlaub: 31 Urlaubstage inkl. drei gemeinsame „denkfrei-Tage” (Heiligabend, Silvester, Rosenmontag)
Ankommen mit Rückenwind: Dein persönlicher denkmate begleitet dich beim Start
Empfiehl uns weiter - Find Your Mate: Bringe großartige Menschen mit und wir bedanken uns bei dir mit einer Prämie
Rabatte & Goodies: Zugriff auf exklusive Corporate Benefits sowie kostenlose Snacks, Kaffee, kühle Drinks & frisches Obst




Bereit, mit uns durchzustarten?




Dann schick' uns einfach:




deinen Lebenslauf
ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben
dein mögliches Startdatum
sowie deine Gehaltsvorstellungen zu




Dein Weg zu uns




1. Bewerbungseingang

Wir sichten deine Unterlagen sorgfältig und leiten sie ggf. an den Fachbereich weiter.




2. Interviews

Erstgespräch: digital via Microsoft Teams

Zweitgespräch: persönlich an einem unserer Standorte

Aufgabe? Falls ja, geben wir dir rechtzeitig Bescheid




3. Individuelle Journey

Sollte es sinnvoll sein, einen anderen Weg zu gehen, gestalten wir den Bewerbungsprozess gern gemeinsam mit dir und passen ihn individuell an.




4. Feedback

Wir melden uns zeitnah. Dauert's dir zu lange? Melde dich gerne!




Das sind wir, deine Ansprechpartnerinnen




Janina Schulte-Kellinghaus & Marie Rybarczik, Talent Acquisition Team

Title: Data Analyst - Marketing (w/m/d)
Description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben


Du analysierst Marketing-, Kampagnen- und Kundendaten und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
Du entwickelst und pflegst Dashboards, Reports und KPI-Systeme zur Erfolgsmessung.
Du identifizierst Trends, Potenziale und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten entlang der Customer Journey.
Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Performance-Marketing-Kanälen wie SEA, SEO, Social Media, E-Mail-Marketing und Affiliate Marketing.
Du führst Ad-hoc-Analysen durch und bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich für verschiedene Stakeholder auf.
Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing-, Sales- und Produktteams zusammen.
Du unterstützt bei der Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von A/B-Tests.
Du stellst die Datenqualität sicher und entwickelst bestehende Analyseprozesse kontinuierlich weiter.


Dein Profil


Du hast ein sehr erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor/Masterstudium an einer Top-Tier Business School
Du verfügst über erste Arbeitserfahrung oder Praktika in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen wie z.B. Startups oder in einer Unternehmensberatung/Consulting
Du bist kreativ und es fällt dir leicht andere Menschen zu überzeugen
Du zeichnest dich durch eine analytische, proaktive und stark lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
Du besitzt eine natürliche Stärke in der Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern
Du hast großes Interesse am Aufbau von Unternehmen und einen ausgeprägten Willen Neues zu lernen
Du hast eine zielstrebige Arbeitsweise, ein hohes Maß an Proaktivität und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
Du besitzt Erfahrung im Priorisieren von Aufgaben in einem fast-paced Environment und kannst einen 100%-Ansatz beim Arbeiten an wichtigen Aufgaben umsetzen
Du stellst hohe Qualitätsansprüche an Dich selbst und andere und legst eine Can-Do-Mentalität an den Tag die andere motiviert
Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift


Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen


Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.
Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.
Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.
Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.
Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.
Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.
Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.
Dein Extra-Boost - 29 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.


Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

Title: Senior BI Analyst, Reporting & BI (m/f/x)
Description:
The Role

As a Senior BI Analyst in the Reporting & BI team, you will be the owner of HelloFresh's data landscape for your domain. You will build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers executive decision-making — from creating data pipelines and ETL jobs to building executive-level dashboards and conducting deep-dive analyses.

You combine analytical depth with engineering capabilities: translating ambiguous business questions into actionable insights and own end-to-end delivery — from raw data ingestion through transformation pipelines to polished dashboards and strategic recommendations that reach C-suite stakeholders.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at building things: pipelines, data models, dashboards, and insights — all while ensuring data quality, scalability, and business impact.

What You'll Do: The Recipe


Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using dbt, Databricks, Spark SQL, and Airflow — transforming raw data into robust, scalable models that power analytics across the business
Act as the steward of your domain's data landscape: implement automated data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting to proactively catch issues, and troubleshoot pipeline failures with timely root-cause fixes
Write performant, maintainable SQL for large-scale data transformations and collaborate with central Data Engineering teams on schema design and technical requirements
Build and maintain executive-level BI dashboards (Tableau, Databricks) and conduct deep-dive analyses that translate complex, ambiguous business questions into data-driven strategic recommendations
Own critical business reporting (WBRs, QBRs, forecasting) and act as the trusted analytics partner across Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations — ensuring insights are accurate, timely, and actionable
Document data models, pipelines, and methodologies to enable self-service, and mentor junior analysts and engineers on SQL best practices, data modeling, and stakeholder communication


What You'll Bring: The Ingredients


6+ years of experience in BI Analytics, Data Engineering, or Analytics Engineering — ideally in a fast-paced B2C, subscription, or growth-oriented business
Advanced SQL proficiency and data pipeline experience — comfortable with complex transformations, performance-tuning, and building/troubleshooting ETL/ELT pipelines at scale
Modern data stack tools — hands-on experience with dbt, Databricks, Spark SQL, Airflow, or similar orchestration and transformation tools
Data modeling expertise — strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, and designing scalable data models
Proven ability to build and maintain BI dashboards (Tableau, Databricks, Looker, or similar) that reach senior leadership
Stakeholder management — experience translating ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical work and influencing cross-functional partners (Product, Marketing, Finance, Operations)
Ownership mindset — proactively identifies issues, drives solutions, and takes accountability for data quality and delivery


Nice To Have


Python for data transformation, ad-hoc analysis, automation, or lightweight modeling
Experience with data monitoring and alerting frameworks (Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, dbt tests)
Experience with event-level behavioral data and tracking design (Snowplow, Google Analytics, Segment, GA4) — schema design, entity modeling, event naming
Exposure to statistical modeling techniques — segmentation, clustering, regression, cohort analysis
Experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) or data migration projects.


What we offer: The Toppings

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing


You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.
Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.


Health & Wellbeing


Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.
Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.


Flexibility & Work-Life


Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.
Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.
Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.


Career & Development


Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.


Culture & Environment


Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.
We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

Title: Data Analyst (f/d/m)
Description:
Join us as femtasy's first internal Data Analyst (f/d/m). Sit with Marketing, Product, and Finance to turn messy questions into clear, actionable answers, working directly with our Head of Data.




This is femtasy

femtasy is the audio-only streaming platform for sensual audio stories & sexy sounds for women. We inspire women to explore and enjoy on their own terms. We're a female-centric product, led by a female CEO & Founder, with over 90% of our team identifying as women+. We've already positively impacted the lives of hundreds of thousands of women by redefining female pleasure – and we're just getting started.




Your mission and your impact:

Today, all data requests from Marketing (our principal stakeholder), Product, and Finance funnel through our Head of Data, who scopes every ask before an external agency executes it. That doesn't scale. You'll be the first internal hire to change that: sitting directly with stakeholders, turning vague requests into well-defined problems, and delivering a good-enough solution fast.




You'll report to the Head of Data and work alongside an Analytics Engineer who owns the heavier dbt/pipeline work.




Six months in, this is what your impact looks like: you run scoping conversations with Marketing especially, but also Product and Finance independently – no pre-framing needed from your Head of Data. You own the fact tables and models behind your recurring reporting. You've proactively fixed or flagged at least one foundational data issue – because you saw it, not because someone asked. Stakeholders treat you as a go-to resource, not a ticket-taker.




What you'll do

Own first-line scoping conversations with Marketing, Product, and Finance: ask the right clarifying questions, push back on vague or over-scoped requests, and land on a defined problem plus a good-enough solution.
Come up with your own solution after aligned with stakeholders, maximizing the impact and keeping the development time as short as possible.
Build and maintain the dashboards and reports (Tableau today, tool-agnostic long term) that Marketing, Product, and Finance can actually act on.
Build and manage data in dbt: create and maintain the fact tables and models that support your recurring reporting and analyses, with our Analytics Engineer supporting the underlying infrastructure.
Own the day-to-day reliability of what you build: catch issues, flag or fix them – so no one ever has to ask »which number is right«.
Question the status quo at the working level. If something's »always been done that way« and it's slowing a team down, we want you to say so and to work with your Head of Data on what's worth fixing.




What you bring

3+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar analytics role: you can work independently on well-scoped problems and know when to ask for help on ambiguous ones.
Proven stakeholder-facing judgment. You've sat in front of a non-technical stakeholder with a vague ask, asked the right questions, and resisted both over-engineering the answer and under-scoping it.
You frame problems clearly, communicate directly, and challenge assumptions.
Solid SQL, dbt, and hands-on comfort with a BI tool: you build and maintain your models yourself, from raw data to fact table to dashboard. Our Analytics Engineer supports you on infrastructure, but day-to-day dbt work is yours to own.
Comfortable moving across domains. You won't own one fixed area – you will support Marketing and other stakeholders when needed.
Opinionated but coachable. You're willing to challenge »it's always been like that«, and open to direct feedback.
Fluent in English.

A strong plus, not a must

You've worked with Marketing before (at least one real marketing project)
You've experienced a startup environment
You already use AI tools in your day-to-day analysis




This role is hybrid, based in or around Berlin. We're in the office together every Tuesday and Wednesday, with flexibility on the remaining days.




This is NOT for you if…

You want every request fully pre-scoped before you touch it, rather than asking the clarifying questions yourself.
You'd rather just execute the ticket than sit with a stakeholder and challenge whether it's the right ask.
You reach for a dashboard or a data pull before you've actually understood the business problem behind it.
You're not comfortable owning your models end-to-end in dbt, from raw data to the fact table to the final report.
You see yourself as a data service desk instead of creating your own tickets after aligning with stakeholders.




What we offer

🌟 Impact & purpose. The chance to join a huge mission around female empowerment and gender equality.

🦸 Female-led and women-centric. A female-centric product, a female CEO & Founder, and over 90% of our whole team identifies as women+.

🤝 Inspiring, performance-oriented culture. A progressive team culture based on transparency, open feedback, ownership, and collaboration. Check out »radical candor« if you want to learn more about how we work.

🤖 AI-first by default. A company-paid AI subscription of your choice, and a team that automates everything worth automating so you can focus on the work that matters.

📈 Personal and professional growth. Team learning sessions, learning & development budgets, and internal trainings. Every team member, from junior to C-level, has access to personal 1:1 sessions with a professional business coach.

🔄 Healthy approach to taking a break. 26 holidays plus unlimited recharging time on top for when you really need it.

📍 Flexibility. Flexible working hours, hybrid setup with our Berlin office as home base.

🎉 (Really cool) events & benefits like an Urban Sports membership (or alternative offerings), snacks & lunches, mobility and retirement plans, and our famous femtasy parties and team events. We also cook and eat together twice a month and have a big office garden for the best BBQs in Berlin.

💪 Package. A compensation package that fairly mirrors what's expected from you and the impact you'll have on femtasy. Exact range shared in the first call.




femtasy offers equal opportunities for all and encourages applicants of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religious backgrounds, gender identities, and people with disabilities to apply.




Our Recruiting Process

Short application questionnaire (approx. 10 minutes)
30 min Get-to-know-each-other call with one of our recruiters
30 min with our Head of Data
1h 30 min working session with our Head of Data: a live scoping exercise, not a take-home test
45 min interview with one of your future stakeholders (Marketing, Product or Finance)
1h interview with our CEO
Final offer




We are looking to fill this position as soon as possible und usually respond within three days.

Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category - the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: you see everything about a lead before you buy - full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. Role Overview

Intro

Zur CKM Group gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Schnittstelle zu Fachbereichen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Bereichen wie Marketing undOperationszur Klärung, Priorisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Anforderungen.
Monitoring & Reporting: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards und Reports zur Überwachung von Datenqualität, Systemzuständen und operativen KPIs.

Weiterentwicklung der Datenlandschaft: Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzialen in Datenstrukturen, Tools und Prozessen sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung.
