Title: Senior Analyst — People & Workforce Intelligence (PWI) (d/f/m)
Description:
Personio's intelligent HR platform helps small and medium-sized organizations unlock the power of people by making complicated, time-consuming tasks simple and efficient. Our team of 1,500 Personios is building user-friendly products that delight our 15,000+ customers and their 1.5 million employees. Ready to make an impact from day one?

This role requires 2 days per week in the office and is based in Munich, Berlin or Dublin.

We empower Personio's decision-making with reliable data and strategic insights, while improving productivity through scalable infrastructure and automation. Be part of our transformative journey in HR technology, where your contributions shape how a leading people management platform understands its own workforce.

The Senior Analyst — PWI sits within the Data, Systems & AI department and partners closely with the People & Workplace Intelligence (PWI) function. This role combines two capabilities that are most powerful together: building the data foundations that make reliable analysis possible, and delivering the analysis itself. You own the infrastructure — writing dbt models from raw sources — and you own the insight: turning that data into clear recommendations for People leadership and partners.

You will work closely with PBPs and People leadership to connect people data sources — HRIS, absence and attendance systems, and others — and enable a self-serve analytics capability across the people domain.

What You'll Do

Data Foundations


Build and own dbt models end-to-end — from raw source ingestion through to staging, intermediate, and reporting layers — for the PWI domain, covering HRIS, headcount, absence, attendance, and adjacent people data sources.
Design and maintain scalable warehouse schemas in Snowflake, with clear data lineage, documentation, and version-controlled code (Git).
Define, document, and steward metric definitions and the semantic layer for people data, ensuring reliable KPI logic and metric consistency across the domain.
Implement data quality testing, monitoring, and alerting so that data issues are caught early and fixed proactively — not discovered by stakeholders.


Analytical Delivery


Deliver structured analysis on headcount, attrition, absence and attendance, org design, manager effectiveness, and compensation for PBPs and PWI leadership — forming clear hypotheses and producing decision-ready outputs, not just data dumps.
Build and maintain intuitive dashboards and reporting that allow stakeholders to self-serve on day-to-day questions without requiring analyst involvement.
Support MBR and QBR cycles with data storytelling: own the narrative, not just the numbers.
Partner with PBPs to diagnose root-cause data gaps, translate urgent business needs into analytical deliverables, and systematically improve the quality of people data over time.


Stakeholder Partnership


Act as the embedded analytical partner for the PWI function — showing up proactively, anticipating needs, and flagging risks before they escalate.
Present findings directly to People leadership with confident, prescriptive recommendations.
Enable PBPs to work more independently with data through documentation, self-serve tools, and direct coaching.


What You Need To Succeed

Must-haves


5+ years in analytics engineering, analytics, or a hybrid of both — you have done both the building and the analysis, not just one side.
Expert-level dbt: you have built models from raw source data, written tests, managed documentation, and understand lineage end-to-end — not just maintained existing models.
Strong SQL: complex queries, performance optimization, ability to work across a Snowflake-based data warehouse without hand-holding.
Analytical rigour: you structure ambiguous problems into hypotheses, identify the right metrics, and produce outputs that lead to decisions — not more questions.
Clear communicator: you translate data into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, present confidently, and write documentation that people actually use.
Experience with BI tooling (HEX, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) for building stakeholder-facing dashboards and reporting.
Comfortable with Git and version-controlled codebases as a daily practice.
High ownership: you diagnose root causes, drive work independently, and don't wait to be told what matters next.
AI Fluency: You have hands-on experience using AI to improve your workflow, and the sound judgment to know exactly when to rely on it and when to step in yourself.


Nice to have


Experience with people/HRIS data — Workday, BambooHR, or similar compensation and benefits tooling.
Python for analytical workflows and automation.
Exposure to AI/LLM tooling (Claude, GPT) for insight generation or workflow automation.


Why Personio

Personio is an equal opportunities employer, committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We embrace uniqueness and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. We are proud to have an inclusive workplace environment that will foster your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

At Personio, we value in-person collaboration while also offering flexibility. This role is office-based, with 3 days per week required in your contracted office location. The remaining days can be worked from home or in the office if you prefer. In addition, you’ll have 20 Flex Days per year to work remotely from other locations. Aside from our people, culture, and mission, check out some of the other benefits that make Personio a great place to work:


Receive a competitive reward package – reevaluated each year – that includes salary, benefits, and pre-IPO equity
Enjoy 28 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day after 2 and 4 years
Make an impact on the environment and society with 1 (fully paid) Impact Day
Receive generous family leave, child support, mental health support, and sabbatical opportunities
We enjoy gathering for meals, cultural initiatives, and events like local Summer Sessions and year-end celebrations. There's also healthy snacks, drinks, and a weekly catered lunch.

Title: Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) – Daten & Institutssteuerung
Description:
Die Sparkassen Rating und Risikosysteme (SR) ist der zentrale Dienstleister für Verfahren des Risikomanagements in der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe. Wir unterstützen die Institute mit Standardlösungen in den Bereichen der Risikomessung und -steuerung, der regulatorischen Banksteuerung sowie im Vertrieb mit Data-Analytics-Lösungen. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern bieten wir den Instituten, von der Konzeption der Verfahren, über deren Weiterentwicklung, IT-Umsetzung und Umsetzungsunterstützung, zentrale und standardisierte Lösungen an.


Business Analyst | Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) – Daten & Institutssteuerung


ab sofort suchen wir im Fachbereich Institutssteuerung


Das erwartet Dich:
Aufbruch & Datenfokus: Bereich Institutssteuerung, Entwicklung neuer Systeme für Sparkassen; datengetriebene Lösungen zur Steuerung von Risiko und Ertrag, Arbeit mit Daten, Modellen und technischen Lösungen.
Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst Du früh eigene Themenpakete und entwickelst Dich hin zu eigenständigem Projektmanagement und sicherem Auftritt vor Kunden und Fachgremien.
Daten & Technik: Du analysierst große Datenmengen, entwickelst Auswertungen, Modelle und Prototypen (z. B. in SQL, Python, R), gestaltest Datenverarbeitungsstrecken und bereitest Ergebnisse für die Steuerung von Sparkassen auf.
Kundensicht & Technik verbinden: Du verstehst Prozesse und Bedarfe unserer Kunden und übersetzt sie in robuste, nachhaltige Daten- und IT-Konzepte – genau diese Brücke zwischen Fachlichkeit und Technik ist Kern Deiner Rolle.
Vielseitiger Arbeitsalltag: Mix aus Datenanalyse, Programmierung und Lösungsdesign, enger Austausch mit Fachbereichen und Anwender:innen; bankfachliches Vorwissen ist ein Plus, den fachlichen Kontext bauen wir mit Dir gemeinsam auf.

Das bringst Du mit:
Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem passenden Fach (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science) oder gleichwertige, praxisbasierte Kenntnisse.
Starke Datenanalyse-Skills, sehr gutes SQL, Programmierung in Python oder R; idealerweise Erfahrung mit gängigen Analyse- und Datenverarbeitungspaketen.
Erste praktische Datenerfahrung (Praktika, Werkstudium, Abschlussarbeit oder erste Berufserfahrung); Einstieg je nach Profil als Business Analyst oder Senior Business Analyst möglich.
Hohes Interesse an Kundendialog und daran, Anforderungen in klare, umsetzbare Daten- und Technikkonzepte zu übersetzen; Neugier und Lernbereitschaft, bankfachliche Erfahrung ist ein Plus.
Idealerweise Erfahrung im Projekt- und Anforderungsmanagement; auf Senior-Level fundierte Projekterfahrung und ggf. fachliche Anleitung von Kolleg:innen.
Starke Kommunikation, verbindliches Auftreten, Teamorientierung, pragmatische, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Lust auf kontinuierliche fachliche wie technische Weiterentwicklung.

Wir bieten Dir:
Eine unbefristete Tätigkeit in einem hoch versierten Arbeitsumfeld mit anspruchsvollen Aufgaben und einem attraktiven Vergütungspaket
30 Tage Urlaub + 2 Bankfeiertage und zusätzlichen Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen
Individuelle interne | externe Weiterbildung über unsere Akademie
Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeit und Option zum mobilen Arbeiten für eine echte Work-Life-Balance
Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
Zuzahlung zum Jobticket und Essensgutscheine
Dienstrad-Leasing (JobRad) als zusätzliches Mobilitätsangebot
Kostenfreie Girokontoführung inkl. Visa Card Gold bei der Berliner Sparkasse
Interne Veranstaltungen: Meet-Ups, Afterworks, Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeste
Zentraler und moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen und über den Dächern von Berlin

Title: Staff Data Analyst, Paid Search
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

This specific position sits within our Growth Analytics team, whose objective is to scale marketing investment toward the most incremental and loyal customers. The role is focused on our paid search channel where black-box auction dynamics, branded vs non-branded incrementality, and elasticity modelling define the analytical problem. The successful candidate will also contribute to cross-channel measurement questions as they arise.

Your mission


Develop quantitative analysis and statistical models to evaluate and steer marketing decisions
Propose and defend strategic recommendations to our top marketing leads
Setup and analyse marketing experiments to drive strategic decision making
Explore large datasets, give meaning to data and numbers, identify opportunities and issues, and present findings to stakeholders
Maintain and improve our marketing measurement tools (Attribution, experimentation framework, Customer lifetime value…)
Serve as a liaison between the marketing teams and the data engineering team
Mentor others in the skills needed for this role
Use AI to accelerate end-to-end analysis — from framing the question to delivering the insight — while holding a high bar for methodological rigor and validation


Your toolkit


8+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or data science role
Prior experience analysing paid search and/or SEO performance, using platforms such as Google Ads/Search.
Strong knowledge of SQL and Python for analysis (eg, pandas, scikit-learn, pyspark)
Hands-on experience with causal inference methods (e.g. geo experiments, difference-in-differences, synthetic controls) and/or elasticity modelling applied to marketing spend decisions.
Ability to understand user behavior and meaning behind the numbers and a track record in sharing insights to business stakeholders.
Experience identifying where AI could meaningfully improve your team's analytics workflows or tooling, not just your own output.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Databricks).
Desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction and with highly engaged individuals
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
Monthly transportation and fitness budget
Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
Language reimbursement program
Health and wellness benefits


And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Title: (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) in Berlin
Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Corporate Functions - Performance & Reward ein attraktives, motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld gestalten? Unser Team entwickelt Konzepte und Programme rund um die Themen Karriere, Benefits, Recognition oder (leistungsbezogene) Vergütung. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d).

Standorte: Düsseldorf, Berlin, Dresden, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, Leipzig, Magdeburg, Mannheim, München, Nürnberg und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als (Senior) Experte HR Data Analytics (m/w/d) erwartet dich eine anspruchsvolle Rolle als Data Scientist zur Entwicklung datengestützter Modelle zur Aufbereitung und Interpretation entscheidungsrelevanter Daten.


Konzeption: Du entwickelst geeignete Algorithmen und Modelle zur Aufbereitung entscheidungsrelevanter Daten und erschaffst individuelle Dashboards anhand moderner Business-Intelligence-Tools.
Verifizierung: Um deine aufgestellten Hypothesen zu prüfen, identifizierst du Zusammenhänge und Muster in deinen Daten.
Entwicklung: Gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern entwickelst du Reporting und Analysetools.
Präsentation: Strukturierte Aufbereitung der Inhalte für verschiedene Zielgruppen und Reporting-Anforderungen.
Management: Selbstständig identifizierst und entwickelst du Schritt für Schritt den notwendigen Prozess zur Entwicklung der gesamte Wertschöpfungs- und Engagementkette.


Dein Skillset:


Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Physik bspw. mit Schwerpunkt Statistik, Data Analytics oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung z. B. im Bereich Analytics und/oder Projektmanagement
Der Umgang mit großen Datenmengen in einem hochvertraulichen Umfeld ist für dich kein Problem
(Erste) Programmierkenntnisse in R, Python, SQL oder vergleichbar sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Qlik, Sense oder PowerBI
Exzellente analytische Fähigkeiten und einen hohen Anspruch an die eigenen Arbeitsergebnisse


Deine Chance:


Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr

Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
Vielfältige Gestaltungsräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do


Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.


What You'll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.


Nice To Have


Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).


What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you up for the challenge?

Title: People Analytics Manager (m/f/x)
Description:
Scalable Capital is a leading digital investment and banking platform with a full banking licence, empowering people across Europe to shape their own finances. Scalable Broker makes it easy and affordable for clients to invest professionally in stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives, as well as set up savings plans. Scalable Wealth, the digital wealth management service, offers clients professional investment in ETF portfolios, and is also adopted as a white-label solution by banks and other B2B partners. The company’s offerings are rounded off by attractive interest rates, loans, and private equity. With the European Investor Exchange, Scalable Capital offers an exchange specifically for retail investors. Over one million clients have already entrusted more than €30 billion to the platform.



Founded in 2014, Scalable Capital now employs over 700 people across Munich, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, and London. Together with the founding and management team, including Erik Podzuweit and Florian Prucker, they are working on a new generation of financial services.



Visit our finance blog or check out our Social Media channels to find out what our Expert Teams have to say.



Our Company Values guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. To learn more about them, you can find our values here (English).





Job Description



At Scalable, we use data to make better decisions across our business, including People. As our first dedicated People Analytics hire, you will build the foundations for a data-driven People function.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will bring together People data, create reliable reporting, improve our People Tech stack, and turn data into insights that help leaders make informed decisions.





Build a trusted People data foundation by combining data from relevant source systems and ensuring data quality, privacy, and clear ownership
Design and maintain dashboards and reports for core People metrics, such as headcount, hiring, retention, employee lifecycle, and workforce planning
Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders to translate business questions into meaningful analyses
Develop clear, actionable recommendations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders
Improve and expand our People Tech ecosystem to support reliable data flows and efficient People processes
Establish practical data governance standards for People data, including definitions, access, quality checks, and privacy requirements
Identify opportunities to develop forecasting and predictive analytics capabilities as the data foundation matures
Shape Scalable’s People Analytics and People Tech foundations from day one with a dedicated budget for analytics tooling and continuous learning
Work in close collaboration with People, Finance, and business leadership to directly improve decision-making, employee experience, and business growth


Qualifications


Experience in People Analytics, People Data Management, Business Intelligence, or a comparable data analytics role
Strong SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools, such as Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience working with HR systems and integrating data from multiple sources
A sound understanding of data architecture, data quality, data governance, and privacy principles
Ability to explain complex data clearly and turn findings into practical recommendations
Experience with Python or R is a plus, especially for advanced analytics
Fluent English skills. German is a plus
This role requires you to be based in Munich or Berlin and work from one of our office locations


Additional Information


Be part of one of the fastest-growing and most visible Fintech startups in Europe, creating innovative services that have a substantial impact on the lives of our customers
Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients
Be productive with the latest hardware and tools
Learn and grow by joining our in-house knowledge sharing or career development sessions and spending your individual Education Budget
Learn and experience German culture first hand by joining our free German language classes
Opportunity to work from abroad
Benefit from an attractive compensation package and from the company pension scheme
Monthly contribution of 50% for the ‘Deutschland Jobticket’
Say goodbye to order commissions and say hello to your complimentary subscription of Scalable Capital's PRIME+ Broker
Enjoy flexible and discounted sports activities with Urban Sports Club

Title: Decision Scientist, Payments Intelligence
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

As a Decision Scientist, you will work in a cross-functional Payments Intelligence team that supports all Payments Business Unit across different domains. This role is part of the Data Science & Analytics (DSA) function, reporting to the DSA Manager for Payments Intelligence. You will play a key role in shaping our payments products by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.

Currently, Payments is a quickly growing business area, which brings its own challenges and opportunities. To be successful and satisfied in this role, you need to be comfortable with a fast pace and continuous change. In return, you get to build something really big together with other driven and caring colleagues.

In this position, you’ll


Partner with your team and stakeholders at Vinted, to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations, as well as answer critical business questions.
Test and analyse developed opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools
Select, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact
Familiarity with SQL and Python
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Fluent in English, both written and spoken


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€69.600—€100.100 EUR

Title: Senior Quantitative Analyst
Description:
About Schumacher

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life.We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers “celebrate the feeling of home”. F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our Competitive Advantage In The Industry Is Our People. We Believe That Our Employees Are Our Most Important Assets. F. Schumacher & Co Is Deeply Anchored In Our Company Core Values Which Are As Follows


Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit
Take Ownership & Accountability
Be Solutions-Oriented
Demonstrate Courage
Practice Adaptability
Embrace Collaboration


We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is a 12 month contract and is a part of Data Insights & AI team

Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on, Senior Quantitative Analyst, Product Portfolio (Statistical Modeling) to own analytics and reporting in support of our Portfolio Development team, with a specific focus on SKU productivity & capital allocation across a portfolio of 20,000+ SKUs and growing. This role will report directly to the Sr. Director of AI & Data Insights, but is expected to work directly with the CEO & Chief of Staff on a day-to-day basis.

This is not a role for someone who takes data at face value. You'll need to distinguish real signal from noise (e.g., a SKU selling poorly because it's out of stock, not because demand is weak), and when you find data that's wrong or inconsistent, you'll have the access and judgment to go into Snowflake and fix it — not just flag it and wait.

What You’ll Do


Work hands-on with CEO & Product Strategy stakeholders to understand key strategic questions, and then build analysis and reporting to address them directly
Use statistical methods (e.g. conjoint analysis, multivariate regression) to identify which product attributes and characteristics (e.g., color, pattern, material, price point, availability) drive productivity, and translate that into data-driven guidance on where the portfolio should expand, contract or shift
Cut through data noise at scale: systematically identify and control for confounders like stock-outs, new/discontinued SKUs, and seasonality so reported trends reflect real pattern performance
Identify data inconsistencies at the source (e.g., ERP, web, product master data) and directly and systematically correct records in Snowflake and work with upstream platform owners to improve the accuracy of source data and downstream analytics
Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders
Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity
Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio


What We're Looking For


2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses
Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations
Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying)
A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives
Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner
Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible
Thinks in terms of SKU-level economics: sell-through, margin, inventory position, lifecycle stage — and knows how to separate a true productivity problem from a data artifact
Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML in a business context for task automation - automating repetitive analysis to spend more time on judgment calls
Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset


Nice to Have


Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools alongside Snowflake
Exposure to margin, pricing, or demand forecasting data
Experience in retail, e-commerce, or luxury/home furnishings goods


What We Offer


Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience
Fully remote work within Europe, with optional time in our NYC office (1–2 weeks per year)
Direct visibility with the CEO, with real influence on Product Strategy and Merchandising decisions
Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego working environment


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

Title: Retail Media Campaign Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a Retail Media Campaign Analyst, you form the analytical and operational backbone of our local Retail Media team in Germany. Working closely with our Retail Media Managers, you own the data-driven planning, tracking, optimization, and evaluation of advertising campaigns for FMCG brands, restaurant partners, and advertisers. Operating in a dynamic, high-growth environment, you translate complex performance datasets into actionable insights, maximize campaign revenue, and prove the ROI of our partners with hard facts. Through high-quality performance reporting, you proactively surface upselling opportunities and support the team with compelling insights for both internal reviews and external client meetings. To excel in this role, you bring deep ad-tech understanding, outstanding analytical skills, and a strong collaborative mindset.

Location: Berlin (Hybrid)

Reports to: Manager Retail Media

Key Responsibilities Of The Role


Analytical support, performance monitoring, and continuous data-led optimization of Retail Media and digital advertising campaigns to consistently hit client KPIs
Serving as the primary analytical partner for our Retail Media Managers regarding campaign performance, custom reporting requests, and ad-tech topics
Generating actionable insights from campaign performance and market data to drive long-term partner success
Systematically evaluating performance data to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities that support Commercial Managers in their business reviews
Building, automating, and maintaining performance dashboards, while preparing and occasionally co-delivering performance presentations for key accounts
Conducting closed-loop and attribution analyses
Collaborating closely with central Ad Operations, Data, and Product teams to continuously improve local campaign reporting standards and analytics infrastructure


What You Bring To The Team


Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, Data Science, Marketing, or a related field
Proven expertise in campaign analytics, reporting, and optimization across Retail Media, Search (SEA), Display Advertising, or related digital channels
Deep understanding of ad serving, DSP, SSP, and analytics platforms, as well as Programmatic Advertising and data-driven advertising solutions
Strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience querying and visualizing complex datasets (e.g., using SQL, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI)
Excellent organizational skills to efficiently prioritize and manage requests across multiple stakeholders (Retail Media Managers) and active campaigns
Operational agility, quick comprehension, and adaptability within a fast-paced, high-growth business environment
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, commercial stories for internal teams and clients
Native/fluent German skills and professional fluency in English (written and spoken)


Our Offer

Like a well-balanced recipe: your skills and our offer are a perfect match! Here is what awaits you with us:

💰 A competitive compensation package that recognizes your performance – complemented by an open feedback culture and regular performance reviews.

📝 A permanent employment contract with hybrid working options: three days a week in our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and two days working from home – entirely at your convenience.

🏋️‍♀️ Urban Sports Club membership – for your work-life balance and a fresh mind in your day-to-day routine.

🍽️ Additional perks: a monthly travel allowance of €59 and a €90 monthly Lieferando Pay credit to have delicious food delivered straight to your workplace.

🏠 Company pension scheme with a 20% employer contribution.

🌐 A diverse and inclusive team with colleagues from over 99 nations, as well as the opportunity to become part of our varied communities and ERGs (Employee Resource Groups).

😎 Shared experiences: after-work drinks, regular team events, social engagement initiatives, as well as our summer and/or winter parties.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Lieferando. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people’s stories, blogs, podcasts and more Lieferando and Just Eat Takeaway.com morsels.

Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now

Title: Manager Commercial Analytics (f/m/d)
Description:
Berlin | Full time | As soon as possible

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Specialist to strengthen our Commercial team and build the data foundation that supports informed sales and customer decisions. In this role, you will turn complex sales, market, usage, and customer data into reliable dashboards, reports, and actionable insights using Power BI and Excel. Working closely with Tech, Sales, and Sales Operations teams worldwide, you will ensure that commercial teams have accurate, accessible, and sales-ready data. This is a great opportunity for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with a structured, business-oriented approach to data.




This is a fixed-term contract for two years.




Your tasks




Build and maintain the commercial data foundation by consolidating, integrating, standardizing, and modelling data from multiple sources in close collaboration with the Tech department
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and Excel solutions that transform raw sales, market, customer, and usage data into clear, actionable business intelligence
Translate business requirements into reliable BI solutions, working closely with Commercial, Sales, and Sales Operations to deliver effective dashboards, reports, and data tools
Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity by identifying discrepancies, data gaps, and inconsistencies and implementing scalable solutions to improve data reliability
Act as the in-house data expert for usage data, COUNTER statistics, holdings, denials, and authorship reporting, supporting colleagues with data-related questions and requirements
Support global users and stakeholders by documenting BI solutions, communicating data availability and functionality, and providing training where required. The role does not include responsibility for revenue-related or order reporting.




Your profile




Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Informatics, Library & Information Science, Business Administration with a clear BI focus, or a comparable field, ideally combined with 3+ years of relevant professional experience
Strong expertise in Microsoft Power BI, including data modelling, dashboard development, and BI best practices
Advanced Excel skills, including PowerPivot, data modelling, automation, and working with complex datasets
Proven ability to integrate, consolidate, standardize, and validate data from multiple sources, with strong technical troubleshooting skills
Structured, detail-oriented, and solution-focused, with the ability to translate business requirements from non-technical stakeholders into reliable, scalable BI solutions
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English; German and knowledge of scholarly publishing data standards such as COUNTER are a plus




We offer you




An exciting professional challenge for one of the innovation drivers of the publishing industry
Family-friendly working time models, flexitime, and flexible home office arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, alongside a substantial vacation allowance and additional special leave days
Extensive benefits and allowances for a healthy, balanced life
Development budget and opportunities for training and personal development
Passionate colleagues in diverse, international teams; joint team events and company parties




At De Gruyter Brill, we are dedicated to diversity, equal opportunity, and building an inclusive culture where everyone belongs. We believe in individual potential, so please apply even if you don’t meet every requirement—passion and a willingness to learn matter as much as qualifications. We look forward to hearing from you!

Title: Expert Data Analytics (m/f/d)
Description:
Beschreibung

Bei Appsfactory, Deutschlands führender Agentur für Digitale Transformation, haben wir uns zum Ziel gesetzt, maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen für Kund:innen aus verschiedenen Bereichen wie Gesundheit, Medien, öffentlicher Sektor, u.v.m. zu entwickeln - auch im Bereich Artificial Intelligence, beispielsweise Chatbots und Voicebots, Recommendation, Sentiment-Analyse, Content Creation und Aufbau von Knowledge Datenbanken.

Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für Tracking & Analytics hast und sicher im Umgang mit Datenstrukturen sowie SQL bist, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir bieten dir ein inspirierendes Umfeld, in dem du das Thema Data Intelligence in der Appsfactory maßgeblich vorantreiben kannst.

Wir suchen keine:n reine:n Data Scientist:in oder theoretische:n Researcher:in, sondern eine starke, beratungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die Lust hat, ganzheitliche Tracking-Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen von der ersten Technologieentscheidung über das Event-Konzept bis hin zum fertigen Dashboard umzusetzen. Du schließt die Lücke zwischen reiner Entwicklung und strategischer Beratung und stellst sicher, dass unsere Projekte nicht nur technisch funktionieren, sondern echten datengetriebenen Mehrwert liefern.

Deine Aufgaben


Du bist zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in für Tracking & Analytics und berätst unsere Kund:innen sowie internen Teams bei der Auswahl der passenden Tracking-Infrastruktur (z. B. Google Analytics vs. Matomo vs. Piano)
Du entscheidest, wie wir Tools optimal aufsetzen, welche Features wir „out of the box“ nutzen können und wo individuelle Analyse-Lösungen (Custom Tracking) notwendig sind
Du entwickelst smarte Tracking-Konzepte, definierst Eventstrukturen sowie Parameter und wählst die passenden KPIs aus
Du begleitest die Entwicklung bei der technischen Umsetzung und stellst als Quality Gate gemeinsam mit der QA eine exzellente Datenqualität sicher
Du pflegst und erweiterst bestehende Tracking-Setups und erstellst automatisierte Queries sowie Data Blends (z. B. in BigQuery / SQL)
Du analysierst quantitative Daten und verwandelst sie in visuell ansprechende Dashboards (z. B. in Looker), die klare Handlungsempfehlungen liefern
Du förderst datengetriebenes Arbeiten innerhalb der Appsfactory und begeisterst Kund:innen sowie interne Teams für das Potenzial valider Daten


Dein Profil


Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium mit einem Schwerpunkt auf quantitativer Datenanalyse (Informatik, Naturwissenschaften, Data Science o. Ä.)
Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Web / App Analytics sowie technisches Tracking-Know-how
Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Tracking-Tools (z. B. Google Analytics, Piano, Matomo) und kannst fundierte Empfehlungen für unterschiedliche Projektbedarfe aussprechen
Du beherrschst SQL für Abfragen in Data Warehouses (z. B. BigQuery) und hast idealerweise Grundkenntnisse in R oder Python
Du hast ein exzellentes Gespür für die grafische Aufbereitung von Daten (z. B. in Looker), kannst komplexe Datenmengen durchdringen und die "Story" hinter den Zahlen verständlich kommunizieren
Du trittst sicher vor Kund:innen auf und hast Freude daran, technisches Wissen in Business-Mehrwert zu übersetzen
Du liebst es, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, arbeitest strukturiert und hast einen hohen Anspruch an die Validität deiner Daten
Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mind. C1 Niveau
Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mind. B2 Niveau


Was wir dir bieten

Das erwartet dich


Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Projekte für viele Global Player
Ein umfassendes Onboarding-Programm mit Einblick in alle Abteilungen
Leistungsstarkes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
Multikulturelle Teams, in denen gegenseitiger Respekt eine Selbstverständlichkeit ist


So arbeitest du


Flexible Arbeitszeiten dank Kernarbeitszeiten von 09:30 bis 15:00 Uhr

Title: Senior Business Analyst, Content Analytics
Description:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Business Analyst within the Content Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as an analytical leader and trusted thought partner for our senior Content leadership team, as well as the primary analytics conduit for European Content teams. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving the analytical frameworks and reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization.

Working in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, you'll transform multi-source data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive long-term strategy. Your deep expertise in the Content business — spanning audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media — will allow you to proactively anticipate leadership questions and surface insights before they're asked. As a content data SME, you'll help drive data quality standards within your domain while making insights readily accessible through efficient, scalable, self-service solutions.

About You

You are an analytical leader who balances technical expertise with deep business acumen, particularly within the world of content. You excel at working cross-functionally, translating complex business challenges into robust analytical frameworks and long-term solutions. You're naturally curious, with a talent for looking beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions driving our Content business forward.

You thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with strong judgment while continuously raising the bar on data processes and analytical best practices. Your communication skills are exceptional — you distill complex analyses into compelling, influential narratives for both technical and executive audiences. You build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders that position your insights to meaningfully influence business strategy and decision-making across the organization.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will...


Proactively identify complex or ambiguous business problems and serve as a thought partner to senior Content leadership — anticipating questions, designing long-term analytics solutions, and developing analyses and visualizations that address emerging business needs before they're raised
Design and own end-to-end reporting processes that track KPIs, support business reviews, and enable self-serve data access — ensuring speed, reliability, and scalability; break down high-level metrics into constituent components and leading indicators that generate actionable insights and recommendations for MBR/QBR/HBR cycles
Develop concise, impactful narratives and visualizations — including MBR/QBR documents and 6-pagers — that communicate complex trends, root cause analyses, and strategic recommendations to executive audiences; automate the identification of key dimensions driving metric variance to enable faster, more consistent analysis
Apply deep content domain expertise — spanning production, distribution, and audience engagement — alongside awareness of micro and macro industry trends in books and digital media, to ensure analytics solutions are grounded in real business context
Serve as the analytics conduit for European Content teams, facilitating analyses and surfacing insights that connect regional performance to Global team strategy
Partner cross-functionally with data scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, product managers, and business leaders to align analytical solutions with strategic objectives; own the effective communication of metrics and analyses across your organization, and identify when to bring in technical partners to unlock new insights
Drive operational excellence and data governance by improving, streamlining, and/or eliminating excess processes; work with data owners to onboard new sources, guarantee data fidelity, and ensure consistency in metric definitions, documentation standards, and data quality
Mentor and develop peers within your organization, modeling analytical best practices in design, delivery, and long-term scalability; develop clear documentation that enables both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand and replicate reporting methodologies


About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications


Knowledge of advanced skills in Excel as well as any data visualization tools like Tableau or similar BI tools (familiarity with Tableau preferred)
Experience in a data driven/analytical role
Experience delivering complex, end-to-end analytics solutions independently in ambiguous spaces, with track record of generating recommendations that influenced organizational strategy
Content-related experience, ideally with audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media
Experience building relationships and running projects across multiple functions with diverse stakeholder groups


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting executive reporting and business reviews, including ownership of MBR/QBR narratives or equivalent documents
Demonstrated ability to drive operational excellence through process improvement, automation, or streamlining of data and business processes
Understanding of data governance principles and practices, including metric definition standardization and data quality management
Experience partnering with Business Intelligence Engineers or Data Scientists to apply advanced analytics techniques and unlock new data sources
Ability to work a flexible schedule that occasionally accommodates US time zone meeting requirements
Experience working with or supporting European markets or cross-regional teams

Title: Controller (d/m/w) mit Data‑Science‑ und Automatisierungs‑Expertise
Description:
Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Zahlen, betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und datenbasierte Lösungen? Du verbindest fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Know-how mit fortgeschrittenen Data-Science-Kompetenzen und möchtest moderne Technologien wie RPA und KI gezielt im Controlling einsetzen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams in Kirchheim bei München oder Berlin als Controller mit Data-Science- und Automatisierungs-Expertise (d/m/w).

Was gibt es zu tun?


Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von KPI-Dashboards und Ad-hoc-Reports
Analyse von Soll-Ist-Abweichungen sowie Ableitung und Nachverfolgung geeigneter Maßnahmen
Erstellung von Szenario-Analysen als Grundlage für Investitions- und Unternehmensentscheidungen
Mitwirkung an Preis- und Rabattmodellen sowie an der Entwicklung datenbasierter Preisstrategien
Anwendung statistischer Methoden und Machine-Learning-Modelle zur Prognose von Umsatz-, Kosten- und Preisentwicklungen
Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Predictive-Analytics-Lösungen, beispielsweise für Preisoptimierung oder Kunden-Churn
Aufbereitung und Analyse von Daten einschließlich Feature Engineering und Modellvalidierung
Konzeption und Umsetzung von RPA-Lösungen, beispielsweise mit Power Automate, zur Automatisierung wiederkehrender Controlling-Aufgaben
Entwicklung und Einsatz KI-gestützter Tools zur Unterstützung von Controlling- und Geschäftsprozessen
Sicherstellung der Datenqualität und -konsistenz zwischen ERP-System, Data Warehouse und Analyse-Tools
Identifikation von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Prozesse
Definition und Pflege von Datenstandards und Reporting-Richtlinien


Das bringst du mit


Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Controlling oder Finanzwesen
Praktische Erfahrung in Data Science, insbesondere mit Python oder R, SQL und statistischen Methoden
Kenntnisse im Umgang mit RPA-Tools und Interesse an der Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Machine-Learning-Modellen oder KI-basierten Automatisierungslösungen
Erfahrung mit Power BI sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse in MS Business Central bzw. Dynamics
Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten und Analysen verständlich aufzubereiten und daraus relevante Business Insights abzuleiten
Freude daran, datenbasierte Handlungsempfehlungen zu entwickeln und Entscheidungsträger mit fundierten Analysen zu unterstützen
Selbstsicheres Auftreten und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Austausch mit Fachabteilungen, IT und Management
Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Title: (Senior) Retail Media Insights Manager (m/w/d)
Description:
Über Redcare Pharmacy:

Als Europas führende Online-Apotheke wird Redcare Pharmacy von unseren engagierten Teams und modernster Innovation angetrieben. Wir streben danach ein angenehmes und kooperatives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen in dem sich jeder Mitarbeitende wohlfühlt und gerne zu unserer Vision “Until every human has their health” beiträgt. Wenn du eine Karriere mit Bedeutung suchst die mit deinen Werten übereinstimmt komm’ in unser Team und starte deine #Redcareer.

Über die Rolle:

Retail Media ist einer der am schnellsten wachsenden Bereiche bei Redcare Pharmacy. In dieser Rolle verbindest du Daten, Strategie und Storytelling, um unsere Sales Teams mit überzeugenden Insights für Herstellergespräche zu unterstützen und so direkten Einfluss auf kommerzielle Entscheidungen und Wachstum zu nehmen.

Als Teil eines internationalen Umfelds arbeitest du eng mit Sales-, Data- und Retail-Media-Expert:innen zusammen, entwickelst Reporting-Standards weiter und gestaltest datengetriebene Ansätze, die unseren Partnern echten Mehrwert bieten.

Stellenbeschreibung

Über deine Aufgaben:


Entwickle datenbasierte Insights, Markt- und Kategorieanalysen, die unsere Sales Teams bei strategischen Kundengesprächen und Workshops unterstützen.
Identifiziere Wachstums- und Upselling-Potenziale und leite daraus überzeugende Storylines und Handlungsempfehlungen für Hersteller ab.
Nutze Power BI, SQL und analytische Methoden, um Daten aufzubereiten, zu analysieren und für interne sowie externe Stakeholder verständlich zu interpretieren.
Arbeite eng mit internationalen Teams zusammen, um einheitliche Reporting-Standards und Best Practices im Bereich Retail Media Analytics voranzutreiben.
Gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenlandschaft aktiv mit, indem du Datenlücken identifizierst, Anforderungen definierst und gemeinsam mit dem zentralen Data Team priorisierst.


Qualifikationen

Über dich:


Du bringst sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2) mit.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Bereich Retail Media, E-Commerce oder datengetriebener Herstellerberatung.
Du besitzt Kenntnisse in Power BI, SQL sowie im Umgang mit datenbasierten Analysen.
Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung für Themen und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Stakeholder-Umfeld wohl.


Zusätzliche Informationen

Über deine Vorteile:

Um dich bestmöglich bei deinen individuellen Bedürfnissen zu unterstützen - sei es ein gesundes Leben zu führen, genügend Zeit für dich zu haben oder deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln - bieten wir eine breite Palette unterschiedlicher, standortspezifischer Benefits an:


Willkommen: Wir möchten, dass Du Dich vom ersten Tag an bei uns wohl fühlst. Deshalb begrüßen wir Dich mit unserem umfassenden Onboarding-Programm.
Homeoffice: Wenn Du für deine Arbeit nicht im Büro anwesend sein musst, können wir den Ort, von dem aus Du arbeitest, individuell gestalten - sogar für bis zu 20 Tage im Jahr irgendwo in der EU.
Entwicklung: Wachse! Wir unterstützen und fördern Deine individuelle Entwicklung durch verschiedene interne und externe Trainings.

Redcare Events: Wir fördern die Teambildung durch kreative Teamevents und feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam auf regelmäßig stattfindenden Partys.

Title: Senior Analyst — People & Workforce Intelligence (PWI) (d/f/m)
Description:
Personio's intelligent HR platform helps small and medium-sized organizations unlock the power of people by making complicated, time-consuming tasks simple and efficient. Our team of 1,500 Personios is building user-friendly products that delight our 15,000+ customers and their 1.5 million employees. Ready to make an impact from day one?

This role requires 2 days per week in the office and is based in Munich, Berlin or Dublin.

We empower Personio's decision-making with reliable data and strategic insights, while improving productivity through scalable infrastructure and automation. Be part of our transformative journey in HR technology, where your contributions shape how a leading people management platform understands its own workforce.

The Senior Analyst — PWI sits within the Data, Systems & AI department and partners closely with the People & Workplace Intelligence (PWI) function. This role combines two capabilities that are most powerful together: building the data foundations that make reliable analysis possible, and delivering the analysis itself. You own the infrastructure — writing dbt models from raw sources — and you own the insight: turning that data into clear recommendations for People leadership and partners.

You will work closely with PBPs and People leadership to connect people data sources — HRIS, absence and attendance systems, and others — and enable a self-serve analytics capability across the people domain.

What You'll Do

Data Foundations


Build and own dbt models end-to-end — from raw source ingestion through to staging, intermediate, and reporting layers — for the PWI domain, covering HRIS, headcount, absence, attendance, and adjacent people data sources.
Design and maintain scalable warehouse schemas in Snowflake, with clear data lineage, documentation, and version-controlled code (Git).
Define, document, and steward metric definitions and the semantic layer for people data, ensuring reliable KPI logic and metric consistency across the domain.
Implement data quality testing, monitoring, and alerting so that data issues are caught early and fixed proactively — not discovered by stakeholders.


Analytical Delivery


Deliver structured analysis on headcount, attrition, absence and attendance, org design, manager effectiveness, and compensation for PBPs and PWI leadership — forming clear hypotheses and producing decision-ready outputs, not just data dumps.
Build and maintain intuitive dashboards and reporting that allow stakeholders to self-serve on day-to-day questions without requiring analyst involvement.
Support MBR and QBR cycles with data storytelling: own the narrative, not just the numbers.
Partner with PBPs to diagnose root-cause data gaps, translate urgent business needs into analytical deliverables, and systematically improve the quality of people data over time.


Stakeholder Partnership


Act as the embedded analytical partner for the PWI function — showing up proactively, anticipating needs, and flagging risks before they escalate.
Present findings directly to People leadership with confident, prescriptive recommendations.
Enable PBPs to work more independently with data through documentation, self-serve tools, and direct coaching.


What You Need To Succeed

Must-haves


5+ years in analytics engineering, analytics, or a hybrid of both — you have done both the building and the analysis, not just one side.
Expert-level dbt: you have built models from raw source data, written tests, managed documentation, and understand lineage end-to-end — not just maintained existing models.
Strong SQL: complex queries, performance optimization, ability to work across a Snowflake-based data warehouse without hand-holding.
Analytical rigour: you structure ambiguous problems into hypotheses, identify the right metrics, and produce outputs that lead to decisions — not more questions.
Clear communicator: you translate data into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, present confidently, and write documentation that people actually use.
Experience with BI tooling (HEX, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) for building stakeholder-facing dashboards and reporting.
Comfortable with Git and version-controlled codebases as a daily practice.
High ownership: you diagnose root causes, drive work independently, and don't wait to be told what matters next.
AI Fluency: You have hands-on experience using AI to improve your workflow, and the sound judgment to know exactly when to rely on it and when to step in yourself.


Nice to have


Experience with people/HRIS data — Workday, BambooHR, or similar compensation and benefits tooling.
Python for analytical workflows and automation.
Exposure to AI/LLM tooling (Claude, GPT) for insight generation or workflow automation.


Why Personio

Personio is an equal opportunities employer, committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We embrace uniqueness and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. We are proud to have an inclusive workplace environment that will foster your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

At Personio, we value in-person collaboration while also offering flexibility. This role is office-based, with 3 days per week required in your contracted office location. The remaining days can be worked from home or in the office if you prefer. In addition, you’ll have 20 Flex Days per year to work remotely from other locations. Aside from our people, culture, and mission, check out some of the other benefits that make Personio a great place to work:


Receive a competitive reward package – reevaluated each year – that includes salary, benefits, and pre-IPO equity
Enjoy 28 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day after 2 and 4 years
Make an impact on the environment and society with 1 (fully paid) Impact Day
Receive generous family leave, child support, mental health support, and sabbatical opportunities
We enjoy gathering for meals, cultural initiatives, and events like local Summer Sessions and year-end celebrations. There's also healthy snacks, drinks, and a weekly catered lunch.

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d)
Description:
Intro

Zur CKM Group gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.

Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service gestalten wir den Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis für Menschen mit chronischen Beschwerden so einfach, niedrigschwellig, erschwinglich und sicher wie möglich, und wollen dabei unterstützen, Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu verbessern: https://greenmedical.health/de/cannabis

Du liebst es, aus Daten Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und möchtest mit deinen Analysen echten Mehrwert schaffen? Dann werde unser  Data Scientist (m/w/d) und unterstütze uns beim Aufbau intelligenter Datenprozesse und datengetriebener Entscheidungen!

Deine Mission bei uns


Datenaufbereitung & Datenmodellierung: Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Datenstrukturen und -flüssen in Zusammenarbeit mit der IT, mit dem Ziel konsistenter und nutzbarer Daten.
Analyse & Visualisierung: Entwicklung von KPIs, Durchführung fundierter Analysen sowie Übersetzung von Daten in klare, entscheidungsrelevante Visualisierungen (z. B. inGrafanaoder Power BI).
Strukturierung von Fragestellungen: Eigenständige Zerlegung komplexer, offener Anforderungen in konkrete Analysen, Datenmodelle und umsetzbare Schritte.
End-to-End Umsetzung: Verantwortung für die Umsetzung von Use Cases,von der initialen Fragestellung über Datenaufbereitung bis hin zu Dashboard und Interpretation.
Schnittstelle zu Fachbereichen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Bereichen wie Marketing undOperationszur Klärung, Priorisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Anforderungen.
Monitoring & Reporting: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards und Reports zur Überwachung von Datenqualität, Systemzuständen und operativen KPIs.

Title: Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) – Daten & Institutssteuerung
Description:
Die Sparkassen Rating und Risikosysteme (SR) ist der zentrale Dienstleister für Verfahren des Risikomanagements in der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe. Wir unterstützen die Institute mit Standardlösungen in den Bereichen der Risikomessung und -steuerung, der regulatorischen Banksteuerung sowie im Vertrieb mit Data-Analytics-Lösungen. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern bieten wir den Instituten, von der Konzeption der Verfahren, über deren Weiterentwicklung, IT-Umsetzung und Umsetzungsunterstützung, zentrale und standardisierte Lösungen an.


Business Analyst | Senior Business Analyst (m/w/d) – Daten & Institutssteuerung


ab sofort suchen wir im Fachbereich Institutssteuerung


Das erwartet Dich:
Aufbruch & Datenfokus: Bereich Institutssteuerung, Entwicklung neuer Systeme für Sparkassen; datengetriebene Lösungen zur Steuerung von Risiko und Ertrag, Arbeit mit Daten, Modellen und technischen Lösungen.
Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst Du früh eigene Themenpakete und entwickelst Dich hin zu eigenständigem Projektmanagement und sicherem Auftritt vor Kunden und Fachgremien.
Daten & Technik: Du analysierst große Datenmengen, entwickelst Auswertungen, Modelle und Prototypen (z. B. in SQL, Python, R), gestaltest Datenverarbeitungsstrecken und bereitest Ergebnisse für die Steuerung von Sparkassen auf.
Kundensicht & Technik verbinden: Du verstehst Prozesse und Bedarfe unserer Kunden und übersetzt sie in robuste, nachhaltige Daten- und IT-Konzepte – genau diese Brücke zwischen Fachlichkeit und Technik ist Kern Deiner Rolle.
Vielseitiger Arbeitsalltag: Mix aus Datenanalyse, Programmierung und Lösungsdesign, enger Austausch mit Fachbereichen und Anwender:innen; bankfachliches Vorwissen ist ein Plus, den fachlichen Kontext bauen wir mit Dir gemeinsam auf.

Das bringst Du mit:
Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem passenden Fach (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science) oder gleichwertige, praxisbasierte Kenntnisse.
Starke Datenanalyse-Skills, sehr gutes SQL, Programmierung in Python oder R; idealerweise Erfahrung mit gängigen Analyse- und Datenverarbeitungspaketen.
Erste praktische Datenerfahrung (Praktika, Werkstudium, Abschlussarbeit oder erste Berufserfahrung); Einstieg je nach Profil als Business Analyst oder Senior Business Analyst möglich.
Hohes Interesse an Kundendialog und daran, Anforderungen in klare, umsetzbare Daten- und Technikkonzepte zu übersetzen; Neugier und Lernbereitschaft, bankfachliche Erfahrung ist ein Plus.
Idealerweise Erfahrung im Projekt- und Anforderungsmanagement; auf Senior-Level fundierte Projekterfahrung und ggf. fachliche Anleitung von Kolleg:innen.
Starke Kommunikation, verbindliches Auftreten, Teamorientierung, pragmatische, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Lust auf kontinuierliche fachliche wie technische Weiterentwicklung.

Wir bieten Dir:
Eine unbefristete Tätigkeit in einem hoch versierten Arbeitsumfeld mit anspruchsvollen Aufgaben und einem attraktiven Vergütungspaket
30 Tage Urlaub + 2 Bankfeiertage und zusätzlichen Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen
Individuelle interne | externe Weiterbildung über unsere Akademie
Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeit und Option zum mobilen Arbeiten für eine echte Work-Life-Balance
Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
Zuzahlung zum Jobticket und Essensgutscheine
Dienstrad-Leasing (JobRad) als zusätzliches Mobilitätsangebot
Kostenfreie Girokontoführung inkl. Visa Card Gold bei der Berliner Sparkasse
Interne Veranstaltungen: Meet-Ups, Afterworks, Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeste
Zentraler und moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen und über den Dächern von Berlin
