Title: Staff Data Analyst, Paid Search
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

This specific position sits within our Growth Analytics team, whose objective is to scale marketing investment toward the most incremental and loyal customers. The role is focused on our paid search channel where black-box auction dynamics, branded vs non-branded incrementality, and elasticity modelling define the analytical problem. The successful candidate will also contribute to cross-channel measurement questions as they arise.

Your mission


Develop quantitative analysis and statistical models to evaluate and steer marketing decisions
Propose and defend strategic recommendations to our top marketing leads
Setup and analyse marketing experiments to drive strategic decision making
Explore large datasets, give meaning to data and numbers, identify opportunities and issues, and present findings to stakeholders
Maintain and improve our marketing measurement tools (Attribution, experimentation framework, Customer lifetime value…)
Serve as a liaison between the marketing teams and the data engineering team
Mentor others in the skills needed for this role
Use AI to accelerate end-to-end analysis — from framing the question to delivering the insight — while holding a high bar for methodological rigor and validation


Your toolkit


8+ years of relevant experience interpreting data in an analytics or data science role
Prior experience analysing paid search and/or SEO performance, using platforms such as Google Ads/Search.
Strong knowledge of SQL and Python for analysis (eg, pandas, scikit-learn, pyspark)
Hands-on experience with causal inference methods (e.g. geo experiments, difference-in-differences, synthetic controls) and/or elasticity modelling applied to marketing spend decisions.
Ability to understand user behavior and meaning behind the numbers and a track record in sharing insights to business stakeholders.
Experience identifying where AI could meaningfully improve your team's analytics workflows or tooling, not just your own output.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Databricks).
Desire to work in an international environment, with minimal direction and with highly engaged individuals
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English


How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary


Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
Monthly transportation and fitness budget
Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
Language reimbursement program
Health and wellness benefits


And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

Benefits: Freue Dich auf Bike-Leasing, Deutschlandticket sowie ein breit aufgestelltes Gesundheitsmanagement und weitere attraktive Zusatzleistungen.
Zukunft: Als Teil eines führenden Umweltdienstleisters gestaltest Du die Zukunft des Unternehmens aktiv mit. Umfangreiche Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsangebote unterstützen Dich dabei.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
Description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do


Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.
Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.
Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.
Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.
Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.
Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.
Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.
Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.
As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.


What You'll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.
4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.
Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.
A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.
Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.
Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.
A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.
Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).
A results-oriented, structured approach, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.
Proven project ownership and stakeholder management, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.


Nice To Have


Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.
Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.
Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.
GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).


What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.


Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!


Are you up for the challenge?

Title: Senior Business Analyst, Content Analytics
Description:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Business Analyst within the Content Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as an analytical leader and trusted thought partner for our senior Content leadership team, as well as the primary analytics conduit for European Content teams. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving the analytical frameworks and reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization.

Working in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, you'll transform multi-source data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive long-term strategy. Your deep expertise in the Content business — spanning audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media — will allow you to proactively anticipate leadership questions and surface insights before they're asked. As a content data SME, you'll help drive data quality standards within your domain while making insights readily accessible through efficient, scalable, self-service solutions.

About You

You are an analytical leader who balances technical expertise with deep business acumen, particularly within the world of content. You excel at working cross-functionally, translating complex business challenges into robust analytical frameworks and long-term solutions. You're naturally curious, with a talent for looking beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions driving our Content business forward.

You thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with strong judgment while continuously raising the bar on data processes and analytical best practices. Your communication skills are exceptional — you distill complex analyses into compelling, influential narratives for both technical and executive audiences. You build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders that position your insights to meaningfully influence business strategy and decision-making across the organization.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will...


Proactively identify complex or ambiguous business problems and serve as a thought partner to senior Content leadership — anticipating questions, designing long-term analytics solutions, and developing analyses and visualizations that address emerging business needs before they're raised
Design and own end-to-end reporting processes that track KPIs, support business reviews, and enable self-serve data access — ensuring speed, reliability, and scalability; break down high-level metrics into constituent components and leading indicators that generate actionable insights and recommendations for MBR/QBR/HBR cycles
Develop concise, impactful narratives and visualizations — including MBR/QBR documents and 6-pagers — that communicate complex trends, root cause analyses, and strategic recommendations to executive audiences; automate the identification of key dimensions driving metric variance to enable faster, more consistent analysis
Apply deep content domain expertise — spanning production, distribution, and audience engagement — alongside awareness of micro and macro industry trends in books and digital media, to ensure analytics solutions are grounded in real business context
Serve as the analytics conduit for European Content teams, facilitating analyses and surfacing insights that connect regional performance to Global team strategy
Partner cross-functionally with data scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, product managers, and business leaders to align analytical solutions with strategic objectives; own the effective communication of metrics and analyses across your organization, and identify when to bring in technical partners to unlock new insights
Drive operational excellence and data governance by improving, streamlining, and/or eliminating excess processes; work with data owners to onboard new sources, guarantee data fidelity, and ensure consistency in metric definitions, documentation standards, and data quality
Mentor and develop peers within your organization, modeling analytical best practices in design, delivery, and long-term scalability; develop clear documentation that enables both technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand and replicate reporting methodologies


About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications


Knowledge of advanced skills in Excel as well as any data visualization tools like Tableau or similar BI tools (familiarity with Tableau preferred)
Experience in a data driven/analytical role
Experience delivering complex, end-to-end analytics solutions independently in ambiguous spaces, with track record of generating recommendations that influenced organizational strategy
Content-related experience, ideally with audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media
Experience building relationships and running projects across multiple functions with diverse stakeholder groups


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting executive reporting and business reviews, including ownership of MBR/QBR narratives or equivalent documents
Demonstrated ability to drive operational excellence through process improvement, automation, or streamlining of data and business processes
Understanding of data governance principles and practices, including metric definition standardization and data quality management
Experience partnering with Business Intelligence Engineers or Data Scientists to apply advanced analytics techniques and unlock new data sources
Ability to work a flexible schedule that occasionally accommodates US time zone meeting requirements
Experience working with or supporting European markets or cross-regional teams

Description:
Die IGES GmbH ist auf gesundheitsökonomische und strategische Forschungs- und Beratungsdienstleistungen für internationale Arzneimittel- und Medizinproduktehersteller spezialisiert. Strategische Beratung von Market Access, HE&OR- und RWE-Abteilungen von führenden Pharmaunternehmen und Emerging Biotechs
Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären Projekten zum Marktzugang innovativer Arzneimittel mit Schwerpunkt auf Routinedatenanalysen (Krankenkassen- und weitere Versorgungsdatensätze)
Konzeption, Durchführung und Auswertung von Sekundärdatenanalysen (einschließlich Datenaufbereitung, Kohortendefinition und statistischen Analysen)

Mitarbeit an der Konzeption und Durchführung von Real-World-Evidence-Studien zur Untersuchung von Wirksamkeit und Sicherheit innovativer Arzneimittel in der Versorgungspraxis
Durchführung systematischer Literaturrecherchen und strukturierte Auswertung zur Ergänzung von Routinedatenbefunden
Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung interner Daten- und Methodenkompetenz, inkl. Vorbereitung für die Analysen von Gesundheitsdaten des FDZ Gesundheit
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung und Veröffentlichung Publikationen in z.B. wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften, Projektberichten und Ergebnispräsentationen




Ihre Qualifikation

Mindestens 1–2 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung mit Routinedatenanalysen (z. B. Krankenkassen- oder Registerdaten) im akademischen oder industriellen Umfeld
Erfahrung in der Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Dokumente, z. B. Studienprotokolle, Studienberichte oder Publikationen
Fundierte Kenntnisse epidemiologischer und statistischer Methoden sowie Grundkenntnisse in HTA-/Market-Access-Anforderungen wünschenswert
Gute Programmierkenntnisse in R oder Python; Kenntnisse in SQL von Vorteil
Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
Aufgeschlossene und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit Teamorientierung und Kundenfokus
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (wissenschaftliches Niveau)




Unser Angebot




Mitarbeit in abwechslungsreichen Projekten zu hochinnovativen Arzneimitteln an der Schnittstelle von Versorgungsforschung, Real-World Evidence und strategischer Beratung
Ein interdisziplinäres, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und guten Entwicklungsperspektiven
Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch anspruchsvolle Projektarbeit, viel Raum für eigene Ideen und individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen (z. B. Konferenzen)
Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung großer Routinedatensätze sammeln und frühzeitig Kompetenzen im Hinblick auf das FDZ Gesundheit aufbauen
Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung nach einer strukturierten Einarbeitung am Standort Berlin, inklusive Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

Title: Senior Sales Analyst (d/f/m) 1-year fixed-term contract
Description:
Job Description

In the Kleinanzeagen PRO Business Unit, we are scaling a high-growth SMB powerhouse. To achieve our ambitious growth targets, we are looking for a Senior Sales Analyst who will closely collaborate with PRO Sales leadership to bring our reporting and insight generation to the next level.

This role is designed for an independent decision-enabler who can challenge senior stakeholders while maintaining tight organization over their backlog and execution.

Job requirements

Your Profile


Experience: 4–5+ years of hands-on experience in mid-to-senior sales analytics roles, ideally within a marketplace (e.g., Amazon, eBay, Allegro), SaaS, or E-Commerce environment.
Core technical stack: Advanced SQL skills (code optimization) alongside proven hands-on experience with Salesforce data (must) and Databricks (must). Proficiency with Python, dbt, and CI/CD workflows is a strong plus.
Modern data architecture: Solid understanding of modern data flows (Salesforce -> Databricks -> dbt -> BI/Products) and analytics infrastructure. Ability to partner with Data Engineering and Platform teams to design scalable solutions.
Advanced & predictive analytics: Proven track record with advanced analytical techniques and statistical forecasting methods to convert complex datasets into predictive insights.
Visualization & reporting: Demonstrated experience with data visualization platforms; Tableau and Databricks Dashboards are a major plus.
Modern AI integration: Practical experience with AI tools in analytical workflows. Knowing when to automate versus when to perform deep manual analysis. Using agentic AI as a daily companion, with a proven track record of leveraging AI tooling (especially Claude) to execute both tedious administrative tasks and high-value deliverables efficiently.
Stakeholder management & ownership mindset: Decision-focused with a strong sense of end-to-end ownership, accountability, and backlog prioritization. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders and translating complex data for non-technical audiences.
Languages: Fluency in English is required; German is a strong advantage.


Job responsibilities

Your Role


Drive partner & professional sellers’ self-service analytics: Build a robust, scalable self-service reporting base for our professional sellers, as well as partners and associations.
Automate sales campaign reporting: Restructure campaign management and reporting, driving the shift toward automated, self-service channel data.
Lead data Integration & modeling: Ingest, model, and integrate third-party partner data streams directly into internal systems alongside data engineers, platform teams, and external Salesforce consultants.
Cross-functional collaboration & sales enablement: Act as a sparring partner for sales stakeholders by providing access to critical data, translating business requirements into scalable solutions, and leading cross-functional alignment.
Attribution & performance intelligence: Deliver revenue reconciliation, attribution models, market intelligence, and risk/opportunity recommendations to optimize sales performance.
Advanced analytics & future foundations: Lay the analytics foundations for forward-looking predictions and sales forecasting models to support strategic decision-making.
AI Integration: Integrate AI tools into your analytical workflows and help stakeholders do the same. Automate where it creates leverage; go deep where it matters.


Job benefits

At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive.

✨ Flexibility


Flexible working time (hybrid)
20 days “work from anywhere”
Paid additional parental leave for both parents
Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move)


❤️‍🩹 Wellbeing & Support


Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones
Annual company sports events

In the Kleinanzeagen PRO Business Unit, we are scaling a high-growth SMB powerhouse. To achieve our ambitious growth targets, we are looking for a Senior Sales Analyst who will closely collaborate with PRO Sales leadership to bring our reporting and insight generation to the next level.

This role is designed for an independent decision-enabler who can challenge senior stakeholders while maintaining tight organization over their backlog and execution.

Job requirements

Your Profile

  • Experience: 4–5+ years of hands-on experience in mid-to-senior sales analytics roles, ideally within a marketplace (e.g., Amazon, eBay, Allegro), SaaS, or E-Commerce environment.
  • Core technical stack: Advanced SQL skills (code optimization) alongside proven hands-on experience with Salesforce data (must) and Databricks (must). Proficiency with Python, dbt, and CI/CD workflows is a strong plus.

  • Modern AI integration: Practical experience with AI tools in analytical workflows. Knowing when to automate versus when to perform deep manual analysis. Using agentic AI as a daily companion, with a proven track record of leveraging AI tooling (especially Claude) to execute both tedious administrative tasks and high-value deliverables efficiently.
  • Stakeholder management & ownership mindset: Decision-focused with a strong sense of end-to-end ownership, accountability, and backlog prioritization. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders and translating complex data for non-technical audiences.

Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich M&A oder Corporate Finance, idealerweise auch Carve-out- oder komplexe Deal-Erfahrungen
Fundiertes Wissen in Accounting, Financial Modeling und Unternehmensbewertung
Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie R, Python, SQL sowie Erfahrung mit Business-Intelligence-Tools wie Power BI oder Qlik Sense
Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift, Kommunikationsstärke und Präsentationssicherheit


Deine Chance:


Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr

Title: Analytical Consultant, Digital First
Description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Munich, Germany; Berlin, Germany; Frankfurt am Main, Germany; Hamburg, Germany.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in media analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, consulting, or financial analysis.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience in translating data into business recommendations, creating and delivering appealing insights-based presentations or business cases with clear recommendations and aligned with customers objectives.
Experience in data analyses and visualization (Google Sheets and Slides), scripting (Google SQL), Dashboard development (Looker Studio), and leverage AI for analytics.
Advertising experience from either the advertiser, agency or other media owner side.
Ability to work closely with multiple stakeholder and cross-functional teams and influence key stakeholders (internally and externally) across all levels.
Ability to communicate in German fluently as this is a client facing role.


About The Job

Digital First, a sector within LCS, is home to a variety of customers, from Travel, Media and Entertainment and many digital natives like marketplaces, aggregators and comparison websites. Our mission is to drive the success and sustainable growth of our Digital First customers through innovation and a customer-first mindset.

As an Analytical Consultant (AC), you will work with top clients across various industries to optimize their online advertising strategies and help them achieve their business objectives. In your role, you will be the point of contact for large customers on anything around data in the form of analysis and strategic insights and you will be a core consultant to the sales teams helping them drive Google’s business growth. You will dive deep into data to uncover hidden opportunities and commercial insights for customers – analyze their market coverage, Google auction performance, optimize their profitability and branding investments and align their efforts with target audiences. You will share these insights as a trusted consultant with the customers as well as to sales teams internally.

To scale your impact, you will help identify solutions and analyses that other customers and teams would benefit from and work together with a cross-functional team to scale and automate them. You promote data fluency by sharing insightful dashboards to visualize key metrics that support their business objectives as well as educating clients and partners on Google's tools. You collaborate with cross-functional teams to act as a data analyst, strategic advisor, and consultant, ultimately driving commercial value for our clients.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €98000 - €100000 (EUR) + 40% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Conduct comprehensive bespoke analyses for our high-priority customers to uncover hidden opportunities to optimize their online advertising return on investment.
Consult with clients as a strategic consultant, clearly presenting data-driven insights and recommendations that align with their business goals.
Develop engaging narratives to deliver insights at scale for a wider customer base. Streamline processes by developing scalable templates, dashboards and scripts (together with gCare Insights).
Empower clients and partners with guidance on using Google's data tools via trainings and, democratize insights where needed through insightful dashboards and reports.
Work seamlessly with the teams and stakeholders to drive successful outcomes for clients (e.g., measurement and incrementality specialists).

Title: Senior Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data.

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll:


Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role (3+ years).
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy [[DELETE IF NOT RELEVANT]]

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€74.000—€100.100 EUR

Identifiziere Wachstums- und Upselling-Potenziale und leite daraus überzeugende Storylines und Handlungsempfehlungen für Hersteller ab.
Nutze Power BI, SQL und analytische Methoden, um Daten aufzubereiten, zu analysieren und für interne sowie externe Stakeholder verständlich zu interpretieren.
Arbeite eng mit internationalen Teams zusammen, um einheitliche Reporting-Standards und Best Practices im Bereich Retail Media Analytics voranzutreiben.
Gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenlandschaft aktiv mit, indem du Datenlücken identifizierst, Anforderungen definierst und gemeinsam mit dem zentralen Data Team priorisierst.


Qualifikationen

Du bringst sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2) mit.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Bereich Retail Media, E-Commerce oder datengetriebener Herstellerberatung.

Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung für Themen und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Stakeholder-Umfeld wohl.

Title: Analytical Consultant, Germany (Fixed-Term Contract)
Description:
This Fixed-Term Contract is effective immediately through March 2028 (18 months), with the position located in Germany.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Hamburg, Germany; Berlin, Germany; Frankfurt am Main, Germany; Munich, Germany.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in media analytics, consulting, data analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, or financial analysis.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience in translating data into business recommendations, creating and delivering appealing insights-based presentations or business cases with clear recommendations and aligned with customers objectives.
Experience in data analyses and visualization (Google Sheets and Slides), scripting (Google SQL), Dashboard development (Looker Studio), and leveraging AI for analytics.
Advertising experience from either the advertiser, agency or other media owner side.
Experience and ability to work closely with multiple stakeholder and cross-functional teams and influence key stakeholders (internally and externally) across all levels.
Ability to communicate in German fluently in order to support a client-facing role.


About The Job

Digital First, a sector within DE LCS, is home to a variety of customers, from Travel to Media and Entertainment and many digital players. Our mission is to drive the success and sustainable growth of our Digital First customers through innovation and a customer-first mindset.

The Insights and Analytics team within Digital First empowers our customers in achieving their business and marketing objectives by providing them with data-driven bases for decision-making. The team uses business acumen combined with storytelling skills to partner closely with a variety of internal and external stakeholders and support the transformation and shifts required to be successful in an ever-changing market environment. The team leverages Google's internal search data and external market data to uncover actionable insights, driving informed decision-making and fostering mutual growth for our customers and Google.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €98000 - €100000 (EUR) + 40% bonus target

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Conduct comprehensive bespoke analyses for our high-priority customers to uncover hidden opportunities to optimize their online advertising Return on Investment (ROI).
Consult with clients as a consultant, clearly presenting data-driven insights and recommendations that align with their business goals. Develop compelling insights and narratives to influence client.
Streamline processes and leverages AI to deliver insights at scale, efficiently.
Work seamlessly with teams and stakeholders to drive successful outcomes for clients (e.g., measurement specialists).
Empower internal stakeholders and clients by democratizing insights and by delivering training and guidance on interpreting insights from data.

Title: Google Ads Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Pflegia is one of Germany’s leading job platforms for nurses and healthcare professionals – with the mission to make job applications in healthcare as easy, transparent, and fair as possible.

From our modern office in the heart of Berlin, we’re building technology that improves the working world of nursing – with data, smart tools, and a true passion for impact. To accelerate our growth, we’re now looking for a Google Ads Analyst (f/m/d) who will take our campaigns to the next level – combining hands-on Google Ads expertise with strong analytical and SQL skills.

Tasks


Data-Driven Optimization: Analyze large datasets to identify patterns and actionable insights for performance improvements.
Testing & Experimentation: Design and run A/B tests (ads, bidding, audiences, landing pages) and implement learnings.
SQL & Analytics: Use SQL and BI tools for advanced analysis, ad-hoc reports, and deeper campaign insights.
Reporting & Insights: Build dashboards (e.g., Looker Studio, PowerBI) and deliver recommendations to Marketing and Management.
Market & Competitor Analysis: Monitor industry and competitor activity, translating insights into new growth opportunities.
Automation: Build and improve processes for automated reporting and campaign workflows to increase efficiency.


Requirements


Experience: Minimum of 3 years proven track record managing Google Ads campaigns with 300k+ EUR monthly budgets.
Analytical Mindset: Strong SQL skills and confidence working with relational databases and large datasets.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

This is an exciting opportunity to join our Data & Digital team as a Data Analyst, helping organisations turn data into meaningful insights that drive operational and strategic decision-making. You'll work with a range of stakeholders to understand business challenges, analyse complex data and deliver clear, actionable reporting that supports better outcomes across government, defence and highly regulated environments.

Whether your experience has been gained through business intelligence, reporting, analytics or data-focused delivery roles, you'll have the opportunity to develop your skills while working on impactful projects. If you're passionate about solving problems, uncovering insights and helping organisations make evidence-based decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

Day to Day


Gather, cleanse, validate and transform data from multiple internal and external sources to support reporting and analysis requirements
Create, develop and maintain reports, dashboards and visualisations using Power BI, Tableau or equivalent reporting tools
Apply analytical techniques to identify trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities for improvement.
Produce regular and ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support decision-making
Write efficient SQL queries to extract, manipulate, validate and analyse data from structured and semi-structured sources
Support the creation and maintenance of performance measures, KPIs and management information reporting
Document analytical methodologies, assumptions, calculations, definitions and data sources
Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Support data quality, governance and information management activities to ensure trusted and reliable reporting
Work collaboratively within agile, multidisciplinary delivery teams to deliver analytical outputs
Assist in identifying opportunities to improve reporting, processes and analytical capabilities
Communicate progress, risks and insights effectively with project teams, stakeholders and clients



What's In It For You


Work on meaningful data and analytics projects that support critical services and organisations across the UK
Develop expertise in data analysis, reporting, visualisation and business intelligence tools
Gain hands-on experience working with large and complex datasets across diverse client environments
Collaborate with experienced analysts, engineers, architects and business stakeholders
Build your technical capabilities across SQL, Power BI, Tableau and modern analytics practices
Access mentoring, knowledge sharing and professional development opportunities to support your career growth.
Contribute to data-driven solutions that deliver measurable business value and positive outcomes
Progress through clearly defined technical and professional development pathways as your experience grows



Benefits


A global network of expertise and opportunity
A culture founded on safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging
Flexible working arrangements that support your well-being and potential
Investment in your development through training, certifications and access to experienced mentors
Opportunities to contribute to communities of practice and internal data and analytics initiatives
Exposure to a variety of projects, sectors and analytical challenges
Competitive benefits package including pension, holiday allowance and additional perks
An inclusive environment where diverse perspectives, backgrounds and experiences are valued and encouraged



We welcome applications from candidates with varied backgrounds and experiences. If you don't meet every requirement listed but believe you can bring value to the role, we encourage you to apply.

#DigitalUKI

Here's what you'll need


Strong SQL skills, including joins, filtering, aggregation and data validation techniques.
Experience creating dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau or equivalent visualisation tools.
Advanced Excel skills for analysis, reporting and data manipulation.
Experience cleansing, reconciling and validating data from multiple sources.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, root causes and actionable insights.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience managing assigned tasks, documenting approaches and delivering to agreed deadlines.
Eligibility for SC Clearance



Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees.

With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs.

We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here.

Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles.

As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Your Mission

At Wise, we’ve got a clear mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. As a FinTech company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise needs bulletproof financials & insights into the growth of the company. We need timely, accurate and scalable financial data to make accurate business decisions inside the company.

Due to continued and rapid growth we’re on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Growth and Strategic Finance Team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

What You’ll Be Doing


Your principal responsibility will be to generate insights that lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers
Curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company
Depending on the project you’re working on, you’ll doing the following:
Helping us understand what’s driving our growth at a company or regional level
Understand our customer segments and cohorts, and how they contribute to our growth
Tie our customer acquisition and activity to marketing or product initiatives, to measure the realised financial return of those initiatives

Who You Are


3 years experience in similar roles
Mathematical or quantitative background
Strong SQL skills
Familiarity with Python/R
Strong analytical ability
Decent understanding of stats and statistical modelling
Data visualisation and storytelling ability
Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders
Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements


Desirable


DBT
Data modelling in a warehouse context
Understanding of testing and experimental design
Legally authorised to work in the UK


Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

Some Of Our Benefits

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

‍♀️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Title: BI Data Analyst
Description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About The Role

We are looking for a BI Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. You will take ownership of analytical projects end-to-end — from scoping business problems through to insight delivery — working closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Finance, Product, Commercial and Operations. You will build and maintain critical dashboards and reporting, surface trends and anomalies in business performance, and use data storytelling to drive measurable business outcomes. You will be expected to leverage AI tools strategically throughout your workflow — from LLM-assisted query generation and analysis summarisation to code review — accelerating delivery while maintaining rigorous standards. You will also provide critical support as the human-in-the-loop to ensure accuracy and repeatability of data analysis in other functions, empowering all our teams to make full use of AI-driven data self-serve

What Will You Do


Take business problems and independently structure them into well-defined analytical tasks
Own KPI monitoring and reporting for embedded stakeholder teams, ensuring data accuracy to build quality and confidence in your outputs
Root cause and explain in detail data discrepancies, finding solutions to stakeholder problems
Build Looker dashboards and Hex notebooks to support deep-dive analysis and stakeholder self-serve
Write production-quality SQL and Python, following team coding standards and passing peer review. Additionally assist others to review AI generated outputs.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

So Energy was created in 2015 because we knew energy suppliers could be better. Since then, we’ve grown rapidly but sustainably, with 300,000 customers and over 450 Energists (what we call our people). But we’re not done! We’re on the road to a net-zero future, and thanks to our partnership with ESB, we’re well on the way. We’re customer-centric, tech-led, and passionate about sustainability.

We’re driven to do our best for our customers, for each other, and for our planet. That’s why we’ve built a workplace culture that’s supportive, empowering, inclusive, and full of opportunities to grow and make an impact.

At So Energy, we take pride in our values-driven culture. We live and breathe by our six core values that guide everything we do:


Clear
Honest
Ambitious
Inquisitive
Caring
Sustainable

Line manage 2 direct reports (mid/junior Analysts), working collaboratively with the Data Team Lead.
Utilize advanced SQL skills to extract, clean, and analyse complex datasets, providing meaningful insights.
Lead data-driven projects, from defining objectives and methodologies to presenting findings and recommendations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, develop analytical solutions, and drive data-driven decision-making.
Design and document curated Data Warehouse tables to be handed to our Data Engineering team for implementation.

Create clear and compelling data visualizations and reports to communicate insights to stakeholders at all levels.

Contribute as part of an agile team with sprint planning sessions and daily stand ups.
Communicate status, blockers, and progress in a clear and concise manner.


You’re a great match if:


You have a Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering) or equivalent work experience; Master's degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) as a Data Analyst or similar role with a strong focus on advanced SQL skills. Experience within the Energy Supply Industry will be favourable.
Data Warehouse design experience using industry methodologies will be highly favourable.
Demonstrated experience in delivering complex data projects, with a portfolio showcasing your work.
Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI)
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with large, messy datasets to extract valuable insights.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to drive projects from inception to completion.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities with a keen attention to detail.
A proactive and collaborative attitude, with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

Hybrid Working – Every team has its own SPARK Working Charter. Ask your Talent Partner for more details.

Educational Sponsorships – Supporting professional development through initiatives such as Code First Girls.


Pay & Reward


Up to 10% Performance Bonus – Based on both company and personal performance.
Annual Salary Reviews – Helping ensure we remain competitive in the market.
Real Living Wage Employer – Proud to be an accredited Real Living Wage employer.


Time Off That Matters


Your Birthday Off – Because birthdays should be celebrated.

We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.




We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.




But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Remote UK | Up to £90,000 - No sponsorship offered

A growing digital business is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join a high-performing analytics team. This is an opportunity to work across a variety of commercial and product-focused projects, helping stakeholders make better decisions through data while driving improvements in reporting and self-service analytics.

The Company

They are a fast-growing, data-driven organisation with a strong focus on innovation and customer experience. Analytics plays a central role in shaping business strategy, product development, and commercial decision-making. This role offers the chance to have visible impact across multiple teams while working with a modern data stack.

The Role

You will:

Deliver actionable insights to support business and product decisions.
Build and enhance dashboards, reporting, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Identify trends, opportunities, and risks through data analysis.
Support experimentation, customer analytics, and strategic projects across the business.

Your Skills & Experience

Strong commercial experience in data analytics.
Advanced SQL skills.
Experience building dashboards and BI solutions using tools such as Looker, Omni, or similar.
Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working with stakeholders and influencing decision-making through data.
Exposure to experimentation, analytics engineering, or Python is beneficial but not essential.
Gaming/betting experience is preferred

What They Offer

Salary up to £90,000.
Fully remote working within the UK.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Opportunity to work on high-impact analytics initiatives.
Clear progression opportunities within a growing analytics function.

How to Apply

Apply below or email me at madisonbarlow@harnham.com

Are you a Senior Data Analyst who enjoys solving complex problems, running experiments and turning data into decisions? • Build segmentation, performance metrics and analytical frameworks

• Strong SQL skills

• Experience with experimentation or A/B testing

• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

• Experience with segmentation and behavioural analysis

• Someone comfortable working autonomously and owning problems end-to-end

• Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Hybrid Working

Your work will drive evidence-based decision-making, enhance the effectiveness of our services and shaping the future of debt advice.

Job Description

Role Overview

The BI Analyst will report directly to Continuous Improvement Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for:


Analysing existing systems and operational procedures
Understanding the business needs and goals of the Debt Team and wider organisation
Acquiring relevant data from within MaPS, from suppliers and from other external stakeholders
Cleaning, modelling, transforming and analysing data – understanding what it’s telling us and seeking to understand why
Reviewing data collection processes and assessing the quality of information stored
Building, maintaining and improving dashboards and reports, utilising tools such Microsoft Power BI as part of your role
Adhering to company policies and legal requirements in relation to data collection and security
Analysing data through a variety of statistical methods and models, and identifying challenges and opportunities
Presenting high quality, insight and analysis using engaging visuals – telling the story of the data and providing recommendations to colleagues including senior management
Tracking the progress of changes that are implemented through key performance indicators
