Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Drug Intelligence is a leading Canadian health care data market research company with a 30+ year history. We specialize in providing relevant information, data and insights about serious and complex diseases from various therapeutic areas to our clients in the pharmaceutical industry.




As a Data Analyst at Drug Intelligence, you will be joining a dynamic team in a working environment that embraces high quality standards, initiative, creativity, and collaboration.




Important: to be considered for this position, in addition to the LinkedIn application we require candidates to fill out a 2, step, 20-min survey. You will automatically receive a link (by email) to complete the cognitive assessment (step 2) within 5 min of submitting the Predictive Index Assessment (step 1).

Link to survey: https://assessment.predictiveindex.com/bo/5PWK/Drug-Intelligence-Data-Analyst




Salary: $70,000-75,000 annually

 

Key Position Responsibilities:

 

Execute routine data processing tasks, including validation and transformation of data collected in a variety of formats into an analysis-ready format for other teams.
Extract, structure, and analyze relevant information from specific data sets, both recurring and on an ad-hoc basis, to meet client needs.
Own maintenance of existing data processes using Python and T-SQL (Azure): updating code to support new data elements and new analyses as requirements evolve and creating new data processing scripts as new projects arise.
Build and maintain data collection forms across multiple platforms (e.g., JotForm, Qualtrics).
Translate business and project requirements into data requirements with autonomy.
Become a subject matter expert on existing processes and work closely with data engineers to identify and help design solutions for process improvement and automation.
Collaborate with team members and cross-functionally on multiple simultaneous projects.




Desired Experience:

 

1-2 years of experience working as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, or in a similar role, with strong foundational skills in Python and SQL.
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent preferred.
Strong knowledge of Python (including Pandas) and SQL, especially for data manipulation and analysis.
Strong understanding of data warehousing methodologies and ETL concepts.
Experience with Azure SQL Database or a similar cloud database platform.
Strong project management and time management skills.
Effective multidisciplinary problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with data collection forms (e.g., JotForm, Qualtrics) would be a plus.




What Will You Get Out of This Role?

 

Exposure to and experience with a variety of tools across the Azure cloud platform, Python, and data collection platforms such as JotForm and Qualtrics, with future exposure to data visualization tools as your knowledge and responsibility grows.
Direct ownership over projects based on your skill set, with growing responsibility and room to grow into a broader technical or subject-matter-expert role over time.
The ability to work directly with cross-functional team members, including leadership.
The chance to build strong analytical and problem-solving skills by troubleshooting real data processing issues that arise in day-to-day operations.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Position: Data Analyst
Reports to: Senior Lead, Data Management
Employment Type: Permanent, full-time
Salary: $70,200–$81,900 per annum ($36.00–$42.00 per hour based on 1,950 hours), plus vacation pay
Benefits: Comprehensive group benefits and private pension plan
Location: Hybrid (remote and on-site)
Work Environment: Inclusive, innovative, and growth-oriented culture at the forefront of laboratory referral testing.
Primary Focus:  Enterprise data operations and system integrations; SQL Server ETL and automation; reporting and analytics; data quality, security, and healthcare privacy.




The Opportunity:




We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support enterprise data operations, system integrations, and reporting across business, clinical, and laboratory teams. This hands-on role works with Microsoft SQL Server, business intelligence tools, automated data processes, and secure data transfers in a healthcare environment where data accuracy, reliability, and privacy are essential.




If you enjoy working with data, troubleshooting complex issues, and developing reliable solutions, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful operational impact in healthcare.




Key Areas of Responsibility:

Support daily data operations and ensure timely, accurate data delivery.
Perform data and order corrections in the Lab Information System (LIS) and related systems.
Monitor and audit data transfers and automated processes.
Write, optimize, and maintain SQL and T-SQL queries, procedures, and views.
Develop and maintain Power BI and SSRS reports and dashboards.
Investigate and resolve data quality, integration, reporting, and system issues.
Support ETL pipelines, scheduled data jobs, and automated processes.
Support KPI, operational, and management reporting.
Work with stakeholders to translate business and reporting requirements into reliable data solutions.
Maintain documentation for data processes, integrations, reporting logic, and system changes.
Ensure appropriate handling and protection of Personal Health Information (PHI).
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, automation, reporting, and operational efficiency.




Hands-on Experience Needed to Excel in This Role:

Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
SQL and T-SQL for data analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting.
SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).
Power BI, including datasets, data refresh, publishing, and access control.
Microsoft Excel and Power Query.
Data correction and troubleshooting within LIS and related systems.
Secure file transfers using SFTP and other file-based exchange methods.
Automation, monitoring, and recovery of scheduled data jobs.
SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and ETL processes is an asset.
Scripting or programming using PowerShell, Python, C#/.NET, or similar technologies is an asset.




Qualifications:




Education:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, or Health Informatics or an equivalent combination of education and hands-on experience.

Experience:

Proven experience supporting SQL Server data, reporting, and integration environments.
Strong SQL/T-SQL skills, including query optimization, performance tuning, and data validation.
Experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and datasets.
Experience with data integrations, ETL processes, and file-based data transfers.
Experience working with sensitive or confidential data in a regulated environment.
Familiarity with PHIPA and the handling of Personal Health Information (PHI).
Experience using a Laboratory Information System (LIS) is an asset.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a time-sensitive operational environment.

Key Competencies:

Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proactive approach to troubleshooting and issue resolution.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong documentation and organizational skills.
Ability to work across data, reporting, integration, and enterprise systems.
Strong commitment to data security, privacy, and confidentiality.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.




Why Join ICL?




﻿At In-Common Laboratories (ICL), we are dedicated to transforming lives through innovative healthcare and community support services.

Meaningful mission with real health sector impact.
Collaborative, supportive executive leadership.
Opportunities to make an immediate impact, optimize operations, and expand your expertise.




Selection Process Transparency

Artificial intelligence is not used to screen, assess, or select applicants.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.




Equal Opportunity & Accessibility

ICL is an equal opportunity employer. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request.

Description:
Entreprise: CAGC

Service: Sinistres

Catégories d’emplois: Poste permanent à temps plein

Modèle de travail: Hybride (2 jours au bureau)

Langue: Le bilinguisme français et anglais est un atout.

L’opportunité :

Nous sommes une coopérative canadienne de services financiers de premier plan engagée à promouvoir activement une société durable et résiliente, et notre équipe est essentielle au succès de cette stratégie. C’est pourquoi nos gens sont notre priorité. Nous offrons une culture d’entreprise vivante et des occasions de perfectionnement qui permettent à notre équipe d’exploiter tout son potentiel et de concrétiser notre raison d’être. Et le meilleur : vous travaillerez avec des personnes qui se soucient vraiment de vous, de notre clientèle et de nos collectivités.

Nous souhaitons apporter la tranquillité d’esprit chez nos clients et dans nos collectivités. Notre équipe nationale des sinistres, caractérisée par son savoir-faire et ses professionnels de confiance, sert les clients avec compassion. Nous agissons avec la plus grande intégrité envers nos clients, animés par le désir d’intervenir de la bonne façon et de constamment nous améliorer.

En qualité d’analyste de données, vous contribuez activement à diverses initiatives en analysant des données pour résoudre les problèmes de l’entreprise et en offrant des conseils judicieux Vous comprenez le domaine de l’assurance et vous faites en sorte que vos tâches contribuent à l’atteinte des objectifs de l’entreprise en appliquant les méthodes appropriées, en faisant preuve de pensée critique et en effectuant des analyses.

Comment vous créez un impact :


Effectuer des analyses descriptives et diagnostiques de manière autonome en utilisant les méthodes appropriées (p. ex. : analyse de régression, analyse de cohortes, analyse typologique, test A/B, analyse de facteurs).
Concevoir et développer des mesures visant à permettre l’analyse descriptive et diagnostique.
Concevoir une preuve de concept et de livrer une solution analytique prototype de manière guidée pour permettre une communication narrative efficace et une analyse descriptive ou diagnostique.
Travailler sur les requêtes de données (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extraire, nettoyer, rapprocher et préparer les données aux fins d’analyses.
Transmettre vos résultats à vos collègues et à votre gestionnaire de manière efficace et autonome.


Pour joindre notre équipe :


Vous possédez de trois à cinq années d’expérience en intelligence d’affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
Vous détenez un diplôme universitaire en intelligence d’affaires, en informatique, en actuariat, en mathématiques ou en statistique, ou une expérience technique équivalente.
Les certifications ACAS ou FCAS constituent un atout.
Vous avez de l’expérience en résolution de problèmes standard en analysant les solutions possibles au moyen de votre expérience, de votre jugement et du statu quo précédent et complexe.
Vous avez une bonne connaissance et une compréhension de l’analyse des données, de la programmation, des techniques de modélisation, des entrepôts de données, de la gestion des données, de la recherche, de l’architecture et de la conception.
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est requis : Sql, Python, R, Microsoft fabric
Posséder de l’expérience avec les technologies suivantes est un atout : Service now, Jira, Databricks
La personne qui occupe ce poste travaille principalement avec des groupes non francophones et avec des équipes à l’extérieur du Québec. La maîtrise de l’anglais est donc obligatoire. Les tâches essentielles qui nécessitent la connaissance d’une autre langue que le français ne peuvent être réattribuées à d’autres membres de l’équipe. 


Comment vous brillez :


Vous stimulez le changement et l’amélioration continue en vue de dépasser les attentes de la clientèle.
Vous faites appel à votre esprit critique afin de cerner les problèmes et de proposer des solutions de façon proactive.
Vos solides compétences en communication vous permettent de transmettre clairement les messages.
Vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe et vous partagez vos connaissances afin de soutenir vos pairs.


Ce que vous devez savoir :


Si votre candidature est retenue, nous procéderons à la vérification de votre solvabilité et de vos antécédents judiciaires comme condition d’embauche.


Comment vous en bénéficiez :


Occasions de formation et de perfectionnement vous permettant de bâtir votre carrière.
Horaire de travail flexible et congés rémunérés pour subvenir à vos besoins et à ceux de votre famille.
Approche globale à l’égard de votre bien-être, programmes de santé physique et mentale et culture solidaire en milieu de travail.
Journées de bénévolat rémunérées pour redonner à votre collectivité.
En plus de nos salaires concurrentiels et de nos programmes incitatifs, les employées et employés admissibles bénéficient également d’un programme de rémunération globale complet, y compris des régimes d’épargne-retraite collectifs et une assurance collective (p. ex., assurance soins médicaux, mieux-être, soins dentaires, invalidité et vie), du soutien en santé mentale et un programme d’aide aux employés et employées.

Échelle salariale prévue de : CAD $60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

Le salaire du candidat retenu sera déterminé à la discrétion de Co-operators et variera selon plusieurs critères, notamment les conditions du marché local, la situation géographique et des facteurs liés à l'emploi tels que les connaissances, les compétences, les qualifications, l'expérience et la formation.

Join us and be part of the play!

Zynga Poker is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behaviour to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.

Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 4 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.

Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies

Title: Senior Insights Analyst
Description:
Senior Insights Analyst




About Us

At TTC, we are Enriching lives by connecting people and places.

For over 100 years, we’ve been bringing the world closer together by crafting journeys that create lasting memories, lifelong friendships and meaningful cultural connections. Across more than 70 countries and our award-winning brands, we design and deliver travel experiences that go beyond sightseeing - they change perspectives.

Behind every unforgettable journey is a passionate team making it happen. That’s where you come in.




OUR VALUES

Everything we do is guided by our five shared commitments:

Value Every Voice - We put people first.
Act with Integrity - We do what’s right.
Explore Beyond Boundaries - We’re driven by curiosity.
Own the Outcome - We take responsibility for our decisions.
Succeed Together - We’ve got each other’s backs.




Position Summary

The Senior Insights Analyst is responsible for supporting TTC's global contact centre reporting, analytics, and operational insight capabilities across sales, service, workforce, and omnichannel performance.This role combines technical expertise with business-facing analytical support, partnering closely with operational leadership and key stakeholders to deliver scalable reporting solutions, actionable insights, and data-driven decision support.

The successful candidate will possess strong experience working with Snowflake, SQL, Power BI, and large operational datasets, while demonstrating the ability to communicate meaningful business insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience supporting contact centre or customer operations environments is highly valued, along with the ability to adapt to evolving business priorities and support continuous improvement initiatives.




Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Business Insights

Analyze global contact centre performance across sales, service, customer experience, productivity, and operational KPIs.
Deliver actionable insights through dashboards, executive reporting, and performance reviews.
Support forecasting, incentive reporting, benchmarking, and strategic decision-making.
Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and key performance drivers across regions and teams.

Technical Development & Data Management

Develop and maintain SQL queries, datasets, and reporting solutions within Snowflake and Power BI.
Manage and integrate data from contact centre, CRM, workforce, and sales platforms.
Support reporting automation, dashboard modernization, and analytical initiatives.
Ensure data quality, KPI consistency, and reporting governance standards are maintained.

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Partner with operational, commercial, and transformation stakeholders to align reporting with business priorities.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
Present reporting outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Serve as a trusted resource for KPI definitions, reporting methodology, and operational analytics.

Process Improvement & Transformation

Drive improvements in reporting efficiency, automation, and operational visibility.
Support transformation initiatives, including CCaaS, AI, and reporting modernization programs.
Expand customer-centric and omnichannel analytics capabilities.
Contribute to scalable reporting governance, best practices, and future-state analytics architecture.




About You

Essential Skills

3–5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, or contact centre analytics environments.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, and Power BI.
Experience developing dashboards, reporting solutions, and business intelligence datasets.
Strong understanding of operational KPIs, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement.
Ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
Experience working with CRM, contact centre, workforce management, or sales platforms.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable skills

Experience working within contact centre, customer operations, or sales environments.
Experience with Genesys, Salesforce, or similar customer engagement platforms.
Experience supporting reporting modernization, automation, or transformation initiatives.
Exposure to omnichannel reporting, customer journey analytics, or AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Experience working within global or multi-regional organizations.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Borrowell:

At Borrowell, we're on a mission to help Canadians feel confident about their money. We empower individuals to take control of their financial futures by providing the tools and insights needed to understand, build, and use their credit effectively.

1 in 10 Canadians use Borrowell for comprehensive credit monitoring and personalized insights. Our innovative services, including Credit Builder and rent reporting, help consumers build credit so they can unlock access to a wider range of financial products at more competitive rates. Additionally, we offer personalized financial product recommendations from Canada's most trusted providers based on each member's credit profile and financial goals.

Our team is diverse, inclusive, and driven by a shared passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of Canadians. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of collaboration, humility, and innovation. If you're looking to join a company that's transforming the financial landscape and empowering Canadians to achieve their financial aspirations, we invite you to explore career opportunities at Borrowell. Together, we can help Canadians feel confident about money.

About this role:

As a Data Analyst you will be a key member of Borrowell's Data Analytics Team. Your role will be pivotal in informing new marketing and product initiatives and powering the recommendations we personalize to each of our 3+ million members.

You'll provide a window into business performance and help to make recommendations on what we build next. You can expect to be responsible for creating and managing insights, experimentations, forecasting, and reporting for various business partners at Borrowell. You'll monitor existing key performance indicators, explore new areas of data to drive business growth and product development, and make company data accessible, insightful and actionable to the different business divisions.

This role specifically focuses on being a data thought partner to a designated Product Manager and related cross-functional Product pod (in-house folks in engineering, devops, QA, mobile, and more).

Key Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Infrastructure: Build, maintain, and optimize data models daily using SQL and dbt to ensure a robust, high-quality data infrastructure
Reporting & Forecasting: Deliver business reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights to guide business decisions, leveraging Looker (or similar BI tools)
End-to-End Experimentation: Design, analyze, and validate statistical experiments to support product and business initiatives
Data Proficiency: Write clean, efficient SQL queries using joins, aggregates, subqueries, and window functions to query and structure complex datasets
Stakeholder Communication: Partner cross-functionally to translate complex analytics into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences


Requirements

Nice to Have


Undergraduate (or higher) degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Science, Eng, or Social Sciences).
Basic knowledge of Python (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn) or R (tidyverse: dplyr, data.table, ggplot2...etc.)
Proven experience interpreting data and translating analytical results into impactful business strategies


Benefits


The Opportunity - join and have a major impact at a growing company that is helping Canadians feel confident about money
Comprehensive Health Benefits - medical, dental, vision, and paramedical health benefits for you and your family, with extra yearly coverage for psychotherapists and massage therapists
Additional Health Benefits - virtual benefit offering that allows you to connect 24/7 with nurses, doctors and mental health professionals
Maternity & Parental Leave Top-up - available to new parents
WFH Reimbursement - we ship you gear like a laptop, mouse, keyboard, and you can reimburse additional items to make your workplace better for you
Employee Development Benefit - annual reimbursements on payments to help your learning
Givewell Benefit - 1 paid volunteer day a year to give back to the community
Flexibility - flexible working hours and a flexible vacation policy


We are remote-first across Canada with an office in Toronto. This role requires you to attend in-person meetings and team-building events. While this role is remote, we are currently only able to hire candidates physically located in Ontario, BC, or Alberta.

At Borrowell, one of our core values and firm beliefs is that diversity makes us better. If you're unsure about your qualifications for this position we'd still encourage you to apply. We're looking for candidates who have experience but know that not everyone's had a chance to demonstrate what they can do. What's most important is that you have a growth mindset and care about helping people with their finances - an area in their lives that causes a lot of stress.

Please note that due to the sensitive nature of the work we do, clearing a credit and criminal record check is a condition of employment.

By submitting your application, you consent to Borrowell's use and processing of your personal information in connection with your job application at Borrowell and its recruitment processes.

Borrowell encourages applications from candidates with differing abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodation at any stage in the selection process.

This posting represents a current and active vacancy within our organization.

The budgeted annual salary range for this role is $75,000 - $125,000 CAD. Starting pay is determined by the candidate's relevant experience and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for Borrowell's full benefits package.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
Responsibilities

Position Summary:

As a Business Data Analyst, you will play a key role in analyzing and interpreting data from multiple sources, leverage data driven insights and automation solutions to guide strategic business decisions, streamline data workflows, and improve operational efficiency. This role requires strong technical skills, with a focus on data automation and process optimization. The ideal candidate possesses a strong analytical mindset and a strong problem-solving abilities, and can translate complex datasets into scalable, automated solutions and actionable business recommendations.

Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To

Data Automation, Analysis & Interpretation


Extract, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple data sources (JDE, KOMPASS, MBSYNC, Samsara, Paragon, among others) and data warehouse (Snowflake) to enable automated insights into business performance
Design and maintain automated workflows and data pipelines to reduce manual reporting and improve data accuracy. Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify patterns, trends, and relationships that inform business decisions
Assist in the design and deployment of analytics analysis to support process optimization and data insights
Perform root cause analysis of business challenges and recommend automated, data-driven solutions
Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost reductions, and efficiency gains using data and automation
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Reporting and Visualization


Design, develop, and maintain automated reports, dashboards, and visualizations
Collaborate with department heads to define and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) relevant to the company’s strategic goals
Translate business questions into data requirements and provide concise answers through self-service reporting and automation


Alternative Solutions (Machine Learning and AI Integration)


Work with the global team to identify opportunities for alternative solutions
Assist and support in the deployment of models that support operational decision-making
Evaluate results and continuously improve automated solutions to align with business objectives
Stay updated on emerging technologies and integrate modern automation techniques into business workflows


Data Quality & Governance


Maintain data integrity, ensure consistency across automated processes. Collaborate with data ingestion and IT teams to close data gaps and improve automation readiness
Ensure compliance with data privacy and internal governance standards
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Stakeholder Collaboration


Work closely with various business units (Operations & Transportation, Finance, Supply Chain, ROP, REX, Centralized Routing) to understand their business needs and develop tailored automation or reporting solutions. Present automated data insights and recommendations to senior leadership
Serve as a liaison between technical teams (data ingestion, engineering) and business stakeholders to align automation efforts with priorities


Project Management


Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects focused on
data automation, insight generation, and continuous improvement. Track project milestones and ensure timely delivery of automation initiatives
Other projects or duties as assigned


Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience:


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science or a related field. 2-4+ years of experience data automation and process optimization. Experience building Extract, Transform & Load (ETL) processes and managing data pipelines across multiple data sources and warehouses
Willingness to understand business operations and identify automation opportunities
Experience of scripting languages (like Python, R, SQL) and data process workflow automation tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics to non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to explore alternative solutions that support data automation and process optimization insight delivery
Collaborative mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement
This position must pass a post-offer background check


Preferred Skills And Experience


Master’s degree preferred

At the Reyes Family of Businesses, our Total Rewards Strategy prioritizes the holistic well-being of our employees. This position offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision coverage.

Physical Demands

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you

Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future

About Citylitics Inc.

Citylitics delivers predictive intelligence on where, how, and why infrastructure investments will occur across North America.

Infrastructure includes the foundational systems that shape our quality of life: water, transportation, transit, roads and highways, broadband, and power. It represents a multi-trillion-dollar market and a 20+ year megatrend in North America.

As a Data Analytics Associate, you will work with cross-functional teams to develop tools and data structures. Transform raw data into data structures in our data lake and Snowflake data warehouse that are leveraged for business decision making.

Experience building and maintaining data pipelines.
Ability to clearly explain technical terms to a non-technical audience.


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience in a Linux environment
Experience using Python
Experience using Git or other version control systems
Experience with AWS or other cloud service providers
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Previous intern experience

As you begin your career, you’ll define your own path by gaining exposure across the business, learning new skills, and having access to tools and mentorship to understand your potential.

We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.

26WD100492, Principal Data Analyst

Position Overview

Autodesk has invested in data-driven decision-making, optimizing our platform’s business, product, and cost. The next five years will transform how we work, with a surge in data volume and scaling of AI/ML to provide even greater value to our customers. We are looking for a Principal Data Analyst to serve as a senior individual contributor and trusted thought partner to Product, Engineering, Strategy, Research, and business leaders. You will define how success is measured, uncover high-value opportunities, lead rigorous experimentation, and build trusted analytical products and AI assisted workflows that turn complex data into better decisions at scale.

This role combines deep product analytics judgment, strong SQL/Python capability, software engineering discipline, and practical fluency with modern AI tools. You will operate comfortably in ambiguity, influence product direction, and create reusable systems that increase the leverage of teams across the organization.

If you are excited about empowering teams and influencing the organization with insights that drive success, this is the role for you!

Responsibilities


Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams to identify, define, and address business problems and opportunities through data analysis
Use your analytical skills to derive actionable insights from large and complex datasets and communicate findings in a clear and concise manner to technical and non-technical audiences
Define product measurement across north-star metrics, KPI/OKR frameworks, metric trees, instrumentation, guardrails, and launch measurement for platform initiatives
Use AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate SQL/Python development, automate repeatable analytical work, prototype lightweight data applications or assistants, and create reusable workflows with appropriate validation, provenance, and human review
Create clear and impactful data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Looker, or similar, to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization
Build and evolve canonical datasets, semantic models, metric definitions, dashboards, and self-service experiences that can be reliably consumed by both people and AI systems
Proactively mine for data drive insights to support PSET's platform outcomes, focusing on performance, user engagement, and overall business impact
Partner with Data Engineering on data quality, lineage, observability, and scalable pipelines; use version control, testing, code review, and reproducible development practices for high-value analytical assets
Communicate complex findings as concise decisions and trade-offs for technical and executive audiences; mentor analysts and cross-functional partners on problem framing, experimentation, AI-assisted analytics, and data storytelling


Minimum Qualifications


8+ years of experience in large data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline. Demonstrated principal/staff level scope: independently shaping ambiguous problems, influencing product roadmaps, and driving decisions across multiple teams
Hands on experience using AI assisted development and analysis tools (Claude Code, Cursor etc.) to accelerate coding, automate workflows, prototype tools, or extend beyond traditional analyst workflows
Strong skills in data querying and manipulation with SQL, and proficiency in programming languages like Python or R for data analysis and modeling. Experience with data warehouse ELT tools (Airflow, dbt, Snowflake)
Experience with semantic layers, governed metric definitions, and BI/visualization tools such as Looker or Power BI, with a track record of enabling trustworthy self-service analytics
Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to work independently on complex datasets and derive actionable insights
Knowledge of statistical techniques and modeling methodologies to drive in-depth data insights and support predictive analytics
Strong ability to communicate complex data insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner
Effective team player with a strong ability to work across functions, engage with diverse stakeholders, and provide data-driven support for strategic initiatives


Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience working in a SaaS company or a platform engineering organization is preferred
Familiarity with Autodesk’s product portfolio and its applications in various industries is an advantage
Experience analyzing AI/ML or agentic products, including evaluation frameworks and quality, task success, latency, reliability, or cost trade-offs
Experience building lightweight internal data products, analytical applications, or LLM enabled tools connected to governed enterprise data
Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline


26WD100492, Analyste principal des données

Aperçu du Poste

Autodesk s’est engagé dans une démarche de prise de décision fondée sur les données, visant à optimiser les activités, les produits et les coûts de notre plateforme. Les cinq prochaines années vont transformer notre façon de travailler, avec une explosion du volume de données et une généralisation de l’IA et du ML afin d’apporter encore plus de valeur à nos clients. Nous recherchons un analyste de données principal qui jouera le rôle de collaborateur senior et de partenaire de réflexion de confiance auprès des responsables des produits, de l’ingénierie, de la stratégie, de la recherche et des dirigeants de l’entreprise. Vous définirez les indicateurs de réussite, identifierez les opportunités à forte valeur ajoutée, mènerez des expérimentations rigoureuses et développerez des outils analytiques fiables ainsi que des flux de travail assistés par l’IA, capables de transformer des données complexes en meilleures décisions à grande échelle.

Ce poste allie un sens aigu de l’analyse produit, de solides compétences en SQL et Python, une rigueur en ingénierie logicielle et une maîtrise pratique des outils modernes d’IA. Vous serez à l’aise dans l’ambiguïté, influencerez l’orientation des produits et créerez des systèmes réutilisables qui renforceront l’efficacité des équipes à tous les niveaux de l’organisation.

Si vous êtes motivé(e) par l’idée de donner les moyens d’agir aux équipes et d’influencer l’organisation grâce à des informations qui favorisent la réussite, ce poste est fait pour vous !

Responsabilités


Collaborer avec les chefs de produit et les équipes transversales pour identifier, définir et traiter les problèmes et opportunités métier par le biais de l’analyse de données
Utiliser vos compétences analytiques pour tirer des enseignements exploitables à partir d’ensembles de données volumineux et complexes, et communiquer vos conclusions de manière claire et concise à un public technique et non technique
Définir les mesures de performance des produits à travers les indicateurs phares, les cadres KPI/OKR, les arborescences de métriques, l’instrumentation, les garde-fous et les mesures de lancement pour les initiatives de la plateforme
Utiliser des outils de codage et d’analyse basés sur l’IA pour accélérer le développement en SQL/Python, automatiser les tâches analytiques récurrentes, prototyper des applications ou des assistants de données légers, et créer des flux de travail réutilisables avec validation, traçabilité et révision humaine appropriées
Créer des visualisations de données claires et percutantes à l’aide d’outils tels que Power BI, Looker ou similaires, afin de communiquer les conclusions et les recommandations aux parties prenantes de toute l’organisation
Construire et faire évoluer des ensembles de données canoniques, des modèles sémantiques, des définitions de métriques, des tableaux de bord et des expériences en libre-service pouvant être exploités de manière fiable tant par les utilisateurs que par les systèmes d’IA
Exploiter de manière proactive les données pour en tirer des enseignements permettant de soutenir les résultats de la plateforme PSET, en mettant l’accent sur la performance, l’engagement des utilisateurs et l’impact global sur l’activité
Collaborer avec l’équipe d’ingénierie des données sur la qualité des données, la traçabilité, l’observabilité et les pipelines évolutifs ; utiliser le contrôle de version, les tests, la revue de code et des pratiques de développement reproductibles pour les actifs analytiques à forte valeur ajoutée
Communiquer des conclusions complexes sous forme de décisions concises et de compromis à l’intention d’un public technique et de direction ; encadrer les analystes et les partenaires interfonctionnels sur la formulation des problèmes, l’expérimentation, l’analyse assistée par l’IA et la mise en valeur des données


Qualifications Minimales


Au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans l’analyse de grandes quantités de données, la business intelligence ou un domaine connexe, de préférence dans un environnement technologique ou SaaS
Licence dans un domaine quantitatif tel que la science des données, les statistiques, les mathématiques ou une discipline connexe. Capacité avérée à agir au niveau d’un responsable ou d’un cadre : cerner de manière autonome des problèmes ambigus, influencer les feuilles de route des produits et piloter les décisions au sein de plusieurs équipes
Expérience pratique de l’utilisation d’outils de développement et d’analyse assistés par l’IA (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) pour accélérer le codage, automatiser les flux de travail, prototyper des outils ou aller au-delà des flux de travail traditionnels des analystes
Solides compétences en interrogation et manipulation de données avec SQL, et maîtrise de langages de programmation tels que Python ou R pour l’analyse et la modélisation des données. Expérience avec les outils ELT de data warehouse (Airflow, dbt, Snowflake)
Expérience avec les couches sémantiques, les définitions de métriques gouvernées et les outils de BI/visualisation tels que Looker ou Power BI, avec une expérience avérée dans la mise en place d’analyses en libre-service fiables

Work with senior leadership and other business leaders to identify opportunities for improvement;
Create dashboards and data strategies for internal teams and / or external stakeholders;
Collaborate with team members to collect and analyze data;

Structure large data sets to find usable information;
Work with a team of analysts and other associates to process information;
Create presentations and reports based on recommendations and findings.

Familiarity with applying AI-driven analytics tools (e.g. predictive analytics in Microsoft Fabric) an asset

Experience interfacing with customers and working in large enterprise, implementing complex solutions.
Experience in the aerospace and defense industry an asset

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience.

Your role at Clorox:

The Data & Analytics Analyst enables data-driven decision-making across the organization by transforming complex data into meaningful insights and performance reporting. KPI Reporting & Dashboarding (Power BI)


Design, build, and maintain KPI dashboards/scorecards in Power BI to support performance management routines and faster decision-making.
Produce recurring KPI reporting packs (e.g., service/case fill, inventory health/DOS, forecast-related views) with clear commentary on trends and drivers.
Partner with stakeholders to translate KPI needs into usable visuals, filters, and drill paths that align to how teams manage the business.


Transactional & Detailed Reporting (SAC/Fiori)


Use SAC and Fiori to access SAP transactional and detailed reporting needed for root-cause analysis and operational deep dives.
Cross-check transactional views (SAC/Fiori) versus aggregated dashboards (Power BI) to improve confidence in KPI interpretation and decisions


Data Quality, Governance & Documentation


Validate data accuracy and investigate discrepancies across reports; coordinate resolution with report owners/stewards and affected stakeholders.
Maintain and publish reporting documentation (definitions, intended use/purpose, sources, calculation logic, and ownership/stewardship), aligned to enterprise governance approaches.
Contribute to dashboard “link hygiene” and user guidance so that consumers can easily find the right source report and definitions for each KPI.


Problem Identification & Continuous Improvement


Identify performance risks/opportunities using variance, exceptions, and trend analysis; frame the “so what” and recommended actions for KPI owners.
Support continuous improvement by quantifying baseline, diagnosing drivers, and tracking impact through sustained KPI monitoring (e.g., case fill changes over time).

Years and Type of Experience:


2 - 3 years of experience in analytics and reporting, KPI performance management, and cross-functional problem-solving, preferably supporting supply chain, operations, or other business functions.
Experience working with operational/service and inventory metrics and producing recurring performance reporting packs.


Skills and Abilities:

Must-have


Hands-on experience building dashboards and reporting in Power BI (e.g., authoring in Desktop and publishing/sharing via the service).
Working knowledge of SAC and Fiori for SAP transactional and detailed reporting (or strong ability to learn quickly).
Strong analytical problem solving: ability to identify drivers, explain variance, and translate analysis into actions.
Documentation discipline: ability to write clear metric definitions, intended use, and calculation notes to improve shared understanding.
2+ years experience working in data or business analytics with a proven track record of validating AI assisted insights.
Handse-on exposure to modern BI or workspace tools featuring embedded o generative AI features (power BI copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise).


Nice-to-have


Familiarity with report governance/catalog practices (owners/stewards tracked centrally.
Continuous improvement methods (Lean/Six Sigma) applied to operations or supply chain analytics (optional, depending on your preference).
Exposure to Vista reporting change concepts and expectations (e.g., Fiori/SAC go-live and reporting evolution).

Transactional & Detailed Reporting (SAC/Fiori)

Years and Type of Experience:

Must-have

  • Hands-on experience building dashboards and reporting in Power BI (e.g., authoring in Desktop and publishing/sharing via the service).
  • Working knowledge of SAC and Fiori for SAP transactional and detailed reporting (or strong ability to learn quickly).

Nice-to-have

Title: Business Insights Analyst
Description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:




BCU Financial is seeking a motivated and analytical full-time Business Insights Analyst to join the Product, Sales & Marketing team. Reporting to the Manager, Product, Sales & Marketing, the role supports data-driven decision-making by analyzing member, product, sales, marketing, channel, and operational data. The analyst develops reports, dashboards, and performance insights that help leadership monitor results, identify trends, and measure organizational performance. 




Working primarily with Product, Sales & Marketing and collaborating with Finance, Operations, Technology, and Member Service teams, the Business Insights Analyst transforms data into actionable business intelligence that supports planning, performance management, member growth, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate combines strong analytical capability, attention to detail, business curiosity, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:




Business Analytics & Insights

Analyze member, product, channel, marketing, sales, and operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities. 
Perform routine, ad hoc, and exploratory analyses in support of business initiatives and operational priorities. 
Interpret findings and develop clear, actionable recommendations for management and business partners. 
Conduct root-cause analysis to investigate performance variances, emerging issues, and business challenges. 
Prepare analytical summaries, presentations, and briefing materials for management and senior leadership. 




Business Decision Support

Provide analysis and performance information to support management decisions, operational reviews, and strategic initiatives. 
Assist with business cases, forecasting exercises, budgeting activities, and project evaluations. 
Evaluate the performance and business impact of products, services, campaigns, programs, and process enhancements. 
Participate in cross-functional projects by contributing analytical expertise, measurement frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations. 




Member & Market Analysis

Conduct member segmentation, demographic, behavioural, and lifecycle analyses to support growth and engagement strategies. 
Monitor member acquisition, retention, product adoption, channel utilization, and service usage trends. 
Analyze member behaviours and product utilization to identify opportunities to strengthen member experience and relationships. 
Research competitor activity, financial services trends, and market developments to support planning. 
Prepare comparative analyses and benchmarking reports on market position, member trends, and product performance. 




Data Management & Quality

Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other business teams to ensure the availability and reliability of data sources.
Investigate data discrepancies and recommend corrective actions to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistency.
Maintain documentation of reporting methodologies, calculation logic, business definitions, and analytical processes.




Performance Reporting & Dashboard Development

Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, recurring reports, and business intelligence tools based on approved business requirements. 
Collaborate with business owners to define, track, and report on approved key performance indicators and operational metrics. 
Produce weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for management and leadership teams. 
Monitor performance against established targets and highlight significant trends, exceptions, and areas requiring attention. 
Automate and streamline reporting processes to improve efficiency, consistency, and data accessibility. 
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of reporting outputs and underlying data sources. 




Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

Partner with business teams to understand operational challenges, analytical needs, and reporting requirements. 
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Provide guidance to business users on interpreting reports, dashboards, performance metrics, and analytical findings. 
Assist users in understanding reporting tools and dashboard functionality. 
Encourage effective use of performance information and analytics across the organization. 




Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automation, and predictive analytics. 
Recommend enhancements to data visualization, KPI frameworks, and analytical methodologies. 
Remain current on business intelligence tools, analytics practices, financial services trends, and industry developments. 
Contribute to initiatives that strengthen organizational reporting and analytical capabilities. 




Success Measures

Accurate and timely reports, and analytical summaries.
Clear identification of trends, exceptions, and areas requiring management attention.
Improved visibility into member, product, sales, marketing, and operational performance.
Effective support for business planning, performance monitoring, and decision-making.
Strong collaboration with stakeholders and clear communication of findings.
Continued improvement in reporting consistency, data quality, and dashboard usability.




QUALIFICATIONS:




Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
Three or more years of experience in business analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or performance measurement. 
Experience analyzing business data and translating findings into practical recommendations. 
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI tracking tools. 
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and practical experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, attention-to-detail, and communication skills. 
Ability to present data and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
Experience working with business systems and information sources to extract, organize, validate, and analyze data. 




Preferred Assets

Experience in financial services, banking, credit unions, insurance, or another regulated industry. 
Experience supporting product, sales, marketing, member experience, or business performance initiatives. 
Experience with member or customer analysis, market research, forecasting, trend analysis, or business case development. 
Experience with CRM systems, business intelligence platforms, or enterprise reporting solutions. 
Experience with Power Query, data modelling, or DNA’s CRM BI tool. 
Knowledge of SQL, data warehousing concepts, or statistical analysis techniques.
Experience working in member-focused, community-based, or culturally diverse organizations.




COMPENSATION:




Salary Range: $68,000 - $82,000 annually




Compensation for this role will be determined based on experience and qualifications. BCU Financial also offers a competitive and comprehensive beneﬁts package.

Please note that while we thank all applicants for their interest in a career with BCU Financial, only those chosen for an interview will receive further communication.




BCU Financial Group is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. BCU Financial Group provides accommodation during the recruitment process upon request. Requests received relating to accommodation will be addressed conﬁdentially.




About BCU Financial:




BCU Financial is a member-owned ﬁnancial cooperative dedicated to improving the lives of its members and their community. As part of the growing Ontario-based BCU Financial Group, it provides Ukrainian-Canadians with diversiﬁed ﬁnancial services and products.




BCU Financial Group offers a compelling alternative to traditional banking through its various divisions. BCU Financial provides a no-fee personal chequing account, along with savings accounts, loans, mortgages, credit cards, and online banking to its members. The broader BCU Financial Group also encompasses BCU Wealth Management and BCU Insurance, serving clients with investment and insurance services respectively, and supports the community through BCU Foundation and its donors. BCU Financial, together with its BCU Wealth Management division, currently oversees $1.2 billion in assets.




Underscoring its commitment to building a strong community, BCU Financial Group provides generous sponsorship funding annually to a wide array of Ukrainian community-based projects and activities. The Credit Union and its member-supported charitable institution, BCU Foundation, provide sponsorship funding of over $1 million annually for community organizations, charity fundraisers, student scholarships, cultural events, and educational projects.

Job Title: Manager, Data Analytics

Data Analyst plays a critical role in enabling enterprise-wide data-driven decision-making by managing and advancing McKesson’s data assets. This position is responsible for identifying, capturing, analyzing, and organizing data to support strategic and operational objectives. The role ensures adherence to information governance standards and leverages advanced analytics to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that inform key business decisions. The analyst designs and maintains relational databases, creates dashboards and reports, and implements statistical models to guide decision-making. Collaborating with governance teams, data stewards, and business stakeholders, this position drives improvements in data quality, accessibility, and usability while influencing best practices across the organization.

Job Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do:


Manage and advance the data fabric to organize, integrate, and deliver enterprise data assets.
Design, create, and maintain relational databases and data systems, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Implement and apply statistical models to identify trends, patterns, and relationships that support decision-making.
Contribute to the management of central data stores and metadata, establishing and enforcing quality expectations.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, including automation and procedural enhancements for data entry and validation.
Develop and implement techniques for data collection, accuracy, and management, ensuring compliance with governance standards.
Accountable for data accessibility, profiling, and reporting of quality issues, driving remediation strategies.
Collaborate with data governance, stewards, and business systems to propose and implement solutions for data quality improvement.
Recommend analytics opportunities and best practices, influencing enterprise adoption of advanced analytics.
Ensure development of solutions that enable actionable insights, supporting strategic and operational decision-making.



What We’re Looking For: Minimum Requirements:


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced degree preferred.
Typically requires 7+ years of relevant professional experience advancing data programs, including quality management, integration pipelines, and cloud data warehousing for scalable analytics.



Critical Skills/Experience:


Advanced capability in data modeling and database design for complex analytical systems.
Proficiency in data quality management programs, including accuracy, completeness, and timeliness checks.
Advanced capability in cloud data warehousing and performance optimization for large-scale analytics.
Proficiency in metadata management and lineage documentation for compliance and governance.
Ability to implement advanced data integration pipelines and monitor data flow reliability.
Competence in Business Function Knowledge, Customer & Business Driven, Problem Solving, Building Relationships, Adaptability, Digital Acumen, and Creativity.
Clear written and verbal communication tailored to both business and technical audiences.



Technical Expertise:


Advanced experience leveraging Databricks, Snowflake, and SQL to develop scalable analytical datasets, models, and reporting solutions.
Strong proficiency with Power BI to deliver executive-ready dashboards, KPIs, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to partner closely with business stakeholders to frame problems, identify opportunities, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
Experience supporting commercial, pricing, customer, product, or portfolio analytics with an understanding of how insights drive business performance and decision-making.
Proven ability to work independently in ambiguous environments, balancing technical execution with strategic business consultation to deliver measurable outcomes.

You can demonstrate experience in Alteryx, Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft Excel macros, SAS, and Structured Query Language (SQL) to build, maintain, and improve reporting and self-serve data workflows. It's an asset if you hold a certification in Alteryx or Power Automate.

Responsibilities

Position Summary:

As a Business Data Analyst, you will play a key role in analyzing and interpreting data from multiple sources, leverage data driven insights and automation solutions to guide strategic business decisions, streamline data workflows, and improve operational efficiency. This role requires strong technical skills, with a focus on data automation and process optimization. The ideal candidate possesses a strong analytical mindset and a strong problem-solving abilities, and can translate complex datasets into scalable, automated solutions and actionable business recommendations.

Data Automation, Analysis & Interpretation


Extract, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple data sources (JDE, KOMPASS, MBSYNC, Samsara, Paragon, among others) and data warehouse (Snowflake) to enable automated insights into business performance
Design and maintain automated workflows and data pipelines to reduce manual reporting and improve data accuracy. Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify patterns, trends, and relationships that inform business decisions
Assist in the design and deployment of analytics analysis to support process optimization and data insights
Perform root cause analysis of business challenges and recommend automated, data-driven solutions
Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost reductions, and efficiency gains using data and automation
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Reporting and Visualization


Design, develop, and maintain automated reports, dashboards, and visualizations
Collaborate with department heads to define and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) relevant to the company’s strategic goals
Translate business questions into data requirements and provide concise answers through self-service reporting and automation


Alternative Solutions (Machine Learning and AI Integration)


Work with the global team to identify opportunities for alternative solutions
Assist and support in the deployment of models that support operational decision-making
Evaluate results and continuously improve automated solutions to align with business objectives
Stay updated on emerging technologies and integrate modern automation techniques into business workflows


Data Quality & Governance


Maintain data integrity, ensure consistency across automated processes. Collaborate with data ingestion and IT teams to close data gaps and improve automation readiness
Ensure compliance with data privacy and internal governance standards
Ensure data quality and accuracy through proper validation techniques, best practices and governance processes


Stakeholder Collaboration


Work closely with various business units (Operations & Transportation, Finance, Supply Chain, ROP, REX, Centralized Routing) to understand their business needs and develop tailored automation or reporting solutions. Present automated data insights and recommendations to senior leadership
Serve as a liaison between technical teams (data ingestion, engineering) and business stakeholders to align automation efforts with priorities


Project Management


Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects focused on
data automation, insight generation, and continuous improvement. Track project milestones and ensure timely delivery of automation initiatives
Other projects or duties as assigned

Experience of scripting languages (like Python, R, SQL) and data process workflow automation tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics to non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to explore alternative solutions that support data automation and process optimization insight delivery
Collaborative mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement
This position must pass a post-offer background check

Master’s degree preferred

Title: Data Analyst - Portfolio Performance & Optimization
Description:
Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization

EV Charging & Energy Infrastructure

Location: Toronto, ON — On-site

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Department: Product Innovation

Reports To: Director of Product & Innovation

Position Type: Individual Contributor

About ECAMION / Jule

eCAMION Inc., operating under the Jule brand, is a Toronto-based clean-technology company developing, deploying, and operating electric vehicle fast charging and energy storage infrastructure.

We design and manufacture our own charging and battery systems, develop the software that manages them, and operate our own charging network. Our work spans hardware, firmware, cloud software, site deployment, and long-term asset operations.

This integrated business creates an opportunity to connect technical performance with financial outcomes—and use those insights to improve the profitability of individual sites and the overall portfolio.

Learn more: www.julepower.com

Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization to evaluate and improve the operational and financial performance of Jule’s EV charging network.

You will use programming, financial analysis, and forecasting to turn raw data into reliable insights at the charger, site, and portfolio levels. You will investigate differences between forecast and actual performance, identify underlying causes, and help implement solutions that improve profitability.

A central responsibility is to develop, prototype, and refine workflows for routine performance and profitability reviews. Once these workflows are validated and sufficiently mature, you will automate them directly or coordinate their handoff to the teams responsible for ongoing operation and software implementation.

Working closely with Product Innovation, Finance, Network Operations, and Software Engineering, you will follow the full improvement cycle: measure performance, investigate gaps, implement changes, and verify results.

Key Responsibilities2. Programming, Data Preparation & Forecasting3. Performance Gap & Root-Cause Analysis4. Workflow Development, Prototyping & Automation5. Solution Development & Implementation


Portfolio Performance & Profitability Analysis
Conduct routine charger-, site-, and portfolio-level performance reviews, including monthly profit-and-loss analysis and comparisons against forecasts, budgets, and prior periods.
Develop and maintain consistent performance metrics covering utilization, availability, charging activity, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and site contribution margins.
Evaluate the drivers of site profitability, including customer demand, pricing, electricity costs, demand charges, equipment performance, maintenance, and site-related expenses.
Work with Finance to reconcile operational and financial information, validate cost assumptions, and apply consistent allocation methods across the portfolio.
Use SQL and Python to extract, clean, validate, and combine raw charging, diagnostic, energy, payment, and financial data into structured inputs for reports and models.
Develop reusable scripts and analytical tools that reduce manual work and improve the consistency, accuracy, and traceability of recurring analysis.
Build and maintain models to forecast charging demand, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and profitability, incorporating site characteristics and clearly documented assumptions.
Use visualizations, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis to illustrate expected outcomes, key uncertainties, and the financial implications of potential decisions.
Evaluate forecast accuracy against actual results and improve models as new data and operating experience become available.
Identify material differences between forecast and actual results, quantify their financial impact, and prioritize issues for investigation.
Distinguish data-quality problems and incorrect modeling assumptions from genuine changes in customer demand, equipment performance, operating conditions, or costs.
Develop and test hypotheses using detailed records, comparisons across sites and periods, and input from engineering, finance, and operations.
Validate likely causes with the relevant teams, clearly distinguishing confirmed findings from unresolved hypotheses or information gaps.
Design and prototype repeatable workflows for routine profitability checks, performance reviews, exception reporting, and follow-up analysis.
Define the data inputs, calculation methods, validation checks, reporting frequency, exception thresholds, and follow-up responsibilities required for each workflow.
Pilot workflows with intended users, gather feedback, and refine them for accuracy, reliability, usability, and efficiency before wider adoption.
Automate validated workflows using scripts and scheduled processes where appropriate, and collaborate with Software Engineering when production-system integration is required.
Prepare mature workflows for handoff through documented logic, test cases, operating instructions, exception-handling procedures, and clearly agreed ownership.
Monitor workflow performance after implementation and address changing business requirements, data sources, or recurring failures.
