Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Borrowell:

At Borrowell, we're on a mission to help Canadians feel confident about their money. We empower individuals to take control of their financial futures by providing the tools and insights needed to understand, build, and use their credit effectively.

1 in 10 Canadians use Borrowell for comprehensive credit monitoring and personalized insights. Our innovative services, including Credit Builder and rent reporting, help consumers build credit so they can unlock access to a wider range of financial products at more competitive rates. Additionally, we offer personalized financial product recommendations from Canada's most trusted providers based on each member's credit profile and financial goals.

Our team is diverse, inclusive, and driven by a shared passion for making a meaningful difference in the lives of Canadians. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of collaboration, humility, and innovation. If you're looking to join a company that's transforming the financial landscape and empowering Canadians to achieve their financial aspirations, we invite you to explore career opportunities at Borrowell. Together, we can help Canadians feel confident about money.

About this role:

As a Data Analyst you will be a key member of Borrowell's Data Analytics Team. Your role will be pivotal in informing new marketing and product initiatives and powering the recommendations we personalize to each of our 3+ million members.

You'll provide a window into business performance and help to make recommendations on what we build next. You can expect to be responsible for creating and managing insights, experimentations, forecasting, and reporting for various business partners at Borrowell. You'll monitor existing key performance indicators, explore new areas of data to drive business growth and product development, and make company data accessible, insightful and actionable to the different business divisions.

This role specifically focuses on being a data thought partner to a designated Product Manager and related cross-functional Product pod (in-house folks in engineering, devops, QA, mobile, and more).

Key Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Infrastructure: Build, maintain, and optimize data models daily using SQL and dbt to ensure a robust, high-quality data infrastructure
Reporting & Forecasting: Deliver business reporting, forecasting, and actionable insights to guide business decisions, leveraging Looker (or similar BI tools)
End-to-End Experimentation: Design, analyze, and validate statistical experiments to support product and business initiatives
Data Proficiency: Write clean, efficient SQL queries using joins, aggregates, subqueries, and window functions to query and structure complex datasets
Stakeholder Communication: Partner cross-functionally to translate complex analytics into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences


Requirements

Nice to Have


Undergraduate (or higher) degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Science, Eng, or Social Sciences).
Basic knowledge of Python (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn) or R (tidyverse: dplyr, data.table, ggplot2...etc.)
Proven experience interpreting data and translating analytical results into impactful business strategies


Benefits


The Opportunity - join and have a major impact at a growing company that is helping Canadians feel confident about money
Comprehensive Health Benefits - medical, dental, vision, and paramedical health benefits for you and your family, with extra yearly coverage for psychotherapists and massage therapists
Additional Health Benefits - virtual benefit offering that allows you to connect 24/7 with nurses, doctors and mental health professionals
Maternity & Parental Leave Top-up - available to new parents
WFH Reimbursement - we ship you gear like a laptop, mouse, keyboard, and you can reimburse additional items to make your workplace better for you
Employee Development Benefit - annual reimbursements on payments to help your learning
Givewell Benefit - 1 paid volunteer day a year to give back to the community
Flexibility - flexible working hours and a flexible vacation policy


We are remote-first across Canada with an office in Toronto. This role requires you to attend in-person meetings and team-building events. While this role is remote, we are currently only able to hire candidates physically located in Ontario, BC, or Alberta.

At Borrowell, one of our core values and firm beliefs is that diversity makes us better. If you're unsure about your qualifications for this position we'd still encourage you to apply. We're looking for candidates who have experience but know that not everyone's had a chance to demonstrate what they can do. What's most important is that you have a growth mindset and care about helping people with their finances - an area in their lives that causes a lot of stress.

Please note that due to the sensitive nature of the work we do, clearing a credit and criminal record check is a condition of employment.

By submitting your application, you consent to Borrowell's use and processing of your personal information in connection with your job application at Borrowell and its recruitment processes.

Borrowell encourages applications from candidates with differing abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodation at any stage in the selection process.

This posting represents a current and active vacancy within our organization.

The budgeted annual salary range for this role is $75,000 - $125,000 CAD. Starting pay is determined by the candidate's relevant experience and skills. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for Borrowell's full benefits package.

Ability to clearly explain technical terms to a non-technical audience.

Experience in a Linux environment
Experience using Python
Experience using Git or other version control systems
Experience with AWS or other cloud service providers
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Previous intern experience

We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

Title: Client Data Analyst II
Description:
Description

The Client Data Analyst II (analyst) position is responsible for partnering with our clients and teams to drive their initiatives with strategy, analytics and actionable insights, optimizing program measurement to drive field team success, and constantly engaging with the team to better understand where they can have the greatest impact. The analyst will leverage business and market relevant information to make data-driven decisions that allow Mosaic to achieve its sales and marketing objectives and quickly adapt tactics. The analyst will play a key role in evolving, leading, and growing the data-driven discipline within the program they support.

Responsibilities


Collect, inspect, cleanse, transform, model and diagram of complex data sets
Daily use of various business intelligence and analytical software tools
Interpret data, formulate reports, and make recommendations to the team
Lead the standardized measurement strategy for clients and team leaders
Design or collaborate on specific research methods such as questionnaires and market testing approaches (A/B testing, multi-variate, etc)
Use statistical analysis to understand the key drivers of the business and provide recommendations for optimization and go-to-market strategies
Compile data into professional reports that support both findings and recommendations quantitatively and qualitatively. Clearly articulate compelling business insights and actions with data and context
Remain fully informed on market trends, other parties’ research and implement best practices, with a willingness to evolve and grow skillset
Remain fully engaged in the program, understanding strategic vision, key performance indicators, and the day-to-day tactical activities
Regularly attend client and internal team meetings, and in-field ride alongs to stay in tune with program activities
Other assigned duties



Qualifications


Remain fully informed on latest marketing and data trends, practice, and process
3-5 years of related work experience
1-2 years of project management experience
Intermediate (advanced is ideal, not required) Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills including formulas, pivot tables, V-look-up
Intermediate statistical analysis skills
Experience with SPSS, Python, R, or other stats software
Intermediate PowerBI, Tableau, or Looker skills; other data visualization platform skills a plus
Ability to tell a relevant, powerful story with data that matters to clients
Ability to lead research activities including developing a plan, collecting data, and taking action
Ability to execute standard measurement strategies within a project
Strong analytical and critical thinking with the ability to disseminate insight from large datasets
Develop understanding of all areas phases of Mosaic business to find new opportunities for insights, measurement, and analytics
Proven ability to timely complete projects and achieve results in an ambiguous work environment

That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk Data Science team builds the data foundations, models, and measurement frameworks that power Stripe's risk and product decisions — from underwriting and reserves to merchant interventions and enablements. We're at an inflection point: as Stripe increasingly offers risk capabilities as a product to platforms and users, we need a data leader to shape how we build, measure, and evolve our risk data strategy.

Deep expertise in SQL; proficiency in Python
Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical approaches and communicate findings to executive stakeholders

Title: Senior Analyst, Wealth Growth & Analytics
Description:
Role Summary

The Senior Analyst, Wealth Growth & Analytics is responsible for supporting BMO Wealth Management's growth objectives through data-driven insights, performance reporting, lead generation analytics, and business intelligence solutions. This role partners closely with Wealth business leaders, sales teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to monitor key performance indicators, identify growth opportunities, and deliver actionable recommendations that drive client acquisition, client engagement, and revenue growth.

The successful candidate will manage end-to-end analytics processes supporting Wealth lead generation programs, performance measurement frameworks, sales effectiveness reporting, and strategic business initiatives. Leveraging advanced analytical techniques and data visualization tools, the Senior Analyst will transform complex data into meaningful insights that enable informed business decisions and contribute to measurable business outcomes.

This role requires strong business acumen, analytical expertise, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Accountabilities

Wealth Performance Reporting & KPI Management


Develop, maintain, and enhance reporting solutions that monitor Wealth business performance across client acquisition, sales activity, referrals, lead conversion, client growth, and revenue outcomes.
Produce recurring executive and management reporting packages, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery.
Track and analyze key business performance indicators and emerging trends to identify opportunities and business risks.
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews through insightful performance commentary and recommendations.
Develop automated dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI and other visualization tools.



Lead Generation & Program Analytics


Support end-to-end analytics for Wealth lead generation and sales enablement programs.
Measure program effectiveness across key stages including targeting, lead generation, sales activity, conversion, and revenue outcomes.
Identify opportunities to improve lead quality, sales effectiveness, and business results.
Partner with business stakeholders to establish success metrics and measurement frameworks for growth initiatives.
Evaluate program performance and provide recommendations to optimize future business strategies.



Business Insights & Strategic Analytics


Analyze complex client, sales, and business performance data to identify actionable insights and growth opportunities.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support executive decision making and strategic planning initiatives.
Translate analytical findings into clear business recommendations and practical actions.
Support business case development, opportunity sizing, and performance forecasting activities.
Leverage multiple internal and external data sources to provide a holistic view of business performance and client behavior.



Stakeholder Partnership & Delivery Excellence


Collaborate with Wealth business partners, sales leaders, marketing teams, technology teams, and data partners to understand business needs and translate requirements into analytical solutions.
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders at varying levels of the organization.
Ensure reporting and analytics solutions align with business priorities and governance standards.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through process automation, enhanced reporting, and analytical innovation.



Data Management & Technical Development


Develop, maintain, and automate datasets and analytical processes using SAS, SQL, and Python.
Integrate data from multiple sources to support campaign and lead analytics.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities.
Support implementation of new data sources, reporting capabilities, and automation opportunities.
Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and operational standards.
Maintain documentation and support sustainable analytical processes.



Qualifications


4+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, performance reporting, sales analytics, financial services analytics, or related field.
Experience supporting business growth, sales performance, lead generation, or client analytics initiatives.
Proven ability to translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Experience building dashboards, reports, and visualizations that support executive decision making.
Experience working with Salesforce and lead management processes.
Strong understanding of campaign measurement, client targeting, audience segmentation, and performance optimization.
Familiarity with cloud-based data and analytics environments is an asset.
Strong communication, presentation, storytelling, and business writing capabilities is preferred.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.



Required

Technical Skills


Advanced SAS/SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Strong proficiency in Power BI, including dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience with Python for advanced analytics and data manipulation.
Advanced Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel skills.
Strong understanding of data structures, data quality, and reporting best practices.



Preferred


Experience working with Wealth Management, Banking, or Financial Services data.
Knowledge of Salesforce and sales pipeline reporting.
Experience with cloud-based analytics environments and modern data platforms.

Title: Workforce Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Workforce Intelligence Analyst – Markham, ON. - Full Time – ID# 7200




Are you ready to make an impact in the major Capital Projects Industry? Join PTAG, a leading Project Management Advisory & Services firm, recognized across North America for helping world-class clients deliver major capital projects successfully.

We are seeking a Workforce Intelligence Analyst to support our growing team in Markham, ON. In this role, you’ll play a key part in driving project excellence, collaborating with industry leaders, and ensuring high-quality outcomes across complex initiatives.




About PTAG

At PTAG, we help our clients plan, manage, and execute their most challenging projects with innovation, integrity, and collaboration.

Our mission is to help our clients achieve successful delivery and efficient operation of their capital projects.

Our vision is to support global leaders in the selection, planning, and execution of their major initiatives.

Our Values Include

Safety: The safety of our employees, suppliers, and clients is always the top priority.
Collaboration: We build true partnerships with clients and service providers.
Leadership: We elevate project performance through the application of best practices.
Accountability: We take responsibility for every aspect of our engagements.
Client Satisfaction: We strive for 100% satisfaction on every project.
Integrity: We believe in open and transparent communication at all levels.




Role & Responsibilities

The Workforce Intelligence Analyst reports directly to Senior Director, Workforce Development and works closely with Senior Advisors. The role combines workforce analytics, data management, business intelligence, and statistical analysis to identify workforce trends, skill and competency gaps, talent availability, capacity constraints, and future workforce requirements.

Design and build the initial data architecture for the labour intelligence data lake, structured around the KSBA framework (Knowledge, Skill, Behaviour, Attitude) and aligned to NCCER, CII, PMI, and AACE credentialing standards.
Build and maintain data pipelines that ingest, clean, and structure competency and availability data from disparate sources into a consistent, analysis-ready model.
Apply data science and statistical methods — forecasting, clustering, classification, and other predictive techniques.
Define and maintain data standards, taxonomies, and definitions across every source feeding the data lake, and document architecture and lineage clearly.
Embed data capture protocols directly into Pillar 1 advisory engagement templates so every demand profile, gap analysis, sourcing plan, and training outcome is captured systematically from the first client engagement onward.
Own data quality and completeness against the practice's KSBA-scored records targets.
Partner directly with Senior Advisors to ensure competency-level data is structured and captured correctly at the source and translate analytical findings into plain-language input they can use with clients.
Work with Legal and the COO to implement the four-tier data classification.
Lay the data-architecture and analytics groundwork workforce intelligence dashboard.
Track and report data lake growth, quality, and coverage against the practice's milestone gates.
Train and support Senior Advisors and other internal users on how to query, interpret, and apply the data lake and any early dashboards or models




Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in data science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Human Resources, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Minimum 8 years of experience in workforce analytics, people analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, labour-market intelligence, data science, or a related field.
Experience analyzing large and complex datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience working with workforce, project-resource, competency, or labour-market data is preferred.
Experience within engineering, construction, infrastructure, utilities, energy, manufacturing, or other project-based industries is considered an asset.




Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience with Python and/or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, automation, and predictive analytics.
Strong experience with Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and visualization platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Understanding of data modeling, relational databases, data warehouses, data lakes, ETL processes, and data integration principles.
Knowledge of descriptive statistics, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, classification, trend analysis, and predictive analytics.
Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, ERP, PMIS, workforce management, or related enterprise systems is an asset.




Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to interpret complex information and identify meaningful workforce trends.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong business acumen and understanding of how workforce capacity affects organizational and project performance.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong commitment to confidentiality, responsible data use, and data governance.




Salary Range for Role $ 150,000 - $155,000 base + bonus

Compensation at PTAG varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience.




Why Join PTAG?

At PTAG, you’ll be part of a dynamic, growing consulting firm that values professional development, collaboration, and innovation.

Opportunity to work on major infrastructure and capital projects.

Exposure to industry-leading clients and partners.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
Flexible work environment and opportunities for advancement.
Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP).
A culture that values safety, accountability, and excellence.

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that ingest, clean, and structure competency and availability data from disparate sources into a consistent, analysis-ready model.
  • Apply data science and statistical methods — forecasting, clustering, classification, and other predictive techniques.
  • Define and maintain data standards, taxonomies, and definitions across every source feeding the data lake, and document architecture and lineage clearly.
  • Embed data capture protocols directly into Pillar 1 advisory engagement templates so every demand profile, gap analysis, sourcing plan, and training outcome is captured systematically from the first client engagement onward.
  • Own data quality and completeness against the practice's KSBA-scored records targets.
  • Partner directly with Senior Advisors to ensure competency-level data is structured and captured correctly at the source and translate analytical findings into plain-language input they can use with clients.
  • Work with Legal and the COO to implement the four-tier data classification.
  • Lay the data-architecture and analytics groundwork workforce intelligence dashboard.
  • Track and report data lake growth, quality, and coverage against the practice's milestone gates.
  • Train and support Senior Advisors and other internal users on how to query, interpret, and apply the data lake and any early dashboards or models


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in data science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Human Resources, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in workforce analytics, people analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, labour-market intelligence, data science, or a related field.
  • Experience analyzing large and complex datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience working with workforce, project-resource, competency, or labour-market data is preferred.
  • Experience within engineering, construction, infrastructure, utilities, energy, manufacturing, or other project-based industries is considered an asset.


Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
  • Experience with Python and/or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, automation, and predictive analytics.
  • Strong experience with Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and visualization platforms.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Understanding of data modeling, relational databases, data warehouses, data lakes, ETL processes, and data integration principles.
  • Knowledge of descriptive statistics, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, classification, trend analysis, and predictive analytics.
  • Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, ERP, PMIS, workforce management, or related enterprise systems is an asset.


Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to interpret complex information and identify meaningful workforce trends.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen and understanding of how workforce capacity affects organizational and project performance.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong commitment to confidentiality, responsible data use, and data governance.


Salary Range for Role $ 150,000 - $155,000 base + bonus

Description:
Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

The global functions technology group supports Finance and Risk Business partners by using our extraordinarily rich data set that spans multiple versions and geographies globally and captures detailed datasets. Our focus lies on building creative solutions that have an immediate impact on the business of our highly analytical partners. We work in complementary teams comprising members from Data Engineering and various groups at the Bank. To support our rapidly growing group we are looking for Senior Data Analyst/Engineer who are equally passionate about the opportunity to use rich data to tackle meaningful business problems. The candidate will apply extensive, in-depth knowledge, skills, and practices to perform complex assignments to bridge the gap between business and technology by delivering critical insights and analysis to shape strategy, evolve data connectivity, and provide insights into data transformation.

What will you do?


Utilize Hive/SQL/ Python to perform daily data analysis and advanced data mining and analytics on large transactional datasets
Work closely with Program sponsors, SMEs in various business areas, technology teams to finalize functional business requirements and support implementation activities
Make recommendations and build use cases on new sources of value by addressing the biggest gaps in our data sources in relation to completeness
Find opportunities to create and automate repeatable analyses or build self-service tools for business users
Research industry metrics and business context and bring this context to bear in analyses
Oversee processes such as data gathering, transformation, reporting, and advanced analytics to ensure the integrity and reliability of large datasets.
Drive the highest standards of quality, rigor, and thought leadership across the entire data lifecycle.


What do you need to Succeed?

Must have:


Solid understanding of Finance business processes such as Balance Sheet Reporting, Profit and Loss Reporting, Capital Reserve Reporting, Capital Markets products and processes, and Regulatory Reporting
Minimum of 5+ years of analytical experience in applying solutions to business problems in relevant fields such as analytics, business requirements, consulting, or other data-driven functions
Demonstrated Experienced in quantitative, qualitative, analytical, problem solving, and critical thinking skills.
Exceptional storytelling skills, with a track record of translating complex data into compelling business insights. Ability to communicate findings derived from complex analytics to Senior Leadership, both verbally and visually.
Experienced in databases, data engineering, ETL, ELT concepts with utilizing querying, automation, and big data technologies (e.g. Python, SQL, Spark, Teradata, Hadoop, Snowflake, Databricks) to produce repeatable insights
Proficiency with creating compelling presentations


Nice-to-have:


Data Engineering / Data Science certification and/or completion of Business Analysis training courses.
Copilot , Git hub , Python knowledge


What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.


A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

Opportunities to do challenging work.

Job Description

Provide a broad range of data analysis functions including data modeling, structured query language (SQL) data quality, data profiling, extract-transform-load (ETL), metadata enrichment and management, data provenance and lineage, report design and other specialized data management functions. Works under general guidance of Data Specialists or Managers to design, develop and support data management solutions for the bank.

Key Accountabilities

CUSTOMER


Provide a broad range of data analysis and assess data management requirements for specific data platforms, applications systems, servers aligned to business or enterprise technology needs
Develop and maintain knowledge of data available from upstream sources and data within relevant platform / applications, including through the means of data profiling and data quality reporting tools and via the capture of technical and business metadata
Ensure data is maintained in compliance with enterprise data standards, policies and guidelines
Collaborate with business and technology partners to elicit information / data requirements and articulate requirements
Contribute to data deliverables including contribution to the overall project business requirements and data requirements documents
Develop and maintain data models using industry standard modeling tools
Implement and support ETL jobs, using the Bank's standard tools
Provide support to the development and testing teams to resolve data issues
Build and supports reports using a combination of BI tools and SQL
Support the user community by helping users interpret the data
Provide data governance and data availability support to technology teams and business users and ensure requirements regarding privacy and security of data, data governance and access controls are appropriately captured
Assist with the testing of the technical information systems in regards to implementation, upgrades, and/or patches to ensure data integrity and systems functionality


SHAREHOLDER


Coordinate with other technology work teams such as, ITS, Architecture, TRMIS etc. to ensure project success
Build subject matter knowledge in specific subject areas across multiple lines of business
Define, build and manage data dictionary / catalog for respective data platforms, systems / servers / applications
Ensure metadata and data lineage is captured and compatible with enterprise metadata and data management tools and processes
Runs quality assurance reports and resolves data integrity issues to ensure accurate reporting and data records
Gather, review, analyze, profile, validate, and map system data into the data warehouse to meet reporting and analytical business needs
Develop solutions and recommendations for improving data integrity issues, analyze data issues and works with development teams for problem resolutions
Identify problematic areas and conduct research to determine the best course of action to correct the data, identify, analyze and interpret trends and patterns in complex datasets
Determine and analyze line of business requirements, use system data, and provide input needed by various departments and senior management to produce business reports
Understand data initiatives and capabilities, data governance principles and how they apply across the organization
Comply with well-defined enterprise technology delivery practices and standards and project management disciplines


EMPLOYEE / TEAM


Work effectively as a team, supporting other members of the team in resolving critical service issues
Prioritize and manage own workload in order to deliver quality results and meet timelines
Support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation and teamwork and ensure timely communication of issues/ points of interest.
Participate in knowledge transfer within the team and business units
Continuously enhance knowledge / expertise in own area and keep current with leading-edge technologies trends
Identify and recommend opportunities to enhance productivity, effectiveness and operational efficiency of the business unit and/or team


BREADTH & DEPTH


Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Collaborative and strong team player
Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas and results to a varied audience
Ability to work with minimal direction in fast-paced energetic environment, managing multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
Ability to learn and apply new concepts quickly
Participates in the development of small-scale datamarts or changes to enterprise data warehouses
Accountabilities are moderately complex, varied in scope and performed under direct management guidance
Generally reports to a Manager or Senior Manager


Experience & Education


Undergraduate degree or Technical Certificate
3-5 years relevant experience
Hands-On Databricks Expertise: Strong experience building and optimizing pipelines using Databricks, including leveraging Databricks Genie for conversational AI/BI solutions.
Fabric & Power BI Administration: Demonstrated experience managing Power BI/Fabric tenant settings, capacities, workspace governance, and security models.
Enterprise Enablement: Proven ability to teach, mentor, and simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences across the business.
Effective Communication: Exceptional written and verbal soft skills, with a collaborative, learning-focused mindset for cross-functional alignment.
CoE Background (Asset): Prior experience working within an Enterprise Data & Analytics/BI Center of Excellence (CoE) preferred.

TD is one of the world's leading global financial institutions and is the fifth largest bank in North America by branches/stores. Support in managing Blue Yonder and WebPortal data maintenance/accuracy, and exception management to support Vendor and DC/Store order flow.

Technical

Analytical

Superior analytical skills that enable teams to interpret and transform customer needs, converting them into a better customer experience.

Write scripts to analyze data to discover patterns, meaningful relationships, irregularities, and trends.

An effective team player who adds complementary skills and contributes valuable ideas and feedback.
Accountable for fulfilling any commitments made to others on the immediate or cross functional team.

Build partnerships and work collaboratively with teams to achieve shared objectives.
Willing to “roll up their sleeves” when necessary to support tasks.

Take on new opportunities and challenges with a sense of urgency and enthusiasm.
Learn innovative methods, tools, and technology and apply them to business requests and tasks.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently on complex technical and business opportunities.
Acquire and utilize the necessary information from subject matter experts to deliver excellence.


Communication


Establish and maintain effective, dynamic relationships with management and user groups across the organization.
Demonstrate the ability to present and communicate effectively across cross functional teams, leadership, and third-party providers.


Experience, Education, Certifications:


Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Business, Math, Statistics, or related field.
1-3 years of practical analytical experience in a professional environment or business setting, preferably in Supply Chain.
Preferably 1 – 3 years of Blue Yonder Supply Chain application experience.
Advanced knowledge of SQL to query relational databases.
Enhanced skills in using and implementing data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with open-source languages such as R, Python is an asset.
Proficient in advanced Microsoft 365 applications including Excel, Power Automate, SharePoint, Teams, Word, and Outlook.
Excellent analytical and communication skills (written and verbal).
Must be able to travel to offices, stores, and distribution centers as required.

The targeted salary range for this position is $62,000-$70,000 annually. The final offer will be based on factors such as market location, relevant skills, experience and internal equity.

Title: Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP&A Business Partner
Description:
About The Company

Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category - the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: you see everything about a lead before you buy - full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We're the #1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we're accelerating.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP&A Business Partner who will help us understand where the business makes money, where profit is lost, and which decisions can improve margins, cash flow, and overall performance. You will work closely with founders, finance, product, operations, and business teams to turn financial and operational data into clear recommendations. This role exists to help leadership make faster, better decisions based on real business numbers.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build and improve executive dashboards that show revenue, profit, margins, COGS, OpEx, refunds, payouts, cash flow, and key business metrics

Analyze profitability across products, customers, providers, geographies, channels, lead sources, and operational workflows

Create P&L analysis, gross margin analysis, contribution margin analysis, unit economics models, forecasts, and scenario analysis

Identify cost leaks, overspending, inefficient vendors, payment issues, margin risks, and other areas where the business can improve profit

Partner with finance, accounting, product, operations, sales, and marketing teams to connect business activity with financial outcomes

Reconcile business data with invoices, payouts, payment systems, taxes, accounting records, and financial reports

Present clear recommendations to founders and senior leadership on pricing, cost optimization, product profitability, hiring, and growth decisions

What Makes You a Strong Fit:

6-8+ years of experience in financial analytics, FP&A, data analytics, business analytics, or a similar role

Strong experience with financial modeling, P&L analysis, unit economics, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis

Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with BigQuery

Strong experience with Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for financial modeling, reporting, and scenario analysis

Good understanding of accounting basics, financial statements, revenue, COGS, OpEx, gross margin, contribution margin, and cash flow

Clear communication in English, both spoken and written, with the ability to explain financial insights to founders, business teams, and non-finance stakeholders

Bonus if you have:

Experience with Python or another scripting language for data analysis and reporting automation

Experience with payment systems, accounting systems, CRM, ERP, Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or similar tools

Experience in marketplace, SaaS, fintech, real estate, lead generation, or performance marketing businesses

Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership in a fast-moving business environment

Why You'll Love It Here:

You'll work at the core of a product-led, AI-powered startup where data drives every decision

Your work will ship fast and impact thousands of users

High autonomy, low bureaucracy: we trust you to own your domain

Remote-first culture with flexible hours and async-friendly communication

Salary (fixed base) ABOVE the market average

A smart, passionate team that moves fast, supports each other, and builds cool stuff

15 paid vacation days plus 5 paid sick days annually

Paid access to courses, books, and growth resources

Real decision-making power and ownership of your results

Meet The Team

The Market Insights team delivers the market intelligence behind executive decision-making at Cisco. We size markets, track the competitive landscape, and analyze customer behavior to inform where Cisco invests, builds, and competes.

We’re a team of analysts, data scientists, engineers, and market intelligence leaders focused on the practical application of data to hard business problems. Using proprietary data and machine learning, we surface new market opportunities and flag risks early. Every insight we produce is built to be acted on, so that resource allocation and product roadmaps rest on objective evidence rather than assumption.

Your Impact

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll sit between our data architecture and the strategic decisions it informs. Working with experts from the team, you’ll build the analytical solutions and dashboards that support the market insight analysis in the team and help visualize to give executives clear understanding into market performance — sizing opportunities, measuring how we’re performing against them, and translating what the data says into recommendations leaders can act on.

Responsibilities


Market Analysis: Run deep-dive analyses across large, disparate datasets — internal telemetry, third-party analyst data, public financial disclosures — to identify trends, anomalies, and growth opportunities in the global technology market.
Market Sizing & Forecasting: Build and maintain TAM models and forecasts for priority segments, tracking forecast accuracy and refining methodology over time.
Visualization: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards that turn complex datasets into insight an executive can absorb in two minutes.
Gen AI Integration: Apply LLMs and agentic workflows to synthesize unstructured sources — analyst reports, earnings calls, customer feedback — and to accelerate recurring reporting and narrative development.
Data Modeling: Architect and optimize the data models behind our analytical platforms for accuracy, scalability, and performance, and continuously improve the collection and reporting workflows that feed them.

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field — Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science — or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years in business intelligence, data analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced SQL for data extraction and manipulation.

Strong grounding in data modeling, relational databases, and data warehousing.

Title: Data and Financial Insights Analyst
Description:
Description

The Experience

The Data and Financial Reporting Analyst supports the Data, Analytics and Reporting team within the Prospect-to-Cash Operations organization. This role delivers business intelligence and data solutions to the Credit and Collections function, crafting accurate, clear data stories that drive scale, efficiency, and effectiveness in support of Salesforce's Operating Cash Flow.

What You'll Actually Be Doing


Owns recurring financial and business reporting for the America Credit and Collections function, including monthly, quarterly, and yearly key performance indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and scorecards built in Tableau, Snowflake, and Salesforce, while maintaining data quality and integrity across the portfolio
Delivers ad-hoc analysis and strategic support to business leaders, including workforce planning, growth-trend forecasting, and guidance on where to focus to hit performance targets
Drives high-impact process improvement and automation projects end-to-end, from framework design and metric definition through executive reporting, partnering with Operations, Data Engineering, and Business Systems teams to eliminate manual bottlenecks
Creates and presents executive-level presentations and reporting that translate complex data into clear data stories with actionable recommendations


You're Our Person If...


You have 2+ years of experience in Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Finance and Strategy, Accounting, Operations, or Business Consulting
You have hands-on experience with advanced Excel, SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets, and data visualization tools such as Tableau or Tableau CRM
You can explore & apply new Salesforce and Data/AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate and solve data, reporting, & business problems
You have experience presenting analysis and recommendations to senior leadership and both technical and non-technical audiences and experience with enterprise software systems such as Oracle, Concur, Workday, Salesforce, or Coupa


Even Better If...


You have experience with additional data management tools or languages such as Python, Tableau Prep, or Alteryx
You can demonstrates the ability to dissect and solve problems with a fact-based, data-driven, and creative approach, while managing multiple high-visibility projects and deadlines with urgency and ownership
You have experience with process optimization, transformation, or automation, including AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, Slackbot, Apromore, or Copilot, for workflow automation or analysis
You have familiarity with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, including experience as a SOX control owner and familiarity with ASC 606 revenue recognition standards

Curiosity and attention to detail

Title: Consultant, Business Insights
Description:
Company Description:

At McDonald's, we are committed to being the best, and that starts with finding the best people. We have built a team of extraordinary people from around the world. We are problem solvers, risk takers, innovators, and thought leaders that take our work seriously, but have fun doing it. We challenge ourselves to get smarter and sharper every day, we value personal and professional growth, and believe in rewarding and celebrating our successes.

The Opportunity

The Consultant, Business Insights is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving reporting, dashboards, and business performance analysis for the Business Insights team. Based in Toronto, the candidate will support recurring reporting processes, data validation, dashboard enhancements, documentation, and technical analysis that enable accurate internal decision-making. This role is best suited to someone with strong analytical skills, technical reporting experience, and a focus on building scalable, reliable reporting solutions while leveraging Power BI and Microsoft Co-Pilot.

Who you are
You are a detail-oriented, fact-based problem solver with a technical mindset. You have applicable experience working with various data sources, and establishing relationships between multiple datasets. You have strong capabilities in dashboarding tools such as PowerBI, and able to leverage AI tools like co-pilot. You proactively look for ways to improve accuracy, efficiency, and automation. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy building reporting solutions that help teams make informed decisions.

Duties

In addition to following McDonald’s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:

Business Updates

Prepare recurring reporting outputs and business updates that summarize key performance trends accurately and consistently.
Consolidate data inputs, validate results, investigate variances, and maintain reporting processes across monthly, daily, and ad hoc deliverables.
Monitor business trends and translate performance changes into clear internal insights and reporting outputs and presentation to senior leadership team as needed.

Technical Reporting and Dashboard Support

Support regional and national reporting through data pulls, tracking files, competitive outlet reporting, product mix reporting, incentive reporting, and ad hoc analysis.
Design, test, enhance, and document dashboards and reporting solutions, including data models, measures, refreshes, and reporting views.
Utilize Power Query and Power BI to optimize data formatting and visualize reporting.

Reporting

Produce, maintain, and distribute recurring dashboards and reports for internal business users.
Clarify reporting requirements with internal partners and ensure solutions are accurate, relevant, and fit for purpose.
Improve reporting accuracy, automation, efficiency, and scalability by resolving data discrepancies, dashboard issues, refresh failures, and reporting gaps.
Leverage Co-pilot to summarize findings and automate communication routines.
Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess the following skills and qualifications:

Work experience: Five to seven years’ experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, or a related analytics function.
Education: An undergraduate degree with a data, analytics or business focus.
Experience building, maintaining, validating, and enhancing dashboards and reports for internal business users.
Experienced and capable of working in a fast-paced, agile, and sometimes high-pressure environment while managing recurring timelines and multiple priorities.
Strong analytical thinking, technical problem-solving, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI, SQL, and Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and PowerPoint
Proficiency and experience in leveraging AI
Experience with data modelling, visualization design, refresh management, and automation; Tableau, Alteryx, Python, or R is an asset.
Detail-oriented self-starter with sound data validation practices and the ability to support weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting.

.

Salary Range

The expected salary range for this role is $77,000 - $102,000 per year
The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we may also consider your experience, and other job-related factors.  This is for an existing role.

Our workplaces have a long-standing policy of providing fair, equitable, and accessible opportunities for all employees and prospective employees. Accommodations during the application process are available upon request.
We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to screen, assess, or select applicants during our recruitment process

Description:
Job Summary

UBC Sauder School of Business is one of the world’s leading business faculties. The school consistently ranks among the top 100 in the world and is recognized internationally for excellence in research and learning, an outstanding faculty and unmatched global partnerships. A collaborative and respectful culture within which all members of our community can thrive is a key principle in our strategic plan, and one that underpins our educational mission.




We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the Vancouver Campus is situated within the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the Musqueam. We acknowledge that UBC Sauder at the UBC Robson Square is situated on the traditional territory of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh.




The Creative Destruction Lab (CDL) is a nonprofit organization that delivers an objectives-based program for massively scalable, seed-stage, science- and technology-based companies with locations in Canada, USA, France and the UK. CDL-Vancouver is anchored at the UBC Sauder School of Business, supporting and contributing to the entire west coast innovation ecosystem in Canada and in the US.CDL-Vancouver works directly with start-up companies within the Climate, Compute, Biomedical Engineering, and Advanced Therapies (stream info). Read more.




CDL is a high priority and high-profile initiative for the UBC Sauder School of Business and UBC. Program outcomes can be expected to have a significant impact on UBC Sauder and UBC’s public profile and standing in the eyes of Universities, the startup & technology sector, and the general public in both Canada and the US.




The Data Analyst works to maintain and transform data into meaningful insights regarding stakeholder behavior, trends, and operational effectiveness and develops new reporting tools and data

visualizations and representations to advise CDL senior leadership and support data-driven decision-making.




The Data Analyst works extensively with Saleforce, Airtable and Google Drive and manages the data flow and interaction between these platforms. As the data management expert, the Data Analyst facilitates informed decisions on strategic action items and advances CDL-Vancouver priorities by performing qualitative and quantitative research, designing reporting systems, overseeing data collection and conducting analyses. The incumbent designs, develops and implements methods associated to this research.




Work Performed

Collects, analyzes, interprets and extracts data. Works with complex datasets to research, analyze and prepare statistical reports on key findings.
Advises CDL leadership team, uses statistical analysis to evaluate progress towards strategic targets.
Creates regular reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) on a regular basis to track progress and success.
Conducts benchmarking research exercises and analysis to support CDL’s objectives.
Reorganizes and streamlines current databases to accurately synthesize reports, summaries, and dashboards to produce insights. Develops reporting schedule and creates and runs reports required for all levels of reporting.
Maintains data and develops data quality assessments on main databases to ensure its accuracy and suitability.
Recommends, develops, and implements process improvements to ensure the timely and accurate transfer of information into the CDL network-wide databases.
In consultation with the team, builds solutions to simplify CDL’s data infrastructure and data visualization tools to empower the team to access and leverage data independently.
Builds automations to reduce manual work while increasing efficiency and accuracy.
Manages key data collection and implements new processes to acquire and analyze information that has been identified as significant to the operation of the organization.
Contributes to the identification of CDL’s data needs and priorities for upgrades.
Educates the larger team on how to use the tools according to the improved processes (on an ongoing basis). Provides training and answers questions around data management from CDL employees.
Obtains and discloses confidential and sensitive information as appropriate, determining appropriate course of action, resolving details of unusual situations in the absence of established guidelines.
Provides technical documentation of all aspects of the data management process.
Performs other related duties.




Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of two years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.




- Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own

- Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion




Preferred Qualifications

A high degree of computer literacy and extensive experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Drive, in particular, demonstrated high-level proficiency with advanced Excel/Google Sheets functions (VLOOKUP, PivotTables, PowerPivot, etc.).
Proficiency with statistics, data cleaning, data mapping, data manipulation, and reporting.
Experience working with databases and CRMs, preferably Salesforce and Airtable.
Willing to learn the existing processes in place in order to propose improvements.
Intermediate coding skills to create solutions in Airtable Scripting Extension or alternative new solutions as the team’s needs evolve. (Candidates with basic knowledge but a strong desire to develop coding skills will be considered.)
Knowledge of Airtable Interfaces, Salesforce Dashboards, or any other data visualization software is strongly preferred.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and decision-making skills.
Ability to be thorough, accurate, and have a high level of attention to detail.
Technical documentation skills.
The ability to work as part of an integrated team in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills.
Proactive, with demonstrated initiative and creative problem-solving skills.
Understanding of privacy, copyright, and data security best practices.
Proven quantitative research and analytical techniques with the ability to gather, evaluate and synthesize complex and large sets of data.




Compensation Range

$6,143.67 - $8,830.25 CAD Monthly

The Compensation Range is the span between the minimum and maximum base salary for a position. The midpoint of the range is approximately halfway between the minimum and the maximum and represents an employee that possesses full job knowledge, qualifications and experience for the position. In the normal course, employees will be hired, transferred or promoted between the minimum and midpoint of the salary range for a job.

Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the Posting End Date.




Job End Date: Ongoing




Please note Applications will only be accepted via the hiring portal, please do not send over LinkedIn. We anticipate high volume of applicants for this role and only selected candidates will be contacted.

Program outcomes can be expected to have a significant impact on UBC Sauder and UBC’s public profile and standing in the eyes of Universities, the startup & technology sector, and the general public in both Canada and the US.

The Data Analyst works to maintain and transform data into meaningful insights regarding stakeholder behavior, trends, and operational effectiveness and develops new reporting tools and data

visualizations and representations to advise CDL senior leadership and support data-driven decision-making.

The Data Analyst works extensively with Saleforce, Airtable and Google Drive and manages the data flow and interaction between these platforms. As the data management expert, the Data Analyst facilitates informed decisions on strategic action items and advances CDL-Vancouver priorities by performing qualitative and quantitative research, designing reporting systems, overseeing data collection and conducting analyses. The incumbent designs, develops and implements methods associated to this research.

Organizational Status

Reports to CDL’s Senior Project Manager. Works closely with the CDL Leadership team, Operations team, Partnerships team, and Venture Management team.

Work Performed

  • Collects, analyzes, interprets and extracts data. Works with complex datasets to research, analyze and prepare statistical reports on key findings.
  • Advises CDL leadership team, uses statistical analysis to evaluate progress towards strategic targets.
  • Creates regular reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) on a regular basis to track progress and success.
  • Conducts benchmarking research exercises and analysis to support CDL’s objectives.
  • Reorganizes and streamlines current databases to accurately synthesize reports, summaries, and dashboards to produce insights. Develops reporting schedule and creates and runs reports required for all levels of reporting.
  • Maintains data and develops data quality assessments on main databases to ensure its accuracy and suitability.
  • Recommends, develops, and implements process improvements to ensure the timely and accurate transfer of information into the CDL network-wide databases.
  • In consultation with the team, builds solutions to simplify CDL’s data infrastructure and data visualization tools to empower the team to access and leverage data independently.
  • Builds automations to reduce manual work while increasing efficiency and accuracy.
  • Manages key data collection and implements new processes to acquire and analyze information that has been identified as significant to the operation of the organization.
  • Contributes to the identification of CDL’s data needs and priorities for upgrades.
  • Educates the larger team on how to use the tools according to the improved processes (on an ongoing basis). Provides training and answers questions around data management from CDL employees.
  • Obtains and discloses confidential and sensitive information as appropriate, determining appropriate course of action, resolving details of unusual situations in the absence of established guidelines.
  • Provides technical documentation of all aspects of the data management process.
  • Performs other related duties.

Consequence of Error/Judgement

Responsible for providing accurate, potentially sensitive, and confidential information to other members of the team. Must respect the confidentiality of information handled.

Failure to exercise appropriate judgment could put the department in violation of privacy laws, increase direct costs, contribute to lost opportunities, damage the reputation of the university, and potentially negatively impact relationships and philanthropic support.

Supervision Received

Reports to CDL’s Senior Project Manager. Also takes direction from CDL’s Leadership team.

Supervision Given

None

Minimum Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of two years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
  • Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion

Preferred Qualifications

  • A high degree of computer literacy and extensive experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Drive, in particular, demonstrated high-level proficiency with advanced Excel/Google Sheets functions (VLOOKUP, PivotTables, PowerPivot, etc.).
  • Proficiency with statistics, data cleaning, data mapping, data manipulation, and reporting.
  • Experience working with databases and CRMs, preferably Salesforce and Airtable.
  • Willing to learn the existing processes in place in order to propose improvements.
  • Intermediate coding skills to create solutions in Airtable Scripting Extension or alternative new solutions as the team’s needs evolve. (Candidates with basic knowledge but a strong desire to develop coding skills will be considered.)
  • Knowledge of Airtable Interfaces, Salesforce Dashboards, or any other data visualization software is strongly preferred.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to be thorough, accurate, and have a high level of attention to detail.
  • Technical documentation skills.
  • The ability to work as part of an integrated team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Proactive, with demonstrated initiative and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of privacy, copyright, and data security best practices.
  • Proven quantitative research and analytical techniques with the ability to gather, evaluate and synthesize complex and large sets of data.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA SPORTS™ FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
