BC Cancer provides comprehensive cancer control for the people of British Columbia. BC Cancer is part of the Provincial Health Services Authority (PHSA).

PHSA plans, manages and evaluates specialized health services with the BC health authorities to provide equitable and cost-effective health care for people throughout the province. Our values reflect our commitment to excellence and include: Respect people – Be compassionate – Dare to innovate – Create equity – Be courageous.

Learn more about PHSA and our programs: jobs.phsa.ca/programs-and-services

PHSA and BC Cancer are committed to anti-racism and equity in our hiring and employment practices. With learning and compassion, we are addressing existing inequities and barriers throughout our systems. PHSA is seeking to create a diverse workforce and to establish an inclusive and culturally safe environment. We invite applications and enquiries from all people, particularly those belonging to the historically, systemically, and/or persistently excluded groups identified under the B.C. Human Rights Code.

One of PHSA’s North Star priorities is to eradicate Indigenous-specific racism, which includes ongoing commitments to Indigenous recruitment and employee experience as well as dismantling barriers to health care employment at every level. We welcome Indigenous individuals to apply and/or contact the Sanya’k̓ula Team (Indigenous Recruitment & Employee Experience) for support at indigenous.employment@phsa.ca.

The internal job posting expires on September 22, 2026 and will no longer be accessible. If the internal job posting has expired, please e-mail internaljobshelpu@phsa.ca with the six-digit job requisition number and your PHSA employee ID number to be considered as a late internal applicant. Please do not apply for the external job posting.

If you have not yet set up an internal profile, please e-mail internaljobshelpu@phsa.ca with your PHSA employee ID number to obtain your temporary password. Under the direction of the Director, Insights and Pipeline Management, the Analyst supports the delivery of fundraising analytics, and pipeline management services for the Corporate Partnerships team. What You’ll Be Doing


Data Analysis
Use Salesforce and analytics/visualization tools to generate insights that support strategic, data‑informed fundraising selection.
Retrieve, analyze, and interpret data to support performance management of prospect pools, pipelines, portfolios, forecasting, and fundraiser activity.
Act as the Corporate team’s lead representative in DAS project discussions.
Serve as the Salesforce subject‑matter expert for the Corporate Giving team, including managing updates, creating and editing reports, supporting process changes, and building campaigns.
Manage the time‑sensitive Gifts of Securities (GOS) process in accordance with CCS Gift Acceptance Policy, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Prospect Development and Reporting
Implement prospect development strategies and data integrity initiatives; design and produce regular and ad‑hoc audit reports to ensure accuracy of ratings, stages, assignments, proposals, and prospect groups.
The Analyst keeps up to date on market trends and best practices to ensure continual service improvements.
Create efficiencies by streamlining tools, processes, and reports based on feedback from colleagues and observance of data input results. Identify opportunities to leverage technology to facilitate information delivery and work alongside the DAS team to enact updates.
Maintain and update the Business Procedures and Policies document to reinforce consistency in data and analytics practices that can also serve as a reference guide for fundraisers and securing required approvals.
Support fundraiser pipeline management
Provide recommendations to fundraising staff on how to interpret, comprehend, and leverage data visualization and predictive data model scores for the benefit of prospect discovery and pipeline management.
Enable quarterly pipeline review meetings with fundraisers to review portfolios to ensure fundraising activities are on track and moving through the solicitation cycle. Initiate and drive regular meetings with fundraisers to review pipelines to ensure data cleanliness prior to quarterly reviews.
Monitor portfolio composition and performance; provide recommendations on portfolio size, stage distribution, moves management, fundraising plans, and prospect stagnation or sunsetting.
Design and contribute toward training sessions on new reports and tools to fundraisers to ensure that KPIs and financial goals are achieved and data competency is maintained. Utilize strong data analysis and data presentation skills to present information clearly to staff at different levels of the department.
Drive corporate record clean‑up initiatives to strengthen authority-driven linkages and eliminate duplicate records across industry sectors.
Conduct lead‑generation and prospecting activities to refresh the corporate donor pool and identify new or existing prospects within the database.
Other duties as assigned
Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.


Qualifications


Demonstrated experience retrieving, interpreting, and synthesizing complex datasets using Salesforce and analytics/visualization tools to support evidence‑based decision‑making.
Hands‑on experience creating and modifying reports, managing data updates, supporting process changes, and serving as a subject matter expert for business users.
Experience working with technical teams (e.g., data/analytics) and frontline fundraisers to translate business needs into actionable insights, tools, and process improvements.
Experience implementing data‑integrity initiatives, conducting portfolio/pipeline reviews, and supporting prospect management strategies in a fundraising or CRM‑driven environment.
Ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, diagnose issues in pipelines or portfolios, and recommend clear, actionable solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences and guide fundraisers in applying insights.
Commitment to accuracy, consistency, and governance in data entry, reporting, and documentation.
Ability to work effectively with fundraisers, leadership, and technical teams, fostering trust and shared ownership of data‑driven practices.

Title: Supply Chain Business Analyst
Description:
Reporting to the Director, Inventory Management, the Supply Chain Business Analyst provides analytical, forecasting, reporting, and process‑optimization support across the supply chain organization. This role focuses on developing insights, improving systems and processes, and supporting data‑driven decisions that enhance inventory performance, forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and the overall customer experience.

What You Will Do


Develop, enhance, and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools to monitor supply chain performance
Analyze supply chain data across forecasting, inventory, procurement, and logistics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
Conduct root‑cause analyses on service failures, forecast variances, and inventory challenges
Support the development of data governance standards and ensure data integrity across systems
Support demand planning cycles through trend analysis, modeling, and scenario planning
Evaluate forecast accuracy and partner with teams to improve inputs and assumptions
Collaborate with Sales and Inventory teams to align demand forecasts with budgets and category growth plans
Assess end‑to‑end supply chain processes and identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, and standardization
Support ERP enhancements, functional improvements, and system implementation projects
Prepare business cases, cost‑benefit analyses, and operational assessments to drive continuous improvement
Act as the central strategic bridge, connecting the dots between Sales, Procurement, Operations, and Logistics to ensure a unified strategy and a seamless customer experience.
Work closely with Inventory, Procurement, Operations, Logistics, and Sales teams to support strategic and operational initiatives
Participate in supplier and logistics partner performance reviews by providing analytical insights
Support issue resolution related to supply disruptions, service delays, or data inconsistencies
Assist in inventory investment planning, demand/supply balancing, and capacity assessments
Provide analytical support for annual budgeting and long‑range planning
Support compliance with supply chain regulatory requirements (import/export, sustainability, documentation


About You


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent post‑secondary education in Supply Chain, Business, Analytics, Engineering, or a related field
3-5 years of experience in supply chain analytics, business analysis, or a similar analytical supply chain function
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience using data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau)
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities
Proficiency with ERP systems and supply chain planning tools
Certifications: SCMP, CPIM, CSCP, or other relevant designations considered an asset

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
About Us:

With over 60 years of industry experience, Gescan has 29 branches located across Western Canada. At Gescan, we leverage our strong global resource base, our local expertise, and our family-oriented values to deliver the best service to our customers and suppliers.

We are a proud member of the Sonepar Group, the world's largest privately-held electrical distributor. The Sonepar Group is present in more than 40 countries with over 45,000 employees. In Canada, we are represented by 6 locally managed electrical and industrial distributors and have over 110 locations with coverage in 9 provinces.

To explore and learn more about Sonepar opportunities, please visit www.career.sonepar.com




What’s In It For You?

You will be joining a market leader with over 40 years of experience to help you elevate your potential.
You will be working for the world's #1 privately held business to business distributor of electrical products and related solutions.
A chance to get involved in the forever growing electrical industry.
We house the largest inventory to better service our customers and deliver on sales commitments.
An opportunity for career development across many business departments within our organization.




Scope

Under the supervision of the Pricing Manager, the primary mandate of the Pricing Analyst is to analyze any trend, from products, categories, customers and suppliers. The analyst will be responsible for the creation, structure and management of the product database.




Responsibilities

Tool development
Develop dynamic pricing tools and models to effectively meet business needs.
Extract, process, and edit reports from Cognos and Power BI (Excel file, Access, pivot tables).
Perform complex analyses of our current pricing, product, vendor customer data using Excel, Power BI, Cognos, and our internal and external databases.
Analyze and interpret market trends in collaboration with internal teams for the purpose of developing competitive pricing strategies;
Analyze data from a variety of sources to better understand pricing strategies, better structure our customer types, and better aggregate our products and suppliers.
Prepare and present the results of the pricing and profitability analysis to management.
Keep abreast of different methods of price analysis, industry trends, and database management
Develop dynamic tools to improve database management.
Participate in the management of the information of the database and ensure the compliance of the information found therein and propose solutions.Team Support
Validate and approve pricing agreements on a daily basis to understand the pricing cycle and support the team as needed.
Assist the team in preparing for IT changes on products, categories, customers and suppliers.
All other related tasks.




Required

Bachelor's degree in administration or related field.
Excellent command of Microsoft Office suite tools (Excel, Access, Outlook, Teams).
Good knowledge of technological tools such as MS VBA/SQL, Python, Power BI, Power Apps.
Knowledge of Cognos (an asset). • A minimum of 1-3 years of experience in the field and/or related field.
Experience in interpretation, data analysis, database management, and dashboard creation.
Programming experience (basic).




Benefits & Perks

We offer a competitive salary, plus a full set of benefits.

Benefits program allowing you to choose from options that best fit you and your dependents’ needs. Benefit options include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Spending Account & RRSP matching.
Employee Assistance Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Discounts and a career path.
Regardless of your benefits program, you will receive company paid Life Insurance, and employee paid disability.

À propos d'EDC

À Exportation et développement Canada (EDC), nous aidons les entreprises canadiennes à réussir à l'étranger. En tant que société d'État à vocation financière, EDC propose des solutions financières innovantes et des conseils d'experts pour aider les entreprises à explorer de nouveaux marchés, à atténuer leurs risques et à se développer.

Pourquoi vous joindre à EDC?


Gamme complète d'avantages sociaux : EDC offre un régime de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux concurrentiel, une bonne conciliation travail-vie personnelle et la chance de contribuer à bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce
Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : EDC offre un régime concurrentiel en ce qui concerne la rémunération et la conciliation travail-vie personnelle : différentes options de travail hybride, trois à quatre semaines de vacances, une période de fermeture, des vendredis d'été raccourcis et les vendredis sans réunion
Perfectionnement professionnel : Profitez de nos occasions d'apprentissage continu, notamment des programmes de formation, des ateliers et de la formation linguistique
Culture inclusive : Intégrez un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif qui lutte pour l'équité en matière d'emploi et valorise la diversité des idées, des forces et des origines pour favoriser la réussite
Programmes de bien-être : Nous offrons des initiatives de bien-être, de l'aide à la santé mentale et des programmes de conditionnement physique pour veiller à votre santé et à votre bonheur
Investissement dans la collectivité : Participez à des activités de bénévolat et donnez au suivant grâce à un éventail de programmes de responsabilité sociale


Aperçu de l'équipe

Le groupe Solutions numériques et technologiques (DTS - Digital & Technology Solutions), sous la direction du chef de l'information, a été créé en 2023 avec pour mission de permettre à nos clients et à nos collègues de relever les défis du monde en offrant de façon harmonieuse des expériences numériques sécurisées et fiables.

Les Solutions numériques et technologiques se sont fixé les objectifs suivants pour EDC :


Définir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir l'état cible intégré de la technologie, le modèle de données cible ainsi que les opérations technologiques nécessaires pour soutenir la transformation des activités d'EDC à l'horizon 2030
Établir et gérer une feuille de route numérique glissante sur trois ans qui séquence les résultats technologiques requis pour atteindre l'état cible technologique et facilite son exécution dans l'ensemble des domaines de l'organisation
Suivre l'évolution des tendances de l'industrie et des technologies émergentes afin qu'EDC ait accès aux outils numériques nécessaires pour demeurer pertinente sur le marché et favoriser la croissance du commerce international canadien
Diriger et assurer la mise en œuvre intégrée des initiatives numériques, de données, d'infrastructure et de cybersécurité afin d'offrir d'excellentes expériences aux clients, aux utilisateurs et aux employés


L'équipe de l'Initiative de transformation des données supervise les initiatives de transformation visant à permettre aux secteurs d'activité d'EDC de prendre des décisions opportunes et éclairées grâce à des rapports, des analyses et des produits de données fiables.

Alors qu'EDC poursuit la modernisation de son écosystème de production de rapports, ce poste contribuera à la migration et à la modernisation des rapports Cognos existants vers Microsoft Power BI/Fabric.

Ce que vous ferez :


La personne choisie jouera un rôle clé dans l'évaluation, la rationalisation, la refonte et la reconstitution des ressources existantes de production de rapports de Cognos sur la plateforme Power BI. Elle travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs fonctionnels, les équipes des données, les partenaires technologiques et les responsables des rapports afin de cerner les besoins actuels en matière de production de rapports, de consigner les données et la logique commerciale, de valider les mappages de la source à la cible et de créer des rapports et des modèles sémantiques dans Power BI qui sont conformes aux normes d'EDC en matière de gouvernance, de rendement, de convivialité et de facilité de maintenance.
Analyser les rapports, les dossiers, les requêtes, les calculs, les filtres, les exigences de sécurité et les modèles d'utilisation existants dans Cognos afin de déterminer l'étendue et la complexité de la migration.
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de valider les exigences en matière de production de rapports, de cerner les rapports redondants ou de faible valeur et de recommander des pistes de consolidation, de refonte ou de retrait.
Consigner l'état actuel des éléments suivants : logique et mise en page des rapports, sources de données, mappage des champs de données, dépendances et règles de fonctionnement.
Concevoir et élaborer des rapports, des tableaux de bord, des rapports paginés et des modèles sémantiques dans Power BI qui sont conformes aux normes de production de rapports d'EDC et aux besoins opérationnels.
Transformer et valider les données à l'aide du langage de requête structuré (SQL), de Power Query, de DAX et des sources de données d'entreprise approuvées tout en garantissant l'exactitude et la traçabilité de ces données depuis les anciens rapports jusqu'aux nouveaux résultats générés par Power BI.
Soutenir les essais d'acceptation par les utilisateurs, harmoniser les résultats de Cognos avec ceux de Power BI, analyser les écarts et consigner les résultats des essais.
Collaborer avec les équipes de l'ingénierie des données, de l'architecture, de la gouvernance et des plateformes afin de garantir que les rapports soient sécurisés, performants, faciles à maintenir et conformes à l'architecture de données cible d'EDC.
Préparer les mises à jour sur l'inventaire des rapports, les documents techniques, les guides d'utilisation et les documents relatifs au transfert de connaissances destinés aux équipes de soutien et aux utilisateurs fonctionnels.
Contribuer à la planification de la migration, à l'amélioration de l'arriéré de travail, à la définition des priorités, à la production de rapports d'état et au suivi des problèmes et des risques.
Soutenir le déploiement dans l'environnement de production, la validation après mise en œuvre et la transition des rapports migrés vers le soutien continu


Ce que nous cherchons:


Diplôme universitaire de premier cycle en affaires, en informatique, en systèmes d'information de gestion, en analyse de données, en finance ou dans une discipline connexe, ou combinaison équivalente d'études et d'expérience
Au moins 7 années d'expérience dans les domaines de la veille stratégique, de la production de rapports et de l'analyse de données, ainsi que dans l'élaboration de solutions de production de rapports ou d'analyse à grande échelle sur des plateformes d'analyse d'entreprise comme Cognos, Tableau ou Power BI
Expérience dans l'élaboration de rapports, de tableaux de bord, de modèles sémantiques ou de rapports paginés dans Power BI
Expérience avec Microsoft Fabric
Expérience en matière d'analyse, de rétro-ingénierie ou de migration de rapports depuis IBM Cognos Analytics vers Power BI : Report Studio, Framework Manager, dossiers Cognos, requêtes et analyses de vérification ou d'utilisation
Solides compétences dans l'utilisation du SQL et expérience dans l'utilisation de bases de données relationnelles, de dépôt de données, d'entrepôts de données ou de plateformes de données d'entreprise
Capacité avérée à recenser les exigences, à consigner la logique commerciale, à valider les résultats et à communiquer les résultats à un auditoire technique et d'équipes sectorielles
Expérience dans le soutien à la vérification des rapports, le rapprochement, la résolution des défauts et l'approbation des parties prenantes


Atouts:


Expérience de travail dans le secteur des services financiers, banquiers ou d'assurance, dans des environnements de production de rapports réglementés ou auprès de sociétés d'État
Expérience en matière de gouvernance des données, d'élaboration de documents sur les métadonnées, de traçage, de gestion de l'inventaire des rapports et de retrait contrôlé des rapports
Connaissance des méthodes de déploiement agile, d'Azure DevOps, de la gestion de l'arriéré de travail et de l'élaboration itérative de rapports
Maîtrise des deux langues officielles
Compréhension rapide des anciens rapports complexes et capacité à les transformer en produits d'analyse modernes et conviviaux
Capacité à trouver le juste équilibre entre le contexte opérationnel et les détails techniques, en veillant à ce que les rapports migrés ne soient pas simplement reproduits, mais améliorés au besoin
Capacité à communiquer clairement avec les utilisateurs des rapports, les développeurs, les architectes et les équipes des plateformes et contribuer ainsi à faire le lien entre les besoins opérationnels et la mise en œuvre technique


Admissibilité :

EDC s'engage à respecter des pratiques d'emploi équitables et la préférence sera accordée aux candidats qui sont en mesure de travailler légalement au Canada au moment de la présentation de leur candidature (citoyens canadiens ou résidents permanents). Les candidats doivent satisfaire aux exigences de sécurité du gouvernement. Pour obtenir de plus amples renseignements, veuillez consulter la section 2.1 de la Norme d'acquisition des talents, accessible sur LINK sous l'onglet Ressources, dans la section Politiques et procédures. Le poste est ouvert aux personnes qui répondent à toutes les exigences essentielles énoncées ci-dessus et dont la candidature est reçue avant la date limite.

Engagement d'EDC envers l'équité en matière d'emploi

Exportation et développement Canada (EDC) s'engage à favoriser l'équité en matière d'emploi et à constituer une main-d'œuvre diversifiée. Elle s'engage à créer un environnement sûr et inclusif qui respecte les personnes de toutes les origines, aptitudes et compétences. EDC favorise une culture d'inclusion et d'appartenance où chaque personne a des chances égales de se perfectionner, de se développer, de réussir et de réaliser son plein potentiel.

Votre candidature doit démontrer clairement que vous répondez à toutes les exigences. Nous remercions tous les candidats de l'intérêt qu'ils portent à une carrière à EDC. Toutefois, seules les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien seront contactées. Veuillez noter que les candidats qualifiés peuvent être pris en considération pour des postes similaires à ce niveau au sein d'EDC.

EDC reconnaît que le fait de divulguer la nécessité de prévoir des mesures d'adaptation peut être une question personnelle. Sachez qu'en tant qu'organisation, nous nous engageons à respecter la confidentialité et à veiller à ce que toutes les mesures d'adaptation fournies soient adaptées à vos besoins. Notre objectif est de vous garantir une expérience positive et satisfaisante tout au long du processus de recrutement. N'hésitez donc pas à nous contacter directement pour toute demande d'adaptation à l'adresse accessibility@edc.ca. Nous sommes là pour vous aider à chaque étape du processus.

Énoncé de confidentialité

En postulant à cet emploi, vous reconnaissez avoir lu et compris l'Énoncé de confidentialité d'EDC pour les candidats à l'emploi, qui décrit comment nous recueillons, utilisons, conservons et protégeons les renseignements personnels pendant le processus de recrutement, ainsi que vos droits d'accès et de rectification.

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, Talent Acquisition Analytics
Description:
Description

As a Business Intelligence Engineer, this is your opportunity to be at the intersection of data, analysis, hiring, and strategy that will make it possible for our teams to fulfill that customer promise every day.

In this role, you will own data analytics projects from beginning to end, and will build reports, compile metrics, and own ad hoc and trend analysis. You will utilize business intelligence tools to analyze data and drive key recommendations. You will work with Talent Acquisition leadership to achieve business objectives and communicate insights to key stakeholders. You will recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis, including data integrity, analysis, validation, and documentation; and drive results in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

You will provide analytical support for various Talent Acquisition programs, and build tools to surface timely, meaningful, and actionable data that will drive proactive decision making. Your analysis will contribute deeply to the development of our strategy and drive impact against our hiring objectives. You will collaborate with subject matter experts across Amazon to work through complex problems and to create unified scalable reporting solutions at an enterprise-wide level. You will have the opportunity to partner with the central HR Information Systems teams as an influencer on their next generation road map.

Key job responsibilities


Collaborate with recruiting operations, data scientists, and business leaders to define business processes and provide analytical support
Leverage code to analyze complex datasets and design, develop and evaluate data transformations to solve specific business problems
Build scalable, efficient, and automated data processes to facilitate customer-facing reporting
Automate TA processes to streamline business operations
Communicate verbally or in writing to business customers / leadership for sharing insights and recommendations
Build dashboards and reports for both recruiting leaders and the businesses they support
Perform complex data analysis across multiple systems to support both scheduled and ad-hoc reporting requests
Mine key performance indicators to discover root causes
Analyze business outcome data in order to identify relationships and trends; incorporate data visualization and statistical analyses


About The Team

Amazon delights millions of customers around the world, and the Talent Acquisition team enables our business leaders to make informed and effective hiring decisions.

Basic Qualifications


3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse
Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling

Title: Senior Associate, Strategy & Operations - Integrity (International)
Description:
About the Team

The Integrity team is seeking a Strategy & Operations Senior Associate to help reduce fraud costs and drive solutions that safeguard the integrity of our platform. In this role, you'll develop a deep understanding of our three core audiences—Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants—and become a key resource for analyzing behaviors that may indicate risky or abusive patterns. You'll lead investigations into high-risk activity, design data-informed strategies, and implement cross-functional initiatives to mitigate losses while maintaining a seamless and trusted user experience. Most importantly, you'll help strike the right balance between user trust and risk management, ensuring we continue to support growth while protecting the platform.

About the Role

Our best Senior Associates are data-driven, truth seeking, strategic thought partners and operators. They combine business context and analytics to take on a problem area and implement a customized solution. Think this is you? Read on…

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Establish and refine DoorDash's strategic approach to payments, credit and refund risks - work on the operations, engineering, and analytics needed to protect DoorDash's audiences from bad actors
Analyze user behavior across DoorDash's platform – complete end-to-end analysis that allows us to better identify the bad actors and improve the experience of good users
Influence and engage across the company - partner with the product, engineering, and analytics teams to establish goals and build strategic programs
Improve through experimentation – use data-driven decision-making to run tests in order to reduce risk while accelerating growth


We're excited about you because…


2+ years of experience in consulting, strategy, business development, operations, technology, investment banking, analytics or related experience
Experience leading projects, hitting goals, and succeeding in a team environment
Strong communicator, both written and verbal
Problem solving and analytical skills, including proficiency in SQL and expertise in Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets/sheets)
You have a bachelor's degree


Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.

$97,000—$121,000 CAD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Title: Actuarial Analyst
Description:
We’re searching for an Actuarial Analyst. Are you searching for new possibilities?

Westland Insurance Group Ltd is growing and has an exciting opportunity for an Actuarial Analyst to join our growing team. This hybrid role is based out of our Head Office in Surrey, BC.

Expected Compensation: The expected hiring range for this role is $80,000- $105,000 with a 35-hour work week. Your rate of pay will be determined based on your individual qualifications and experience, while considering internal equity.  Westland also offers a competitive annual short-term incentive program that enables employees to share in the rewards of the business and emphasizes the measures that are key to our success.

Discover What’s Possible, With Westland.

The Westland story is all about growth, and that means plenty of possibility for everyone on our team. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of clients, communities, and each other with equal commitment. As we continue to open new doors, we're inviting amazing people like you to join us.

As an Actuarial Analyst, you'll play a key role in supporting pricing strategy and data-driven decision making across Westland's in-house insurance products. Working alongside actuaries, data engineers, and analysts, you'll help shape the future of our pricing capabilities while building expertise in actuarial analysis, predictive modelling, and insurance analytics.

Interested in learning more?

Why You'll Love Westland


An open, flexible and welcoming workplace
Plenty of opportunities to grow and learn
Autonomy to drive your own success
Be part of our inclusive culture, alongside an extraordinarily talented community of people with a wide variety of backgrounds
A total rewards program that takes care of your financial, physical, and mental health
Flexible paid Values Days to celebrate days important to you
Paid Volunteer Days for employees as part of Amplifying Communities, a program to support causes that matter most to our employees and clients


Why We’ll Love You


You love working with data and using analytical thinking to uncover trends, solve problems, and support business decisions
You have a bachelor's degree in Actuarial Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, or another quantitative field and are actively pursuing an actuarial designation (CAS or SOA), with actuarial exams considered an asset
You have at least two years of experience in an actuarial, analytical, or data-focused role, with experience using SQL, Python, and/or R for analysis and modelling
You enjoy collaborating with actuaries, analysts, engineers, and business partners to translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations
You can communicate complex findings clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences
You have strong attention to detail, sound critical-thinking skills, and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work
Bonus: Experience with insurance pricing, predictive modelling, Power BI, Databricks, or P&C insurance


Once Here, You'll


Be a contributing member of our inclusive culture, alongside an extraordinarily talented community of people with a wide variety of backgrounds
Support actuarial pricing analyses and help monitor rate adequacy across Westland's portfolio of Personal and Commercial Lines insurance products
Partner with underwriting, operations, actuarial, and data teams to implement pricing changes and improve pricing processes
Extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources to support pricing decisions, portfolio insights, and business objectives
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations while identifying opportunities to automate recurring analysis and reporting
Contribute to the development, testing, and enhancement of predictive models that support pricing, retention, and conversion strategies
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders while continuously developing your actuarial, technical, and analytical expertise


Want to get to know each other better? Send your resume our way.

You belong here

We strive to be much more than a great place to work. Here, you join a collective of incredibly vibrant, purpose driven, and open-minded people. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of communities, clients, and each other with equal commitment. You will be supported and respected for who you are and for the voice you add to the conversation.

At Westland, you will feel the power of community. Westland Insurance Ltd. is an inclusive organization that values diversity in its workforce. We listen, champion equity and diversity, and create safe welcoming spaces where everyone has a voice and is free to be themselves. Westland Insurance Ltd. encourages applications from all qualified individuals and will accommodate applicants' disability-related needs, up to the point of undue hardship, throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

If you require a disability-related accommodation in order to participate in the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team by email at careers@westlandinsurance.ca
